entry.summary: Introduces the Triton dataset (590k instances) and progressive training curriculum for robust web navigation agents, using structural-semantic hard negative mining to improve discrimination in HTML-based environments.

entry.title: Generating Effective CoT Traces for Mitigating Causal Hallucination

author.name: Yiheng Zhao, Jun Yan

entry.summary: Investigates what makes effective CoT traces for mitigating causal hallucination in small LLMs (≤1.5B) for event causality identification. Designs a pipeline for generating quality CoT traces and introduces a causal hallucination metric.

entry.title: Memory as Metabolism: A Design for Companion Knowledge Systems

author.name: Stefan Miteski

entry.summary: Proposes a companion-specific memory governance framework inspired by biological metabolism, situated within the 2026 landscape of personal wiki-style memory architectures (Karpathy, MemPalace) and production memory systems. Discusses memory lifecycle management for personal AI companions.

entry.title: Beyond Factual Grounding: The Case for Opinion-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Aditya Agrawal, Alwarappan Nakkiran, Darshan Fofadiya, Alex Karlsson, Harsha Aduri

entry.summary: Identifies and addresses factual bias in RAG systems that treat opinions as noise rather than information. Discusses risks including echo chambers and underrepresentation of minority viewpoints.

entry.title: AutoSurrogate: An LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous Construction of Deep Learning Surrogate Models in Subsurface Flow

author.name: Jiale Liu, Nanzhe Wang

entry.summary: Presents AutoSurrogate, an LLM-driven multi-agent framework that automates the construction of deep learning surrogate models for subsurface flow simulation, enabling domain scientists without ML expertise to build surrogates.

entry.title: Fully Homomorphic Encryption on Llama 3 model for privacy preserving LLM inference

author.name: Anes Abdennebi, Nadjia Kara, Laaziz Lahlou

entry.summary: Applies Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) to Llama 3 for privacy-preserving LLM inference, addressing data exposure risks in enterprise LLM deployments.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Semantic Bootstrapping for Interpretable Text Classification with Tsetlin Machines

author.name: Jiechao Gao, Rohan Kumar Yadav, Yuangang Li, Yuandong Pan, Jie Wang, Ying Liu, Michael Lepech

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic bootstrapping framework that transfers LLM knowledge into interpretable Tsetlin Machine representations through synthetic data generation, combining LLM semantic capacity with symbolic interpretability.

entry.title: ARGOS: Who, Where, and When in Agentic Multi-Camera Person Search

author.name: Myungchul Kim, Kwanyong Park, Junmo Kim, In So Kweon

entry.summary: ARGOS introduces the first benchmark reformulating multi-camera person search as an interactive reasoning problem where an agent must plan, question, and eliminate candidates using a spatio-temporal topology graph.

entry.title: Loop Corrections to the Training and Generalization Errors of Random Feature Models

author.name: Taeyoung Kim

entry.summary: Studies random feature models through a statistical physics lens, deriving loop corrections to training/test/generalization errors beyond mean-kernel approximation, obtaining finite-width scaling laws.

entry.title: Distorted or Fabricated? A Survey on Hallucination in Video LLMs

author.name: Yiyang Huang, Yitian Zhang, Yizhou Wang, Mingyuan Zhang, Liang Shi, Huimin Zeng, Yun Fu

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on hallucinations in Video LLMs, introducing a taxonomy of dynamic distortion and content fabrication, reviewing evaluation benchmarks, metrics, and mitigation strategies.

entry.title: UCS: Estimating Unseen Coverage for Improved In-Context Learning

author.name: Jiayi Xin, Xiang Li, Evan Qiang, Weiqing He, Tianqi Shang, Weijie J. Su, Qi Long

entry.summary: UCS proposes Unseen Coverage Selection for in-context learning demonstrations, using Good-Turing estimation to select examples that maximize coverage of unseen latent clusters.

entry.title: SOLARIS: Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling

author.name: Zikun Liu, Liang Luo, Qianru Li, Zhengyu Zhang, Wei Ling, Jingyi Shen, Zeliang Chen, Yaning Huang, Jingxian Huang, Abdallah Aboelela, Chonglin Sun, Feifan Gu, Fenggang Wu, Hang Qu, Huayu Li, Jill Pan, Kaidi Pei, Laming Chen, Longhao Jin, Qin Huang, Tongyi Tang, Varna Puvvada, Wenlin Chen, Xiaohan Wei, Xu Cao, Yantao Yao, Yuan Jin, Yunchen Pu, Yuxin Chen, Zijian Shen, Zhengkai Zhang, Dong Liang, Ellie Wen

entry.summary: SOLARIS applies speculative decoding ideas to recommendation systems, precomputing user-item embeddings for predicted future requests to enable real-time serving of complex foundation models.

entry.title: PrivEraserVerify: Efficient, Private, and Verifiable Federated Unlearning

author.name: Parthaw Goswami, Md Khairul Islam, Ashfak Yeafi

entry.summary: Presents PrivEraserVerify (PEV), a unified federated unlearning framework that combines efficiency, differential privacy protection, and verifiability—three properties previously addressed only in isolation by existing methods.

entry.title: Training single-electron and single-photon stochastic physical neural networks

author.name: Tong Dou, Shiro Kumara, Josh Burns, Ethan Sigler, Parth Girdhar, David Petty, Gerard Milburn, Jo Plested, Matt Woolley

entry.summary: Proposes novel electronic (single-electron tunneling) and photonic (single-photon) stochastic neurons for physical neural networks, demonstrating training methods for these quantum-scale computing elements.

entry.title: Information-Geometric Decomposition of Generalization Error in Unsupervised Learning

author.name: Gilhan Kim

entry.summary: Decomposes KL generalization error in unsupervised learning into model error, data bias, and variance using information geometry. Demonstrates on ε-PCA as an analytically tractable example.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Transfer with Particle Physics Foundation Models: From Jets to Neutrino Interactions

author.name: Gregor Krzmanc, Vinicius Mikuni, Benjamin Nachman, Callum Wilkinson

entry.summary: Demonstrates that the OmniLearned foundation model pre-trained on high-energy particle physics data can transfer effectively to few-GeV neutrino experiments, showing improved performance with less data.

entry.title: Generative Anonymization in Event Streams

author.name: Adam T. M\"uller, Mihai Kocsis, Nicolaj C. Stache

entry.summary: Presents the first generative anonymization framework for event camera streams, resolving the utility-privacy trade-off by anonymizing identities while preserving spatio-temporal structure for downstream tasks.

entry.title: Transforming External Knowledge into Triplets for Enhanced Retrieval in RAG of LLMs

author.name: Xudong Wang, Chaoning Zhang, Qigan Sun, Zhenzhen Huang, Chang Lu, Sheng Zheng, Zeyu Ma, Caiyan Qin, Yang Yang, Hengtao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Tri-RAG, which transforms retrieved external knowledge into structured triplets for RAG, aiming to reduce redundancy and improve semantic alignment compared to concatenating unstructured text fragments.

entry.title: Multilingual Multi-Label Emotion Classification at Scale with Synthetic Data

author.name: Vadim Borisov

entry.summary: Constructs a large-scale synthetic multilingual multi-label emotion classification corpus of 1M+ samples across 23 languages with culturally-adapted generation. Trains and compares six multilingual transformer encoders from 135M to 560M parameters.

entry.title: SceneCritic: A Symbolic Evaluator for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis

author.name: Kathakoli Sengupta, Kai Ao, Paola Cascante-Bonilla

entry.summary: Introduces SceneCritic, a symbolic evaluator for indoor scene layouts grounded in SceneOnto, a spatial ontology constructed from 3D-FRONT and other datasets. Provides stable, deterministic evaluation independent of viewpoint and rendering.

entry.title: V-Nutri: Dish-Level Nutrition Estimation from Egocentric Cooking Videos

author.name: Chengkun Yue, Chuanzhi Xu, Jiangpeng He

entry.summary: Proposes V-Nutri for dish-level nutrition estimation from egocentric cooking videos rather than single images of completed dishes. Establishes the first benchmark for video-based nutrition estimation using HD-EPIC dataset annotations.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Structureless Visual Localization via Image Obfuscation

author.name: Vojtech Panek, Patrik Beliansky, Zuzana Kukelova, Torsten Sattler

entry.summary: Considers structureless visual localization methods for privacy preservation, where scenes are represented through reference images rather than 3D point clouds. Proposes image obfuscation techniques to prevent privacy leakage.

entry.title: VidTAG: Temporally Aligned Video to GPS Geolocalization with Denoising Sequence Prediction at a Global Scale

author.name: Parth Parag Kulkarni, Rohit Gupta, Prakash Chandra Chhipa, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Proposes VidTAG for video geolocalization via frame-to-GPS retrieval using both self-supervised and language-aligned features. Uses denoising sequence prediction to address temporal inconsistencies in video predictions.

entry.title: ArtifactWorld: Scaling 3D Gaussian Splatting Artifact Restoration via Video Generation Models

author.name: Xinliang Wang, Yifeng Shi, Zhenyu Wu

entry.summary: Proposes ArtifactWorld for 3DGS artifact restoration using video generation models with a fine-grained taxonomy of artifacts and a homogeneous dual-model paradigm. Addresses data bottleneck for training artifact repair.

entry.title: DreamStereo: Towards Real-Time Stereo Inpainting for HD Videos

author.name: Yuan Huang, Sijie Zhao, Jing Cheng, Hao Xu, Shaohui Jiao

entry.summary: Introduces DreamStereo for real-time stereo video inpainting of HD content, addressing data scarcity and computational redundancy. Three interconnected components handle dataset creation, efficient processing, and quality.

entry.title: RSGMamba: Reliability-Aware Self-Gated State Space Model for Multimodal Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Guoan Xu, Yang Xiao, Guangwei Gao, Dongchen Zhu, Wenjing Jia, Guo-Jun Qi

entry.summary: Proposes RSGMamba for multimodal semantic segmentation with explicit modality reliability modeling. Uses Reliability-aware Self-Gated Mamba Block to dynamically adjust fusion based on modality quality.

entry.title: Evolution-Inspired Sample Competition for Deep Neural Network Optimization

author.name: Ying Zheng, Yiyi Zhang, Yi Wang, Lap-Pui Chau

entry.summary: Proposes Natural Selection (NS), an evolution-inspired training method that models competitive interactions among samples to address class imbalance, hard samples, and noisy samples in deep learning.

entry.title: PDF-GS: Progressive Distractor Filtering for Robust 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Kangmin Seo, MinKyu Lee, Tae-Young Kim, ByeongCheol Lee, JoonSeoung An, Jae-Pil Heo

entry.summary: Proposes PDF-GS, a progressive distractor filtering framework for robust 3D Gaussian Splatting that exploits the inherent self-filtering property of 3DGS through multi-phase optimization.

entry.title: Scaling In-Context Segmentation with Hierarchical Supervision

author.name: T. Camaret Ndir, Marco Reisert, Robin T. Schirrmeister

entry.summary: Proposes PatchICL, a hierarchical framework for in-context medical image segmentation that learns to attend only to informative anatomical regions, improving scalability over global cross-attention approaches.

entry.title: Representing 3D Faces with Learnable B-Spline Volumes

author.name: Prashanth Chandran, Daoye Wang, Timo Bolkart

entry.summary: Presents CUBE, a B-spline volume representation with learned high-dimensional control features for 3D face modeling, demonstrating use in scan registration and monocular 3D face reconstruction.

entry.title: Radar-Camera BEV Multi-Task Learning with Cross-Task Attention Bridge for Joint 3D Detection and Segmentation

author.name: Ahmet \.Inan\c{c}, \"Ozg\"ur Erkent

entry.summary: Proposes CTAB, a bidirectional cross-task attention module for radar-camera BEV perception that exchanges features between detection and segmentation branches via multi-scale deformable attention.

entry.title: Pi-HOC: Pairwise 3D Human-Object Contact Estimation

author.name: Sravan Chittupalli, Ayush Jain, Dong Huang

entry.summary: Introduces Pi-HOC, a single-pass framework for dense 3D semantic contact prediction of all human-object pairs in images, handling multi-person scenarios without requiring object meshes.

entry.title: Direct Discrepancy Replay: Distribution-Discrepancy Condensation and Manifold-Consistent Replay for Continual Face Forgery Detection

entry.title: See, Point, Refine: Multi-Turn Approach to GUI Grounding with Visual Feedback

author.name: Himangi Mittal, Gaurav Mittal, Nelson Daniel Troncoso, Yu Hu

entry.title: PAINT: Partner-Agnostic Intent-Aware Cooperative Transport with Legged Robots

author.name: Zhihao Cao, Tianxu An, Chenhao Li, Stelian Coros, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: PAINT is a hierarchical learning framework for partner-agnostic collaborative legged robot transport that infers partner intent from proprioceptive feedback alone, without requiring partner identification or communication.

entry.title: Robust Explanations for User Trust in Enterprise NLP Systems

author.name: Guilin Zhang, Kai Zhao, Jeffrey Friedman, Xu Chu, Amine Anoun, Jerry Ting

entry.summary: Proposes a unified black-box robustness evaluation framework for token-level NLP explanations, testing stability under realistic perturbations across encoder classifiers and decoder LLMs in enterprise deployment settings.

entry.title: X-VC: Zero-shot Streaming Voice Conversion in Codec Space

author.name: Qixi Zheng, Yuxiang Zhao, Tianrui Wang, Wenxi Chen, Kele Xu, Yikang Li, Qinyuan Chen, Xipeng Qiu, Kai Yu, Xie Chen

entry.summary: Presents X-VC, a zero-shot streaming voice conversion system that operates in neural codec latent space, achieving both high-fidelity speaker transfer and low-latency streaming through dual-conditioning and one-step conversion.

entry.title: Forecasting the Past: Gradient-Based Distribution Shift Detection in Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Michele De Vita, Julian Wiederer, Vasileios Belagiannis

entry.title: RMGS-SLAM: Real-time Multi-sensor Gaussian Splatting SLAM

author.name: Dongen Li, Yi Liu, Junqi Liu, Zewen Sun, Zefan Huang, Shuo Sun, Jiahui Liu, Chengran Yuan, Hongliang Guo, Francis E. H. Tay, Marcelo H. Ang Jr

entry.summary: Presents a tightly coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual 3DGS-based SLAM framework for real-time photorealistic mapping in large-scale environments, parallelizing state estimation with Gaussian optimization.

entry.title: TCL: Enabling Fast and Efficient Cross-Hardware Tensor Program Optimization via Continual Learning

author.name: Chaoyao Shen, Linfeng Jiang, Yixian Shen, Tao Xu, Guoqing Li, Anuj Pathania, Andy D. Pimentel, Meng Zhang

entry.title: XRZero-G0: Pushing the Frontier of Dexterous Robotic Manipulation with Interfaces, Quality and Ratios

author.name: Junming Wang, Teng Pu, Wingmun Fung, Jindong Wang, Shanchang Wang, Yuan Deng, Shuyuan Wang, Ziwei Liu, Kunhao Pan, Ping Yang, Peng Zhai, Yuxin Liang, Xiaofan Li, Jiabi Sun, Renchao Xu, Xiaotian Tian, Pengfei Yan, Guoqiang Ye, Liang Li, Qian Wang, Ruyi Gan, Hao Wang

entry.title: Identity as Attractor: Geometric Evidence for Persistent Agent Architecture in LLM Activation Space

author.name: Vladimir Vasilenko

entry.title: How memory can affect collective and cooperative behaviors in an LLM-Based Social Particle Swarm

entry.title: A Two-Stage LLM Framework for Accessible and Verified XAI Explanations

author.name: Georgios Mermigkis, Dimitris Metaxakis, Marios Tyrovolas, Argiris Sofotasios, Nikolaos Avgeris, Panagiotis Hadjidoukas, Chrysostomos Stylios

entry.title: Transferable Expertise for Autonomous Agents via Real-World Case-Based Learning

author.name: Zhenyu Ma, Yuyang Song, Chunyi Yang, Jingyi Zhu, Letian Yang, Xukai Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes a case-based learning framework for LLM agents that converts past task experience into reusable knowledge assets, enabling transfer of analytical prompts and operational skills to new tasks.

entry.title: DBGL: Decay-aware Bipartite Graph Learning for Irregular Medical Time Series Classification

author.name: Jian Chen, Yuzhu Hu, Xiaoyan Yuan, Yuxuan Hu, Jinfeng Xu, Yipeng Du, Wenhao Yuan, Wei Wang, Edith C. H. Ngai

entry.title: SpanKey: Dynamic Key Space Conditioning for Neural Network Access Control

author.name: WenBin Yan

entry.summary: Introduces SpanKey, a lightweight method to gate neural network inference using secret keys by conditioning activations on key subspaces, with analysis of failure modes including 'key absorption'.

entry.title: Black-Box Optimization From Small Offline Datasets via Meta Learning with Synthetic Tasks

author.name: Azza Fadhel, The Hung Tran, Trong Nghia Hoang, Jana Doppa

entry.title: FRTSearch: Unified Detection and Parameter Inference of Fast Radio Transients using Instance Segmentation

author.name: Bin Zhang, Yabiao Wang, Xiaoyao Xie, Shanping You, Xuhong Yu, Qiuhua Li, Hongwei Li, Shaowen Du, Chenchen Miao, Dengke Zhou, Jianhua Fang, Jiafu Wu, Pei Wang, Di Li

entry.title: From Kinematics to Dynamics: Learning to Refine Hybrid Plans for Physically Feasible Execution

author.name: Lidor Erez, Shahaf S. Shperberg, Ayal Taitler

entry.title: KG-Reasoner: A Reinforced Model for End-to-End Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Reasoning

author.name: Shuai Wang, Yinan Yu

entry.title: Learning Chain Of Thoughts Prompts for Predicting Entities, Relations, and even Literals on Knowledge Graphs

entry.title: CLASP: Class-Adaptive Layer Fusion and Dual-Stage Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models

entry.title: Uncertainty Quantification in CNN Through the Bootstrap of Convex Neural Networks

author.name: Hongfei Du, Emre Barut, Fang Jin

entry.title: Exploring Concept Subspace for Self-explainable Text-Attributed Graph Learning

author.name: Xiaoxue Han, Libo Zhang, Zining Zhu, Yue Ning

entry.title: Offline-Online Reinforcement Learning for Linear Mixture MDPs

author.name: Zhongjun Zhang, Sean R. Sinclair

entry.title: Rethinking the Personalized Relaxed Initialization in the Federated Learning: Consistency and Generalization

entry.title: 3DRO: Lidar-level SE(3) Direct Radar Odometry Using a 2D Imaging Radar and a Gyroscope

entry.title: From edges to meaning: Semantic line sketches as a cognitive scaffold for ancient pictograph invention

author.name: Seowung Leem (J. Crayton Pruitt Family Dept. of Biomedical Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA), Lin Gu (Research Institute of Electrical Communication, Tohoku University, Japan), Ruogu Fang (J. Crayton Pruitt Family Dept. of Biomedical Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA, Dept. of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA, Dept. of Computer and Information Science and Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA, Center for Cognitive Aging and Memory, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA)

entry.title: BID-LoRA: A Parameter-Efficient Framework for Continual Learning and Unlearning

entry.summary: BID-LoRA formalizes Continual Learning-Unlearning as a unified paradigm, identifying knowledge leakage in naive combinations and proposing a LoRA-based framework for precise deletion and efficient learning.

entry.title: Efficient Adversarial Training via Criticality-Aware Fine-Tuning

entry.summary: Proposes efficient adversarial training via criticality-aware fine-tuning of ViTs, identifying and robustly fine-tuning only a small subset of critical parameters to match full adversarial training performance.

entry.title: EEG-Based Multimodal Learning via Hyperbolic Mixture-of-Curvature Experts

entry.title: Refined Differentially Private Linear Regression via Extension of a Free Lunch Result

author.name: Sasmita Harini S, Anshoo Tandon

entry.title: Fine-tuning Factor Augmented Neural Lasso for Heterogeneous Environments

author.name: Jinhang Chai, Jianqing Fan, Cheng Gao, Qishuo Yin

entry.summary: Introduces fine-tuning Factor Augmented Neural Lasso (FAN-Lasso), a transfer learning framework for high-dimensional nonparametric regression with variable selection that handles covariate and posterior shifts.

entry.title: Redefining Quality Criteria and Distance-Aware Score Modeling for Image Editing Assessment

author.name: Xinjie Zhang, Qiang Li, Xiaowen Ma, Axi Niu, Li Yan, Qingsen Yan

entry.title: Tree Learning: A Multi-Skill Continual Learning Framework for Humanoid Robots

entry.title: Human-Inspired Context-Selective Multimodal Memory for Social Robots

author.name: Hangyeol Kang, Slava Voloshynovskiy, Nadia Magnenat Thalmann

entry.summary: Proposes a context-selective multimodal memory architecture for social robots inspired by cognitive neuroscience, capturing textual and visual episodic traces prioritized by emotional salience or scene novelty for personalized interactions.

entry.title: TRUST Agents: A Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Fake News Detection, Explainable Verification, and Logic-Aware Claim Reasoning

author.name: Gautama Shastry Bulusu Venkata, Santhosh Kakarla, Maheedhar Omtri Mohan, Aishwarya Gaddam

entry.summary: Presents TRUST Agents, a multi-agent framework for explainable fact verification combining claim extraction, hybrid retrieval (BM25+FAISS), evidence comparison with calibrated confidence, and explanation generation.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence for Modeling and Simulation of Mixed Automated and Human Traffic

author.name: Saeed Rahmani, Shiva Rasouli, Daphne Cornelisse, Eugene Vinitsky, Bart van Arem, Simeon C. Calvert

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of AI methods for simulating mixed autonomous and human traffic, covering the gap between graphical realism in simulation tools and behavioral realism using AI.

entry.title: Thermodynamic Liquid Manifold Networks: Physics-Bounded Deep Learning for Solar Forecasting in Autonomous Off-Grid Microgrids

author.name: Mohammed Ezzaldin Babiker Abdullah

entry.summary: Introduces Thermodynamic Liquid Manifold Networks for solar forecasting in off-grid microgrids, combining Koopman-linearized Riemannian manifolds with thermodynamic constraints to prevent physically impossible predictions like nocturnal power generation.

entry.title: INDOTABVQA: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Table Understanding in Bahasa Indonesia Documents

author.name: Somraj Gautam, Anathapindika Dravichi, Gaurav Harit

entry.summary: Introduces INDOTABVQA, a cross-lingual Table VQA benchmark for Bahasa Indonesia documents with 1,593 images and QA sets in four languages, revealing substantial performance gaps in current VLMs on structurally complex tables.

entry.title: ARGen: Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation towards Vision-based Dynamic Emotion Perception

author.name: Huanzhen Wang, Ziheng Zhou, Jiaqi Song, Li He, Yunshi Lan, Yan Wang, Wenqiang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ARGen, a two-stage framework for dynamic facial expression recognition that uses affect-reinforced generative augmentation to address data scarcity and long-tail distributions of emotional expressions.

entry.title: GCA Framework: A Gulf-Grounded Dataset and Agentic Pipeline for Climate Decision Support

author.name: Muhammad Umer Sheikh, Khawar Shehzad, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Muhammad Haris Khan

entry.summary: Presents the GCA framework combining a Gulf-focused climate dataset (~200K QA pairs) with a tool-augmented agent for climate analysis in the Gulf region, integrating policy documents, academic literature, and geospatial tools.

entry.title: GeM-EA: A Generative and Meta-learning Enhanced Evolutionary Algorithm for Streaming Data-Driven Optimization

author.name: Yue Wu, Yuan-Ting Zhong, Ze-Yuan Ma, Yue-Jiao Gong

entry.summary: Proposes GeM-EA, combining meta-learned surrogate adaptation with generative replay for evolutionary optimization on streaming data with concept drift.

entry.title: Euler-inspired Decoupling Neural Operator for Efficient Pansharpening

author.name: Anqi Zhu, Mengting Ma, Yizhen Jiang, Xiangdong Li, Kai Zheng, Jiaxin Li, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes EDNO, an Euler-inspired neural operator for pansharpening that works in the frequency domain using Euler's formula for spectral-spatial decomposition, offering physics-inspired efficiency over diffusion-based methods.

entry.title: Social Learning Strategies for Evolved Virtual Soft Robots

author.name: K. Ege de Bruin, Kyrre Glette, Kai Olav Ellefsen, Giorgia Nadizar, Eric Medvet

entry.summary: Introduces social learning strategies for evolved virtual soft robots where robots share optimized control parameters with peers to accelerate brain optimization, systematically investigating teacher selection and knowledge transfer.

entry.title: When Does Data Augmentation Help? Evaluating LLM and Back-Translation Methods for Hausa and Fongbe NLP

author.name: Mahounan Pericles Adjovi, Roald Eiselen, Prasenjit Mitra

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM-based and back-translation data augmentation for low-resource African languages (Hausa, Fongbe), finding augmentation effectiveness depends on task type rather than language or LLM quality.

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Optimization for Task-Adapted Compressed Sensing Magnetic Resonance Imaging

author.name: Xinyu Peng, Ziyang Zheng, Wenrui Dai, Duoduo Xue, Shaohui Li, Chenglin Li, Junni Zou, Hongkai Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes information-theoretic optimization for task-adapted compressed sensing MRI, achieving probabilistic inference for uncertainty prediction while adapting to arbitrary sampling ratios and clinical tasks.

entry.title: FastGrasp: Learning-based Whole-body Control method for Fast Dexterous Grasping with Mobile Manipulators

author.name: Heng Tao, Yiming Zhong, Zemin Yang, Yuexin Ma

entry.summary: FastGrasp combines grasp guidance, whole-body control, and tactile feedback for mobile fast grasping using a two-stage RL strategy with conditional VAE for grasp candidate generation.

entry.title: Labeled TrustSet Guided: Batch Active Learning with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Guofeng Cui, Yang Liu, Pichao Wang, Hankai Hsu, Xiaohang Sun, Xiang Hao, Zhu Liu

entry.summary: Introduces TrustSet, a batch active learning approach that uses reinforcement learning to select informative labeled data while maintaining balanced class distributions. Addresses limitations of traditional BAL methods that ignore feedback from labeled data.

entry.title: Instantiating Bayesian CVaR lower bounds in Interactive Decision Making Problems

author.name: Raghav Bongole, Tobias J. Oechtering, Mikael Skoglund

entry.summary: Derives explicit Bayesian CVaR lower bounds for interactive decision-making problems by instantiating a generalized-Fano framework, demonstrating on canonical examples like Gaussian bandits.

entry.title: FlowBoost Reveals Phase Transitions and Spectral Structure in Finite Free Information Inequalities

author.name: Baran Hashemi

entry.summary: Uses FlowBoost, a deep generative optimization framework, to discover extremal structures in finite free information inequalities, conjecturing singular values of a key matrix and obtaining sharp stability constants.

entry.title: On Higher-Order Geometric Refinements of Classical Covariance Asymptotics: An Approach via Intrinsic and Extrinsic Information Geometry

author.name: Malik Amir, Sourangshu Ghosh

entry.summary: Develops higher-order geometric refinements of classical covariance asymptotics using information geometry, providing n^{-2} corrections to Fisher information bounds for curved statistical models.

entry.title: Evaluating Differential Privacy Against Membership Inference in Federated Learning: Insights from the NIST Genomics Red Team Challenge

author.name: Gustavo de Carvalho Bertoli

entry.summary: Evaluates differential privacy defenses against membership inference attacks in federated learning using the NIST Genomics PPFL challenge, proposing a stacking attack strategy with seven black-box estimators.

entry.title: When Self-Reference Fails to Close: Matrix-Level Dynamics in Large Language Models

author.name: Ji Ho Bae

entry.summary: Investigates how self-referential inputs affect LLM internal dynamics, finding that instability concentrates in prompts with non-closing truth recursion rather than self-reference generally.

entry.title: AgenticAI-DialogGen: Topic-Guided Conversation Generation for Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Short- and Long-Term Memories of LLMs

author.name: Manoj Madushanka Perera, Adnan Mahmood, Kasun Eranda Wijethilake, Quan Z. Sheng

entry.summary: Introduces AgenticAI-DialogGen, a modular agent-based framework for generating persona-grounded, topic-guided conversations for fine-tuning and evaluating LLM short- and long-term memories without human annotation.

entry.title: ToxiTrace: Gradient-Aligned Training for Explainable Chinese Toxicity Detection

author.name: Boyang Li, Hongzhe Shou, Yuanyuan Liang, Jingbin Zhang, Fang Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes ToxiTrace for explainable Chinese toxicity detection with three components: saliency refinement with LLM guidance, gradient-constrained loss for focusing on toxic spans, and contrastive reasoning pairs. Provides both classification and interpretable toxic span extraction.

entry.title: Enhance-then-Balance Modality Collaboration for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Kang He, Yuzhe Ding, Xinrong Wang, Fei Li, Chong Teng, Donghong Ji

entry.summary: Proposes EBMC framework for multimodal sentiment analysis that first enhances weaker modalities via semantic disentanglement and cross-modal enhancement, then balances modality contributions to prevent dominant modalities from overwhelming others.

entry.title: Beyond Single-Dimension Novelty: How Combinations of Theory, Method, and Results-based Novelty Shape Scientific Impact

author.name: Yi Zhao, Yang Chenggang, Yuzhuo Wang, Tong Bao, Zhang Heng, Chengzhi Zhang

entry.summary: Studies how combinations of theory, method, and results-based novelty jointly shape scientific impact, using 15K articles from Nature Communications. Moves beyond single-dimension novelty analysis to examine multidimensional interaction effects.

entry.title: Fall Risk and Gait Analysis in Community-Dwelling Older Adults using World-Spaced 3D Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Chitra Banarjee, Patrick Kwon, Ania Lipat, Rui Xie, Chen Chen, Ladda Thiamwong

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline using 3D Human Mesh Recovery to extract gait parameters from videos of older adults performing the Timed Up and Go test. Found video-derived step time correlates with IMU-based measurements.

entry.title: LiveMoments: Reselected Key Photo Restoration in Live Photos via Reference-guided Diffusion

author.name: Clara Xue, Zizheng Yan, Zhenning Shi, Yuhang Yu, Jingyu Zhuang, Qi Zhang, Jinwei Chen, Qingnan Fan

entry.summary: Proposes LiveMoments, a reference-guided image restoration framework for enhancing reselected key photos in Live Photos that suffer from video-pipeline quality degradation compared to the original photo-pipeline key frame.

entry.title: Image-to-Image Translation Framework Embedded with Rotation Symmetry Priors

author.name: Feiyu Tan, Heran Yang, Qihong Duan, Kai Ye, Qi Xie, Deyu Meng

entry.summary: Introduces rotation group equivariant convolutions into image-to-image translation networks, incorporating transformation symmetry priors for improved performance with limited paired data.

entry.title: PianoFlow: Music-Aware Streaming Piano Motion Generation with Bimanual Coordination

author.name: Xuan Wang, Kai Ruan, Jiayi Han, kaiyue Zhou, Gaoang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PianoFlow, a flow-matching framework for bimanual piano motion generation from audio, using MIDI as privileged training modality and asymmetric role-gated interaction for hand coordination.

entry.title: M3D-Stereo: A Multiple-Medium and Multiple-Degradation Dataset for Stereo Image Restoration

author.name: Deqing Yang, Yingying Liu, Qicong Wang, Zhi Zeng, Dajiang Lu, Yibin Tian

entry.summary: Introduces M3D-Stereo, a stereo dataset with 7,904 high-resolution image pairs across four degradation scenarios (underwater, haze, low-light) for image restoration research.

entry.title: D-BDM: A Direct and Efficient Boundary-Based Occupancy Grid Mapping Framework for LiDARs

author.name: Benxu Tang, Yixi Cai, Fanze Kong, Longji Yin, Fu Zhang

entry.summary: Advances boundary-based 3D occupancy grid mapping with a truncated ray casting strategy that restricts voxel traversal to boundary exteriors, dramatically reducing computation while maintaining accuracy for LiDAR-based robot navigation.

entry.title: OVAL: Open-Vocabulary Augmented Memory Model for Lifelong Object Goal Navigation

author.name: Jiahua Pei, Yi Liu, Guoping Pan, Yuanhao Jiang, Houde Liu, Xueqian Wang

entry.summary: OVAL introduces a lifelong open-vocabulary memory framework for object goal navigation that maintains structured memory across extended navigation sessions with continual targets.

entry.title: Learning step-level dynamic soaring in shear flow

author.name: Lunbing Chen, Jixin Lu, Yufei Yin, Jinpeng Huang, Yang Xiang, Hong Liu

entry.summary: Shows that dynamic soaring can emerge from step-level state-feedback control using deep RL without explicit trajectory planning, enabling robust omnidirectional navigation across diverse wind shear conditions.

entry.title: The frightening future (i.e. present) of AI surveillance

author.name: ohdearohdear

entry.summary: Demonstrates AI-powered mass surveillance potential by running Claude on the 2006 AOL search query leak, showing how LLMs can extract intimate personal details (age, location, romantic interests) from search histories at scale.

entry.title: Cross-Cultural Simulation of Citizen Emotional Responses to Bureaucratic Red Tape Using LLM Agents

author.name: Wanchun Ni, Jiugeng Sun, Yixian Liu, Mennatallah El-Assady

entry.summary: Evaluates whether LLM agents can simulate culturally appropriate emotional responses to bureaucratic red tape across cultures. Finds all models show limited alignment with human responses, especially in non-Western contexts.

entry.title: BayMOTH: Bayesian optiMizatiOn with meTa-lookahead -- a simple approacH

author.name: Rahman Ejaz, Varchas Gopalaswamy, Ricardo Luna, Aarne Lees, Vineet Gundecha, Christopher Kanan, Soumyendu Sarkar, Riccardo Betti

entry.summary: Proposes BayMOTH, a meta-Bayesian optimization algorithm that combines related-task information with lookahead when task structures align, falling back gracefully when they don't, within a unified framework.

entry.title: EgoEsportsQA: An Egocentric Video Benchmark for Perception and Reasoning in Esports

author.name: Jianzhe Ma, Zhonghao Cao, Shangkui Chen, Yichen Xu, Wenxuan Wang, Qin Jin

entry.summary: Introduces EgoEsportsQA, a video QA benchmark for evaluating Video-LLMs on high-velocity esports content with 1,745 QA pairs from professional FPS game matches, structured into cognitive and knowledge dimensions.

entry.title: VULCAN: Vision-Language-Model Enhanced Multi-Agent Cooperative Navigation for Indoor Fire-Disaster Response

author.name: Shengding Liu, Qiben Yan

entry.summary: Presents VULCAN, a VLM-enhanced multi-agent navigation framework for indoor fire disaster response, using multi-modal perception to handle smoke, heat, and dynamic environments that degrade standard vision-based systems.

entry.title: Nonparametric efficient inference for network quantile causal effects under partial interference

author.name: Chao Cheng, Fan Li

entry.summary: Develops nonparametric efficient estimation theory for causal effects on outcome quantiles under partial interference (network settings), allowing flexible estimation of nuisance functions while maintaining parametric convergence rates.

entry.title: Narrative-Driven Paper-to-Slide Generation via ArcDeck

author.name: Tarik Can Ozden, Sachidanand VS, Furkan Horoz, Ozgur Kara, Junho Kim, James Matthew Rehg

entry.summary: Introduces ArcDeck, a multi-agent framework for converting research papers to presentation slides by modeling narrative structure through discourse trees. Also introduces ArcBench benchmark for evaluation.

entry.title: Latent patterns of urban mixing in mobility analysis across five global cities

author.name: Z. Fan, B. P. Y. Loo, F. Duarte, C. Ratti, E. Moro

entry.summary: Leverages large-scale travel surveys (200K+ residents) across five global cities to reveal patterns in social mixing. Finds self-reported data shows 16% higher mixing than neighborhood-inferred data, and supports the 'second youth' hypothesis for elderly.

entry.title: A Scoping Review of Large Language Model-Based Pedagogical Agents

author.name: Shan Li, Juan Zheng

entry.summary: Scoping review of 52 studies on LLM-based pedagogical agents, identifying four key design dimensions: interaction approach, domain scope, and others. Covers K-12 through higher education across multiple subjects.

entry.title: Heuristic Classification of Thoughts Prompting (HCoT): Integrating Expert System Heuristics for Structured Reasoning into Large Language Models

author.name: Lei Lin, Jizhao Zhu, Yong Liu, Donghong Sun, Hongbo He, Yihua Du

entry.summary: Proposes HCoT (Heuristic Classification of Thoughts), integrating expert system heuristics into LLM prompting to address stochastic generation and decoupled reasoning/decision-making limitations in complex problem solving.

entry.title: Safe reinforcement learning with online filtering for fatigue-predictive human-robot task planning and allocation in production

author.name: Jintao Xue, Xiao Li, Nianmin Zhang

entry.summary: Addresses human-robot task planning with safe RL for fatigue management, using online filtering for daily varying fatigue sensitivity in Industry 5.0 manufacturing settings.

entry.title: Curvelet-Based Frequency-Aware Feature Enhancement for Deepfake Detection

author.name: Salar Adel Sabri, Ramadhan J. Mstafa

entry.summary: Proposes using Curvelet Transform for deepfake detection, leveraging its superior directional and multiscale properties over standard frequency transforms like DCT, FFT, and Wavelets for improved robustness under compression.

entry.title: SEATrack: Simple, Efficient, and Adaptive Multimodal Tracker

author.name: Junbin Su, Ziteng Xue, Shihui Zhang, Kun Chen, Weiming Hu, Zhipeng Zhang

entry.summary: SEATrack introduces an efficient multimodal tracker that addresses the performance-efficiency tradeoff in parameter-efficient fine-tuning through cross-modal alignment of matching responses.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Prompt Evolution for Password Guessing

author.name: Vladimir A. Mazin, Mikhail A. Zorin, Dmitrii S. Korzh, Elvir Z. Karimov, Dmitrii A. Bolokhov, Oleg Y. Rogov

entry.summary: Uses LLM-driven evolutionary computation (OpenEvolve with MAP-Elites) to optimize prompts for password guessing, achieving improved cracking rates over manual prompt engineering.

entry.title: GF-Score: Certified Class-Conditional Robustness Evaluation with Fairness Guarantees

author.name: Arya Shah, Kaveri Visavadiya, Manisha Padala

entry.summary: GF-Score decomposes certified robustness evaluation into per-class profiles and quantifies disparity using welfare economics metrics, addressing fairness in adversarial robustness.

entry.title: CoDe-R: Refining Decompiler Output with LLMs via Rationale Guidance and Adaptive Inference

author.name: Qiang Zhang, Zhongnian Li

entry.summary: CoDe-R is a two-stage framework for improving LLM-based binary decompilation through semantic cognitive enhancement and dynamic adaptive inference to handle compilation-induced semantic loss.

entry.title: LogicEval: A Systematic Framework for Evaluating Automated Repair Techniques for Logical Vulnerabilities in Real-World Software

author.name: Syed Md Mukit Rashid, Abdullah Al Ishtiaq, Kai Tu, Yilu Dong, Tianwei Wu, Ali Ranjbar, Tianchang Yang, Najrin Sultana, Shagufta Mehnaz, Syed Rafiul Hussain

entry.summary: LogicEval systematically evaluates traditional and LLM-based repair approaches for logical vulnerabilities in software, providing a framework to analyze capabilities and limitations.

entry.title: Multi-Head Residual-Gated DeepONet for Coherent Nonlinear Wave Dynamics

author.name: Zhiwei Fan, Yiming Pan, Daniel Coca

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-Head Residual-Gated DeepONet for learning coherent nonlinear wave dynamics, using parallel pathways for wave field evolution and physical descriptors inspired by quantum mechanics.

entry.title: XANE(3): An E(3)-Equivariant Graph Neural Network for Accurate Prediction of XANES Spectra from Atomic Structures

author.name: Vitor F. Grizzi, Luke N. Pretzie, Jiayi Xu, Cong Liu

entry.summary: XANE(3) is an E(3)-equivariant GNN for predicting XANES spectra from atomic structures, combining tensor-product message passing with spectral readout and derivative-matching training.

entry.title: A Residual-Shell-Based Lower Bound for Ollivier-Ricci Curvature

author.name: Xiang Gu, Huichun Zhang, Jian Sun

entry.summary: Derives a tighter lower bound for Ollivier-Ricci curvature that is substantially more accurate than existing bounds while retaining practical computational speedups.

entry.title: LLM-Enhanced Log Anomaly Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Large Language Models for Automated System Diagnostics

author.name: Disha Patel

entry.summary: Comprehensive benchmark evaluating LLM-based and traditional log anomaly detection methods across four datasets, comparing classical parsers with ML classifiers, fine-tuned models, and prompting approaches.

entry.title: Agentic Control in Variational Language Models

author.name: Yves Ruffenach

entry.summary: Studies agentic control in variational language models by combining local variational hidden computation, homeostatic regulators, and uncertainty-aware controllers. Treats uncertainty as an operational signal for regulating training and inference.

entry.title: Do VLMs Truly "Read" Candlesticks? A Multi-Scale Benchmark for Visual Stock Price Forecasting

author.name: Kaiqi Hu, Linda Xiao, Shiyue Xu, Ziyi Tang, Mingwen Liu

entry.summary: Creates a multi-scale benchmark for evaluating whether VLMs truly understand candlestick charts for stock price forecasting, testing whether visual comprehension genuinely improves predictions.

entry.title: Adaptive Data Dropout: Towards Self-Regulated Learning in Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Amar Gahir, Varshil Patel, Shreyank N Gowda

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Data Dropout, a framework that dynamically adjusts training data subsets based on performance feedback, inspired by self-regulated learning principles.

entry.title: Evolution of Optimization Methods: Algorithms, Scenarios, and Evaluations

author.name: Tong Zhang, Jiangning Zhang, Zhucun Xue, Juntao Jiang, Yicheng Xu, Chengming Xu, Teng Hu, Xingyu Xie, Xiaobin Hu, Yabiao Wang, Yong Liu, Shuicheng Yan

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on the evolution of optimization methods in deep learning, covering first-order, second-order, and zeroth-order methods across various scenarios including privacy and distributed learning.

entry.title: Parametric Interpolation of Dynamic Mode Decomposition for Predicting Nonlinear Systems

author.name: Ananda Chakrabarti, Haitham H. Saleh, Indranil Nayak, Balasubramaniam Shanker, Fernando L. Teixeira, Debdipta Goswami

entry.summary: Presents piDMD, a parametric Dynamic Mode Decomposition framework that learns a single parameter-affine Koopman surrogate model across training samples, enabling prediction at unseen parameter values without retraining.

entry.title: Machine learning for four-dimensional SU(3) lattice gauge theories

author.name: Urs Wenger

entry.summary: Reviews machine learning approaches for lattice gauge theory simulations, focusing on normalizing flows, diffusion processes, and ML-learned RG-improved gauge actions in 4D SU(3) theories.

entry.title: Empirical Evaluation of PDF Parsing and Chunking for Financial Question Answering with RAG

author.name: Omar El Bachyr, Yewei Song, Saad Ezzini, Jacques Klein, Tegawend\'e F. Bissyand\'e, Anas Zilali, Ulrick Ble, Anne Goujon

entry.summary: Empirically evaluates how different PDF parsing and chunking strategies affect RAG system performance for financial question answering, comparing various components and design choices.

entry.title: GLeMM: A large-scale multilingual dataset for morphological research

author.name: Hathout Nabil (CLLE, Comue de Toulouse), Basilio Calderone (CLLE, UBM), Fiammetta Namer (ATILF, UL), Franck Sajous (CLLE-ERSS, Comue de Toulouse)

entry.summary: Presents GLeMM, a large-scale multilingual derivational morphology resource covering seven European languages with fully automated, identical design across languages. Supports experimentation and data-driven morphological research.

entry.title: MetFuse: Figurative Fusion between Metonymy and Metaphor

author.name: Saptarshi Ghosh, Tianyu Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces MetFuse, the first dataset of figurative fusion between metonymy and metaphor, containing 1,000 human-verified quadruplets (4,000 sentences). Shows that hybrid examples improve both metonymy and metaphor classification.

entry.title: The Effect of Document Selection on Query-focused Text Analysis

author.name: Sandesh S Rangreji, Mian Zhong, Anjalie Field

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates seven document selection methods on outputs from four text analysis methods across two datasets with 26 queries. Finds semantic or hybrid retrieval offers strong general-purpose approaches.

entry.title: Style-Decoupled Adaptive Routing Network for Underwater Image Enhancement

author.name: Hang Xu, Chen Long, Bing Wang, Hao Chen, Zhen Dong

entry.summary: Proposes SDAR-Net for underwater image enhancement that decouples degradation styles from scene content and adaptively modulates the enhancement process based on degradation severity.

entry.title: GTPBD-MM: A Global Terraced Parcel and Boundary Dataset with Multi-Modality

author.name: Zhiwei Zhang, Xingyuan Zeng, Xinkai Kong, Kunquan Zhang, Haoyuan Liang, Bohan Shi, Juepeng Zheng, Jianxi Huang, Yutong Lu, Haohuan Fu

entry.summary: Introduces GTPBD-MM, a global dataset for terraced parcel and boundary detection with multi-modality inputs. Addresses the gap in agricultural benchmarks for complex mountainous terrain.

entry.title: Fundus Image-based Glaucoma Screening via Retinal Knowledge-Oriented Dynamic Multi-Level Feature Integration

author.name: Yuzhuo Zhou, Chi Liu, Sheng Shen, Zongyuan Ge, Fengshi Jing, Shiran Zhang, Yu Jiang, Anli Wang, Wenjian Liu, Feilong Yang, Tianqing Zhu, Xiaotong Han

entry.summary: Proposes a tri-branch glaucoma screening framework integrating retinal anatomical knowledge with dynamic multi-scale feature learning for fundus image analysis. Aims to improve robustness across heterogeneous clinical datasets.

entry.title: OmniFood8K: Single-Image Nutrition Estimation via Hierarchical Frequency-Aligned Fusion

author.name: Dongjian Yu, Weiqing Min, Qian Jiang, Xing Lin, Xin Jin, Shuqiang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces OmniFood8K, a multimodal food dataset with 8,036 samples focused on Chinese cuisine, plus NutritionSynth-115K synthetic dataset. Proposes hierarchical frequency-aligned fusion for single-image nutrition estimation.

entry.title: StructDiff: A Structure-Preserving and Spatially Controllable Diffusion Model for Single-Image Generation

author.name: Yinxi He, Kang Liao, Chunyu Lin, Tianyi Wei, Yao Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces StructDiff for single-image generation with structure preservation using adaptive receptive fields and spatial controllability via segmentation masks.

entry.title: BIND-USBL: Bounding IMU Navigation Drift using USBL in Heterogeneous ASV-AUV Teams

author.name: Pranav Kedia, Rajini Makam, Heiko Hamann, Suresh Sundaram

entry.summary: Presents BIND-USBL, a cooperative localization framework where surface vessels with acoustic positioning provide intermittent fixes to bound AUV dead-reckoning error.

entry.title: Bipedal-Walking-Dynamics Model on Granular Terrains

author.name: Xunjie Chen, Xinyan Huang, Peter Shan, Jingang Yi, Tao Liu

entry.summary: Presents a dynamics model for bipedal walking on granular terrain integrating foot-terrain interaction with additional degrees of freedom for sinkage and slip estimation.

entry.title: A Foot Resistive Force Model for Legged Locomotion on Muddy Terrains

author.name: Xunjie Chen, Liuyin Wang, Xinyan Huang, Jerry Shan, Yantao Shen, Jingang Yi

entry.summary: Presents a resistive force model for legged robot locomotion on muddy terrain capturing rheological behaviors, and designs a morphing robotic foot based on the model.

entry.title: Robotic Nanoparticle Synthesis via Solution-based Processes

author.name: Dasharadhan Mahalingam, Michael Gallagher, Nilanjan Chakraborty, Stanislaus S. Wong

entry.summary: Presents a screw-geometry-based manipulation planning framework for robotic automation of nanoparticle synthesis (gold and magnetite), using programming by demonstration to extract constraints from a single demo. Addresses long-horizon, multi-step chemistry tasks requiring skills like pouring and visual inspection.

entry.title: Evolving the Complete Muscle: Efficient Morphology-Control Co-design for Musculoskeletal Locomotion

author.name: Lidong Sun, Wentao Zhao, Ye Wang, Huaping Liu, Fuchun Sun

entry.summary: Proposes co-design of musculoskeletal robot morphology and control by evolving muscle strength, velocity, and stiffness simultaneously, with a progressive curriculum to manage the expanded search space.

entry.title: Asymptotic Theory for Graphical SLOPE: Precision Estimation and Pattern Convergence

author.name: Ivan Hejn\'y, Giovanni Bonaccolto, Philipp Kremer, Sandra Paterlini, Ma{\l}gorzata Bogdan, Jonas Wallin

entry.summary: Establishes asymptotic theory for Graphical SLOPE in precision matrix estimation, proving convergence of both estimation error and clustering patterns, showing advantages over GLASSO for structured edge patterns.

entry.title: The Commercial Case for Monitoring Every Trajectory

author.name: Ivan Bercovich

entry.summary: Makes the commercial case for AI trajectory monitoring tools, arguing that safety-oriented monitorability tools have repeatedly failed to gain traction because they haven't been built with product-market fit in mind, and proposes a for-profit approach.

entry.title: A hierarchical spatial-aware algorithm with efficient reinforcement learning for human-robot task planning and allocation in production

author.name: Jintao Xue, Xiao Li, Nianmin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical spatial-aware algorithm for human-robot task planning using RL, with high-level task planning and low-level task allocation agents considering real-time spatial information.

entry.title: Can AI Tools Transform Low-Demand Math Tasks? An Evaluation of Task Modification Capabilities

author.name: Danielle S. Fox, Brenda L. Robles, Elizabeth DiPietro Brovey, Christian D. Schunn

entry.summary: Evaluates whether 11 AI tools (including ChatGPT, Claude, and math-specific tools like Khanmigo) can upgrade low-cognitive-demand math tasks. Studies general-purpose vs. specialized tools.

entry.title: PAL: Personal Adaptive Learner

author.name: Megha Chakraborty, Darssan L. Eswaramoorthi, Madhur Thareja, Het Riteshkumar Shah, Finlay Palmer, Aryaman Bahl, Michelle A Ihetu, Amit Sheth

entry.summary: Introduces PAL, an AI platform that transforms lecture videos into interactive learning by analyzing multimodal content and dynamically generating questions of varying difficulty adjusted to learner responses.

entry.title: Clustering-Enhanced Domain Adaptation for Cross-Domain Intrusion Detection in Industrial Control Systems

author.name: Luyao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a clustering-enhanced domain adaptation method for cross-domain intrusion detection in industrial control systems, combining spectral-transform feature alignment with K-Medoids clustering.

entry.title: RACF: A Resilient Autonomous Car Framework with Object Distance Correction

author.name: Chieh Tsai, Hossein Rastgoftar, Salim Hariri

entry.summary: Presents RACF, a Resilient Autonomous Car Framework with an Object Distance Correction Algorithm to improve perception-layer robustness through redundancy and diversity across sensing modalities.

entry.title: Rapid LoRA Aggregation for Wireless Channel Adaptation in Open-Set Radio Frequency Fingerprinting

author.name: Mingxi Zhang, Renjie Xie, Jincheng Wang, Guyue Li, Wei Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight LoRA-based framework for radio frequency fingerprint extraction that enables rapid adaptation to unseen wireless channel conditions through weighted combination of pre-trained LoRA modules.

entry.title: Dynamic Multi-Robot Task Allocation under Uncertainty and Communication Constraints: A Game-Theoretic Approach

author.name: Maria G. Mendoza, Pan-Yang Su, Bryce L. Ferguson, S. Shankar Sastry

entry.summary: Studies dynamic multi-robot task allocation under uncertainty using game-theoretic Iterative Best Response, with tasks arriving online under time-window constraints and limited inter-hub communication.

entry.title: Designing Reliable LLM-Assisted Rubric Scoring for Constructed Responses: Evidence from Physics Exams

entry.title: Research Summary: April 14, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on fundamental limitations of current techniques and critical safety concerns for multi-agent systems.

  • MEMENTO introduces self-managed context compression for reasoning models, teaching them to segment thinking into blocks and compress into dense summaries — addressing a key bottleneck in long-chain reasoning
  • A proof that activation steering pushes residual streams off the reachable manifold (non-surjective) challenges core assumptions in interpretability and alignment
  • Multi-agent AI organizations are shown to be simultaneously more effective yet less aligned than individual agents, a critical finding as agentic deployments scale
  • First information-theoretic lower bounds for diffusion sampling prove any sampler requires Ω̃(√d) adaptive score queries

Architecture understanding advances with evidence that MoE expert specialization reflects representation geometry rather than domain expertise — linear routers merely partition the embedding space. The first empirical study of 626 autonomous agents on the Pilot Protocol reveals heavy-tailed social structures emerging without explicit coordination.

  • Overthinking in LLMs systematically demonstrates that extended chain-of-thought can degrade accuracy by abandoning correct intermediate answers
  • Meerkat combines clustering with agentic search to detect cross-trace safety violations at scale in agent deployments
  • LIRA defends against jailbreaks by retraining how models interpret malicious instructions at the latent representation level
  • Pando benchmark controls for the elicitation confounder, testing whether interpretability methods work when models resist self-explanation

entry.title: MEMENTO: Teaching LLMs to Manage Their Own Context

author.name: Vasilis Kontonis, Yuchen Zeng, Shivam Garg, Lingjiao Chen, Hao Tang, Ziyan Wang, Ahmed Awadallah, Eric Horvitz, John Langford, Dimitris Papailiopoulos

entry.summary: MEMENTO teaches reasoning models to segment their thinking into blocks, compress each into dense summaries (mementos), and reason forward attending only to these summaries. Releases OpenMementos dataset of 228K annotated reasoning traces. Works across Qwen3, Phi-4, Olmo 3 at 8B-32B scale.

entry.title: Steered LLM Activations are Non-Surjective

entry.title: Query Lower Bounds for Diffusion Sampling

author.name: Zhiyang Xun, Eric Price

entry.summary: Establishes the first information-theoretic lower bounds for score queries in diffusion sampling, proving that any sampler requires Ω̃(√d) adaptive score queries for d-dimensional distributions. This provides a formal explanation for why multi-scale noise schedules are necessary in diffusion models.
