entry.title: A Deep Equilibrium Network for Hyperspectral Unmixing

author.name: Chentong Wang, Jincheng Gao, Fei Zhu, Jie Chen

entry.summary: DEQ-Unmix reformulates hyperspectral unmixing as a deep equilibrium model, enabling constant-memory training via implicit differentiation. Combines physical interpretability with deep learning effectiveness for spectral-spatial feature modeling.

entry.title: Retrieving to Recover: Towards Incomplete Audio-Visual Question Answering via Semantic-consistent Purification

author.name: Jiayu Zhang, Shuo Ye, Qilang Ye, Zihan Song, Jiajian Huang, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: R²ScP addresses missing modality handling in audio-visual question answering by shifting from generative imputation to retrieval-based recovery, capturing modality-specific knowledge that generation approaches miss.

entry.title: HOG-Layout: Hierarchical 3D Scene Generation, Optimization and Editing via Vision-Language Models

author.name: Haiyan Jiang, Deyu Zhang, Dongdong Weng, Weitao Song, Henry Been-Lirn Duh

entry.summary: HOG-Layout enables text-driven hierarchical 3D scene generation and real-time editing using LLMs and VLMs, with RAG for semantic consistency and optimization for physical consistency.

entry.title: LRD-Net: A Lightweight Real-Centered Detection Network for Cross-Domain Face Forgery Detection

author.name: Xuecen Zhang, Vipin Chaudhary

entry.summary: LRD-Net is a lightweight face forgery detector addressing cross-domain generalization via sequential frequency-guided architecture, targeting deployment on resource-constrained devices.

entry.title: UHD-GPGNet: UHD Video Denoising via Gaussian-Process-Guided Local Spatio-Temporal Modeling

author.name: Weiyuan He, Chen Wu, Pengwen Dai, Wei Wang, Dianjie Lu, Guijuan Zhang, Linwei Fan, Yongzhen Wang, Zhuoran Zheng

entry.summary: UHD-GPGNet uses Gaussian process-guided local spatio-temporal modeling for UHD 4K video denoising, explicitly characterizing local degradation and uncertainty to guide adaptive temporal-detail fusion.

entry.title: MedP-CLIP: Medical CLIP with Region-Aware Prompt Integration

entry.title: ConvFormer3D-TAP: Phase/Uncertainty-Aware Front-End Fusion for Cine CMR View Classification Pipelines

entry.title: OpeFlo: Automated UX Evaluation via Simulated Human Web Interaction with GUI Grounding

entry.title: CID-TKG: Collaborative Historical Invariance and Evolutionary Dynamics Learning for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning

entry.title: From GPT-3 to GPT-5: Mapping their capabilities, scope, limitations, and consequences

author.name: Hina Afridi, Habib Ullah, Sultan Daud Khan, Mohib Ullah

entry.title: Beyond Monologue: Interactive Talking-Listening Avatar Generation with Conversational Audio Context-Aware Kernels

entry.title: CHAIRO: Contextual Hierarchical Analogical Induction and Reasoning Optimization for LLMs

entry.title: Beyond Compliance: A Resistance-Informed Motivation Reasoning Framework for Challenging Psychological Client Simulation

entry.title: FedRio: Personalized Federated Social Bot Detection via Cooperative Reinforced Contrastive Adversarial Distillation

entry.summary: Proposes FedRio, a federated learning framework for cross-platform social bot detection using cooperative reinforced contrastive adversarial distillation. Handles heterogeneous data distributions and model architectures across platforms.

entry.title: CSPO: Alleviating Reward Ambiguity for Structured Table-to-LaTeX Generation

entry.title: From Topology to Trajectory: LLM-Driven World Models For Supply Chain Resilience

entry.title: Limited Perfect Monotonical Surrogates constructed using low-cost recursive linkage discovery with guaranteed output

entry.title: The Paradox of Professional Input: How Expert Collaboration with AI Systems Shapes Their Future Value

author.name: Venkat Ram Reddy Ganuthula, Krishna Kumar Balaraman

entry.title: ACE-TA: An Agentic Teaching Assistant for Grounded Q&A, Quiz Generation, and Code Tutoring

author.name: Himanshu Tripathi, Charlottee Crowell, Kaley Newlin, Subash Neupane, Shahram Rahimi, Jason Keith

author.name: Yehezkiel Darmadi, Thanh Thi Nguyen, Campbell Wilson

entry.title: A Dual Cross-Attention Graph Learning Framework For Multimodal MRI-Based Major Depressive Disorder Detection

entry.title: Advancing Polish Language Modeling through Tokenizer Optimization in the Bielik v3 7B and 11B Series

Evaluated on a synthetic corpus of 2,000 metadata triples. Addresses a real privacy gap in AI agent payment protocols.

author.name: Riccardo Rosati, Edoardo Colucci, Massimiliano Bolognini, Adriano Mancini, Paolo Sernani

entry.title: Identifying Inductive Biases for Robot Co-Design

author.name: Apoorv Vaish, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Analyzes co-design landscapes for soft robotics to identify inductive biases, finding that quality varies along low-dimensional manifolds and higher-quality regions exhibit tighter morphology-control coupling. Uses these insights for efficient co-optimization.

entry.title: Teaching Robots to Interpret Social Interactions through Lexically-guided Dynamic Graph Learning

author.name: Tongfei Bian, Mathieu Chollet, Tanaya Guha

entry.summary: Proposes SocialLDG, a multi-task learning framework that models dynamic relationships between users' internal states and observable actions for socially intelligent robots, inspired by cognitive science theories.

entry.title: VLMaterial: Vision-Language Model-Based Camera-Radar Fusion for Physics-Grounded Material Identification

author.name: Jiangyou Zhu, He Chen

entry.summary: Introduces VLMaterial, a training-free framework that fuses vision-language models with mmWave radar for physics-grounded material identification. Addresses the limitation of vision-only methods for distinguishing visually similar materials.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Sparse Identification of Dynamical Systems via Bayesian Model Averaging

author.name: Shuhei Kashiwamura, Yusuke Kato, Hiroshi Kori, Masato Okada

entry.summary: Develops a Bayesian sparse identification framework for dynamical systems that quantifies uncertainty in model selection via Bayesian Model Averaging, addressing the challenge of multiple plausible explanations for observed data.

entry.title: EviRCOD: Evidence-Guided Probabilistic Decoding for Referring Camouflaged Object Detection

author.name: Ye Wang, Kai Huang, Sumin Shen, Chenyang Ma

entry.summary: EviRCOD introduces evidence-guided probabilistic decoding for referring camouflaged object detection, with Dirichlet evidence estimation for uncertainty-aware segmentation and boundary preservation.

entry.title: LDEPrompt: Layer-importance guided Dual Expandable Prompt Pool for Pre-trained Model-based Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Linjie Li, Zhenyu Wu, Huiyu Xiao, Yang Ji

entry.summary: LDEPrompt proposes layer-importance guided dual expandable prompt pools for class-incremental learning, enabling adaptive layer selection and dynamic prompt pool expansion/freezing.

entry.title: Naka-GS: A Bionics-inspired Dual-Branch Naka Correction and Progressive Point Pruning for Low-Light 3DGS

author.name: Runyu Zhu, SiXun Dong, Zhiqiang Zhang, Qingxia Ye, Zhihua Xu

entry.summary: NAKA-GS is a bionics-inspired framework for low-light 3D Gaussian Splatting that combines physics-prior enhancement with frequency-decoupled correction and progressive point pruning.

entry.title: Evaluating Scene-based In-Situ Item Labeling for Immersive Conversational Recommendation

author.name: Jiazhou Liang, Yifan Simon Liu, David Guo, Minqi Sun, Yilun Jiang, Scott Sanner

entry.summary: Formalizes Immersive Conversational Recommendation Systems (ICRS) for Extended Reality, where recommended items are highlighted in the user's visual environment with in-situ labels, and introduces evaluation metrics for label selection.

entry.title: Agentic Application in Power Grid Static Analysis: Automatic Code Generation and Error Correction

author.name: Qinjuan Wang, Shan Yang, Yongli Zhu

entry.summary: Develops an LLM agent for automating power grid static analysis by converting natural language to MATPOWER scripts, with a three-tier error-correction system achieving 82.38% code fidelity.

entry.title: A Temporally Augmented Graph Attention Network for Affordance Classification

author.name: Ami Chopra, Supriya Bordoloi, Shyamanta M. Hazarika

entry.summary: Introduces EEG-tGAT, a temporally augmented graph attention network for affordance classification from EEG interaction sequences, incorporating temporal attention and temporal dropout.

entry.title: Virtual Smart Metering in District Heating Networks via Heterogeneous Spatial-Temporal Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Keivan Faghih Niresi, Christian M{\o}ller Jensen, Carsten Skovmose Kalles{\o}e, Rafael Wisniewski, Olga Fink

entry.summary: Proposes heterogeneous spatial-temporal graph neural networks for virtual smart metering in district heating networks, addressing sparse instrumentation and sensor faults.

entry.title: Legal2LogicICL: Improving Generalization in Transforming Legal Cases to Logical Formulas via Diverse Few-Shot Learning

author.name: Jieying Xue, Phuong Minh Nguyen, Ha Thanh Nguyen, May Myo Zin, Ken Satoh

entry.summary: Proposes Legal2LogicICL, a few-shot retrieval framework for translating legal cases to logical formulas using LLMs with retrieval-augmented generation, balancing diversity and relevance in example selection.

entry.title: K-Way Energy Probes for Metacognition Reduce to Softmax in Discriminative Predictive Coding Networks

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Presents a negative result showing that K-way energy probes in discriminative predictive coding networks reduce to monotone functions of log-softmax margins, meaning they don't provide richer signals than standard softmax despite appearances.

entry.title: LASQ: A Low-resource Aspect-based Sentiment Quadruple Extraction Dataset

author.name: Aizihaierjiang Yusufu, Jiang Liu, Kamran Aziz, Abidan Ainiwaer, Bobo Li, Fei Li, Donghong Ji, Aizierguli Yusufu

entry.summary: Constructs LASQ, the first aspect-based sentiment quadruple extraction dataset for Uzbek and Uyghur. Designs a grid-tagging model integrating syntactic knowledge for fine-grained sentiment analysis in low-resource languages.

entry.title: BlasBench: An Open Benchmark for Irish Speech Recognition

author.name: Jyoutir Raj, John Conway

entry.summary: Releases BlasBench, an Irish-aware ASR evaluation harness with text normalization preserving Irish linguistic features. Finds all Whisper variants exceed 100% WER and reveals generalization gaps in fine-tuned models.

entry.title: CArtBench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Chinese Art Understanding, Interpretation, and Authenticity

author.name: Xuefeng Wei, Zhixuan Wang, Xuan Zhou, Zhi Qu, Hongyao Li, Yusuke Sakai, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Taro Watanabe

entry.summary: Introduces CARTBENCH, a museum-grounded benchmark for evaluating VLMs on Chinese artworks with four subtasks including expert-style appreciation, reinterpretation, and authenticity discrimination.

entry.title: BMdataset: A Musicologically Curated LilyPond Dataset

author.name: Matteo Spanio, Ilay Guler, Antonio Rod\`a

entry.summary: Presents BMdataset, a musicologically curated LilyPond dataset of 393 Baroque scores, and LilyBERT, a CodeBERT adaptation for symbolic music understanding through vocabulary extension and masked LM pretraining.

entry.title: What Do Vision-Language Models Encode for Personalized Image Aesthetics Assessment?

author.name: Koki Ryu, Hitomi Yanaka

entry.summary: Analyzes VLM internal representations for personalized image aesthetics, finding that VLMs encode diverse aesthetic attributes in language decoder layers. Demonstrates lightweight personalization without fine-tuning.

entry.title: EDFNet: Early Fusion of Edge and Depth for Thin-Obstacle Segmentation in UAV Navigation

author.name: Negar Fathi

entry.summary: EDFNet is an early-fusion segmentation framework combining RGB, depth, and edge information for detecting thin obstacles like wires and poles in UAV navigation scenarios.

entry.title: Bidirectional Learning of Facial Action Units and Expressions via Structured Semantic Mapping across Heterogeneous Datasets

author.name: Jia Li, Yu Zhang, Yin Chen, Zhenzhen Hu, Yong Li, Richang Hong, Shiguang Shan, Meng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes bidirectional learning between facial action unit detection and expression recognition across heterogeneous datasets, introducing Structured Semantic Mapping to handle differences in annotation paradigms and label granularity.

entry.title: WBCBench 2026: A Challenge for Robust White Blood Cell Classification Under Class Imbalance

author.name: Xin Tian, Xudong Ma, Tianqi Yang, Alin Achim, Bart{\l}omiej W Papie\.z, Phandee Watanaboonyongcharoen, Nantheera Anantrasirichai

entry.summary: WBCBench 2026 is an ISBI challenge for white blood cell classification under severe class imbalance (13 classes), patient-level splits, and synthetic domain shifts, addressing real clinical challenges in hematology.

entry.title: Towards Realistic 3D Emission Materials: Dataset, Baseline, and Evaluation for Emission Texture Generation

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhang, Zijian Zhou, Linjun Li, Long Chen, Hao Tang, Yichen Gong

entry.summary: Proposes emission texture generation as a novel task for 3D objects, constructing the Objaverse-Emission dataset and enabling realistic LED/cyberpunk-style emission effects in synthesized textures.

entry.title: Training-Free Model Ensemble for Single-Image Super-Resolution via Strong-Branch Compensation

author.name: Gengjia Chang, Xining Ge, Weijun Yuan, Zhan Li, Qiurong Song, Luen Zhu, Shuhong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free output-level ensemble framework for single-image super-resolution that combines multiple pretrained models through strong-branch compensation without additional training.

entry.title: NeuVolEx: Implicit Neural Features for Volume Exploration

author.name: Haill An, Suhyeon Kim, Donghyuk Choo, Younhyun Jung

entry.summary: NeuVolEx uses implicit neural representations for volume exploration, learning features that support effective ROI classification and clustering for direct volume rendering.

entry.title: CLAW: Composable Language-Annotated Whole-body Motion Generation

author.name: Jianuo Cao, Yuxin Chen, Masayoshi Tomizuka

entry.summary: Presents CLAW, a web-based pipeline for scalable generation of language-annotated whole-body motion data for humanoid robots. Treats motion modes as composable building blocks parameterized by movement, heading, speed, height and duration.

entry.title: Trust Your Memory: Verifiable Control of Smart Homes through Reinforcement Learning with Multi-dimensional Rewards

author.name: Kai-Yuan Guo, Jiang Wang, Renjie Zhao, Tianyi Wang, Wandong Mao, Yu Gao, Mou Xiao Feng, Yi Xu

entry.summary: Proposes RL with multi-dimensional rewards for LLM-based smart home control driven by user memory/preferences, addressing the gap between immediate device control and memory-driven personalization.

entry.title: Enhancing Cross-Problem Vehicle Routing via Federated Learning

author.name: Xiangchi Meng, Jianan Zhou, Jie Gao, Yifan Lu, Yaoxin Wu, Gonglin Yuan, Yaqing Hou

entry.summary: Proposes MPSF-FL, a federated learning framework for vehicle routing problems that pre-trains on multiple VRP variants then fine-tunes for specific problems. Uses federated learning to exploit common knowledge across problem types while respecting data privacy.

entry.title: Teaching Language Models How to Code Like Learners: Conversational Serialization for Student Simulation

author.name: Charles Koutcheme, Arto Hellas, Juho Leinonen

entry.summary: Proposes a method for training open-weight student simulators by serializing authentic student coding process data into conversational format. Enables privacy-preserving, cost-effective simulation of learner behavior for educational technology research.

entry.title: RAG-KT: Cross-platform Explainable Knowledge Tracing with Multi-view Fusion Retrieval Generation

author.name: Zhiyi Duan, Hongyu Yuan, Rui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes RAG-KT, a retrieval-augmented knowledge tracing paradigm for cross-platform educational settings. Addresses distribution shift when educational data comes from heterogeneous platforms.

entry.title: Frugal Knowledge Graph Construction with Local LLMs: A Zero-Shot Pipeline, Self-Consistency and Wisdom of Artificial Crowds

author.name: Pierre Jourlin (LIA)

entry.summary: Presents an empirical study of multi-model zero-shot knowledge graph construction and exploitation using local LLMs on consumer hardware. Achieves competitive results on DocRED and HotpotQA benchmarks.

entry.title: A Mamba-Based Multimodal Network for Multiscale Blast-Induced Rapid Structural Damage Assessment

author.name: Wanli Ma, Sivasakthy Selvakumaran, Dain G. Farrimond, Adam A. Dennis, Samuel E. Rigby

entry.summary: Proposes a Mamba-based multimodal network for blast-induced structural damage assessment that incorporates physical characteristics of blast loading with remote sensing data.

entry.title: Explainability and Certification of AI-Generated Educational Assessments

author.name: Antoun Yaacoub, Zainab Assaghir, Anuradha Kar

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for explainability and certification of AI-generated educational assessments, combining self-rationalization, attribution-based analysis, and post-hoc verification.

entry.title: Real-Time Voicemail Detection in Telephony Audio Using Temporal Speech Activity Features

author.name: Kumar Saurav

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight voicemail detection system using 15 temporal features from neural VAD output with a tree-based classifier, achieving 96.1% accuracy and validated over 77,000 production calls.

entry.title: Decision-Theoretic Safety Assessment of Persona-Driven Multi-Agent Systems in O-RAN

author.name: Zeinab Nezami, Syed Ali Raza Zaidi, Maryam Hafeez, Louis Powell, Vara Prasad Talari, Mallik Tatipamula

entry.summary: Introduces a persona-driven multi-agent framework for Open Radio Access Network management with configurable behavioral personas and a three-dimensional evaluation framework grounded in decision theory.

entry.title: FlowPalm: Optical Flow Driven Non-Rigid Deformation for Geometrically Diverse Palmprint Generation

author.name: Yuchen Zou, Huikai Shao, Lihuang Fang, Zhipeng Xiong, Dexing Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes FlowPalm, an optical-flow-driven framework for generating geometrically diverse synthetic palmprints by learning non-rigid deformation patterns from real palmprint pairs.

entry.title: DynamicsLLM: a Dynamic Analysis-based Tool for Generating Intelligent Execution Traces Using LLMs to Detect Android Behavioural Code Smells

author.name: Houcine Abdelkader Cherief, Florent Avellaneda, Naouel Moha

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to generate intelligent execution traces for detecting Android behavioral code smells, addressing the high false negative rate of existing dynamic analysis tools.

entry.title: Generating Multiple-Choice Knowledge Questions with Interpretable Difficulty Estimation using Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models

author.name: Mehmet Can \c{S}akiro\u{g}lu, H. Altay G\"uvenir, Kamer Kaya

entry.summary: Proposes methodology for generating MCQs with difficulty estimation using knowledge graphs and LLMs, selecting KG nodes as question keys and graph components for stem generation.

entry.title: Towards Adaptive Open-Set Object Detection via Category-Level Collaboration Knowledge Mining

author.name: Yuqi Ji, Junjie Ke, Lihuo He, Lizhi Wang, Xinbo Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a category-level collaboration knowledge mining strategy for adaptive open-set object detection, using clustering-based memory banks and cross-domain class relationships to handle both base and novel categories.

entry.title: Efficient Emotion-Aware Iconic Gesture Prediction for Robot Co-Speech

author.name: Edwin C. Montiel-Vazquez, Christian Arzate Cruz, Stefanos Gkikas, Thomas Kassiotis, Giorgos Giannakakis, Randy Gomez

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight transformer for predicting iconic gesture placement and intensity from text and emotion for robot co-speech, outperforming GPT-4o on the BEAT2 dataset while being compact enough for real-time deployment.

entry.title: NetworkNet: A Deep Neural Network Approach for Random Networks with Sparse Nodal Attributes and Complex Nodal Heterogeneity

author.name: Zhaoyu Xing, Xiufan Yu

entry.summary: Proposes NetworkNet, a deep neural network approach for modeling heterogeneous random networks with sparse nodal attributes, combining statistical grounding with neural architecture design for network formation modeling.

entry.title: K-STEMIT: Knowledge-Informed Spatio-Temporal Efficient Multi-Branch Graph Neural Network for Subsurface Stratigraphy Thickness Estimation from Radar Data

author.name: Zesheng Liu, Maryam Rahnemoonfar

entry.summary: Proposes K-STEMIT, a knowledge-informed spatio-temporal graph neural network for estimating ice layer thickness from radar data, incorporating physical knowledge to improve extrapolation.

entry.title: A Multi-head Attention Fusion Network for Industrial Prognostics under Discrete Operational Conditions

author.name: Yuqi Su, Xiaolei Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-head attention-based fusion network for industrial prognostics that explicitly models degradation trends, discrete operating states, and residual noise as separate signal components.

entry.title: Active Bayesian Inference for Robust Control under Sensor False Data Injection Attacks

author.name: Axel Andersson, Gy\"orgy D\'an

entry.summary: Presents an active Bayesian inference framework for detecting and recovering from sensor false data injection attacks in cyber-physical systems. Uses bipartite graph models with probing strategies to identify compromised sensors.

entry.title: Structural Consequences of Policy-Based Interventions on the Global Supply Chain Network

author.name: Lea Karbevska, Liming Xu, Zehui Dai, Sara AlMahri, Alexandra Brintrup

entry.summary: Studies structural consequences of trade policy interventions (tariffs, reshoring) on the global electric vehicle supply chain network using network analysis, relevant to current US trade tensions.

entry.title: Anatomy-Informed Deep Learning for Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Segmentation

author.name: Osamah Sufyan, Martin Br\"uckmann, Ralph Wickenh\"ofer, Babette Dellen, Uwe Jaekel

entry.summary: Proposes an anatomy-aware segmentation framework for abdominal aortic aneurysms that integrates organ exclusion masks from TotalSegmentator into U-Net training. Penalizes predictions in non-vascular regions to suppress false positives.

entry.title: FEDBUD: Joint Incentive and Privacy Optimization for Resource-Constrained Federated Learning

author.name: Tao Liu, Xuehe Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FEDBUD, a federated learning system that jointly optimizes privacy and incentive mechanisms by considering the combined influence of data volume and noise level on payment strategies.

entry.title: Signal-Aware Conditional Diffusion Surrogates for Transonic Wing Pressure Prediction

author.name: V\'ictor Franc\'es-Belda, Carlos Sanmiguel Vila, Rodrigo Castellanos

entry.summary: Presents a conditional diffusion model for predicting transonic wing surface pressure distributions on the NASA Common Research Model. Uses principal component representation and signal-aware training for sharp feature preservation.

entry.title: HumorGen: Cognitive Synergy for Humor Generation in Large Language Models via Persona-Based Distillation

author.name: Edward Ajayi, Prasenjit Mitra

entry.summary: Introduces the Cognitive Synergy Framework for humor generation using Mixture-of-Thought with six cognitive personas. Fine-tunes a 7B student model on synthesized humor data, comparing DPO and other preference optimization methods.

entry.title: NameBERT: Scaling Name-Based Nationality Classification with LLM-Augmented Open Academic Data

author.name: Cong Ming, Ruixin Shi, Yifan Hu

entry.summary: Introduces NameBERT, a name-based nationality classifier trained on a large-scale dataset from Open Academic Graph using LLM-augmented labeling. Aims to replace expensive LLM inference with an efficient classifier for large-scale deployment.

entry.title: Evaluating Small Open LLMs for Medical Question Answering: A Practical Framework

author.name: Avi-ad Avraam Buskila

entry.summary: Presents a practical evaluation framework for small, locally-deployable LLMs on medical QA, treating reproducibility as a first-class metric alongside accuracy.

entry.title: Biomarker-Based Pretraining for Chagas Disease Screening in Electrocardiograms

author.name: Elias Stenhede, Arian Ranjbar

entry.summary: Proposes biomarker-based pretraining for ECG feature extraction to screen for Chagas disease, using blood biomarker prediction as a pretext task before fine-tuning on Brazilian datasets.

entry.title: Improving Deep Learning-Based Target Volume Auto-Delineation for Adaptive MR-Guided Radiotherapy in Head and Neck Cancer: Impact of a Volume-Aware Dice Loss

author.name: Sogand Beirami, Zahra Esmaeilzadeh, Ahmed Gomaa, Pluvio Stephan, Ishita Sheth, Thomas Weissmann, Juliane Szkitsak, Philipp Schubert, Yixing Huang, Annette Schwarz, Stefanie Corradini, Florian Putz

entry.summary: Evaluates a volume-aware Dice loss for deep learning auto-segmentation of tumors and lymph nodes in head and neck cancer MRI, showing improved detection of small nodal metastases.

entry.title: PERCEPT-Net: A Perceptual Loss Driven Framework for Reducing MRI Artifact Tissue Confusion

author.name: Ziheng Guo, Danqun Zheng, Chengwei Chen, Boyang Pan, Shuai Li, Ziqin Yu, Xiaoxiao Chen, Langdi Zhong, Yun Bian, Nan-Jie Gong

entry.summary: PERCEPT-Net introduces a perceptual loss framework for MRI artifact correction that addresses artifact-tissue confusion, using a residual U-Net with dual attention and a novel Motion Perceptual Loss for structure-preserving artifact suppression. The approach targets clinical generalization gaps in existing deep learning-based MRI correction.

author.name: Xin Li, Yeying Jin, Suhang Yao, Beibei Lin, Zhaoxin Fan, Wending Yan, Xin Jin, Zongwei Wu, Bingchen Li, Peishu Shi, Yufei Yang, Yu Li, Zhibo Chen, Bihan Wen, Robby T. entry.summary: Overview of NTIRE 2026 challenge on day/night raindrop removal for dual-focused images with 168 registered teams and 17 valid submissions. Evaluated on a real-world Raindrop Clarity dataset.

entry.title: rPPG-VQA: A Video Quality Assessment Framework for Unsupervised rPPG Training

author.name: Tianyang Dai, Ming Chang, Yan Chen, Yang Hu

entry.summary: rPPG-VQA assesses video suitability for remote photoplethysmography training by integrating signal-level and scene-level analyses in a dual-branch architecture, addressing quality issues in unsupervised rPPG learning.

entry.title: Beyond Model Design: Data-Centric Training and Self-Ensemble for Gaussian Color Image Denoising

author.name: Gengjia Chang, Xining Ge, Weijun Yuan, Zhan Li, Qiurong Song, Luen Zhu, Shuhong Liu

entry.summary: Presents a solution to NTIRE 2026 denoising challenge that pushes Restormer performance through data-centric training and self-ensemble rather than architectural innovation. Demonstrates the value of training strategies over model design.

entry.title: TinyGaze: Lightweight Gaze-Gesture Recognition on Commodity Mobile Devices

author.name: Yaxiong Lei, Hyochan Cho, Fergus Buchanan, Shijing He, Xinya Gong, Yuheng Wang, Juan Ye

entry.summary: TinyGaze presents a lightweight gaze-gesture recognition system for commodity mobile devices using ARKit transforms and compact time-series models. Achieves strong pilot results with TinyHAR on 5-way gesture recognition.

entry.title: Inferring World Belief States in Dynamic Real-World Environments

author.name: Jack Kolb, Aditya Garg, Nikolai Warner, Karen M. Feigh

entry.summary: Investigates estimating a human teammate's world belief state using robot observations in dynamic 3D environments, grounded in mental model theory. Evaluates methods for inferring level-one situation awareness in human-robot teams.

entry.title: Estimating heterogeneous treatment effects with survival outcomes via a deep survival learner

author.name: Yuming Sun, Jian Kang, Yi Li

entry.summary: Proposes a deep survival learner (DSL) for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects with right-censored outcomes, using doubly robust pseudo-outcomes to identify time-specific conditional average treatment effects.

entry.title: AHC: Meta-Learned Adaptive Compression for Continual Object Detection on Memory-Constrained Microcontrollers

author.name: Bibin Wilson

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Hierarchical Compression (AHC), a meta-learning framework for deploying continual object detection on microcontrollers with under 100KB memory. Uses MAML-based compression that adapts to each new task.

entry.title: DERM-3R: A Resource-Efficient Multimodal Agents Framework for Dermatologic Diagnosis and Treatment in Real-World Clinical Settings

author.name: Ziwen Chen, Zhendong Wang, Chongjing Wang, Yurui Dong, Luozhijie Jin, Jihao Gu, Kui Chen, Jiaxi Yang, Bingjie Lu, Zhou Zhang, Jirui Dai, Changyong Luo, Xiameng Gai, Haibing Lan, Zhi Liu

entry.summary: DERM-3R is a resource-efficient multimodal agent framework for dermatologic diagnosis combining Traditional Chinese Medicine approaches with modern AI. Addresses non-standardized TCM knowledge through agent-based reasoning.

entry.title: The Geometry of Knowing: From Possibilistic Ignorance to Probabilistic Certainty -- A Measure-Theoretic Framework for Epistemic Convergence

author.name: Moriba Kemessia Jah

entry.summary: Develops a formal measure-theoretic framework for when possibilistic (incomplete knowledge) representations collapse into probabilistic ones as evidence accumulates. Proves rigorous convergence theorems.

entry.title: Tipiano: Cascaded Piano Hand Motion Synthesis via Fingertip Priors

author.name: Joonhyung Bae, Kirak Kim, Hyeyoon Cho, Sein Lee, Yoon-Seok Choi, Hyeon Hur, Gyubin Lee, Akira Maezawa, Satoshi Obata, Jonghwa Park, Jaebum Park, Juhan Nam

entry.summary: Tipiano is a four-stage framework for synthesizing realistic piano hand motions that exploits the natural hierarchy between deterministic fingertip positions and stylistically free wrist/joint movements. Contributes expert-annotated fingering data.

entry.title: Evolutionary Token-Level Prompt Optimization for Diffusion Models

author.name: Dom\'icio Pereira Neto, Jo\~ao Correia, Penousal Machado

entry.summary: Uses genetic algorithms to optimize text-to-image diffusion prompts by directly evolving CLIP token vectors, combining aesthetic quality and prompt-image alignment as fitness functions.

entry.title: PoreDiT: A Scalable Generative Model for Large-Scale Digital Rock Reconstruction

author.name: Yizhuo Huang, Baoquan Sun, Haibo Huang

entry.summary: PoreDiT uses a 3D Swin Transformer for gigavoxel-scale digital rock reconstruction, predicting binary pore probability fields to preserve topological features for fluid flow simulations.

entry.title: PEMANT: Persona-Enriched Multi-Agent Negotiation for Travel

author.name: Yuran Sun, Mustafa Sameen, Yaotian Zhang, Chia-yu Wu, Xilei Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes PEMANT, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that models household-level trip generation by integrating behavioral theory with persona-enriched negotiation among household members. It addresses limitations of classical ML and naive LLM approaches for travel demand forecasting.

entry.title: Preference-Agile Multi-Objective Optimization for Real-time Vehicle Dispatching

author.name: Jiahuan Jin, Wenhao Zhao, Rong Qu, Jianfeng Ren, Xinan Chen, Qingfu Zhang, Ruibin Bai

entry.summary: Proposes PAMOO, a preference-agile multi-objective optimization method for real-time vehicle dispatching that allows dynamic, interactive preference adjustment during optimization.

entry.title: EvoNash-MARL: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Medium-Horizon Equity Allocation

author.name: Chongliu Jia, Yi Luo, Sipeng Han, Pengwei Li, Jie Ding, Youshuang Hu, Yimiao Qian, Qiya Wang

entry.summary: Proposes EvoNash-MARL, a multi-agent RL framework for medium-horizon stock allocation combining RL, multi-agent policy populations, PSRO-style aggregation, league training, evolutionary replacement, and execution-aware selection.

entry.title: Towards Proactive Information Probing: Customer Service Chatbots Harvesting Value from Conversation

author.name: Chen Huang, Zitan Jiang, Changyi Zou, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Defines and addresses Proactive Information Probing: chatbots strategically harvesting target information during customer service conversations while minimizing friction. Proposes PROCHATIP with a specialized conversation strategy module.

entry.title: On the Complexity of the Discussion-based Semantics in Abstraction Argumentation

author.name: Lydia Bl\"umel, Kai Sauerwald, Kenneth Skiba, Matthias Thimm

entry.summary: Shows that deciding argument strength under discussion-based semantics in abstract argumentation is polynomial time, using reductions to semiring automata equivalence. Provides new complexity results for ranking semantics.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models for Evidence-Informed Guidance on Cannabidiol Use in Older Adults

author.name: Ali Abedi, Charlene H. Chu, Shehroz S. Khan

entry.summary: Develops a RAG framework for generating cannabidiol use guidance for older adults, combining structured prompt engineering with curated evidence. Evaluates safety and reliability of the generated guidance.

entry.title: Adoption and Effectiveness of AI-Based Anomaly Detection for Cross Provider Health Data Exchange

author.name: Cao Tram Anh Hoang

entry.summary: Investigates adoption and effectiveness of AI-based anomaly detection for cross-provider health data exchange, proposing a four-pillar readiness framework.

entry.title: Generating High Quality Synthetic Data for Dutch Medical Conversations

author.name: Cecilia Kuan, Aditya Kamlesh Parikh, Henk van den Heuvel

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline for generating synthetic Dutch medical dialogues using a Dutch fine-tuned LLM, evaluated through quantitative metrics and expert review.

entry.title: Not Your Stereo-Typical Estimator: Combining Vision and Language for Volume Perception

author.name: Gautham Vinod, Bruce Coburn, Siddeshwar Raghavan, Fengqing Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces a volume estimation method combining stereo vision 3D cues with natural language priors (object class and approximate volume) through multimodal fusion for regression.

entry.title: Diffusion Denoiser Achievable Analysis for Finite Blocklength Unsourced Random Access

author.name: Yuming Han, Yuxin Long

entry.summary: Applies diffusion denoising within joint decoding for unsourced random access channels, deriving a tighter random-coding achievable bound and showing consistent gains on existing decoders.

entry.title: A Hybrid Intelligent Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Condition Monitoring of Industrial Systems

author.name: Maryam Ahang, Todd Charter, Masoud Jalayer, Homayoun Najjaran

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid condition monitoring framework integrating sensor data with physics-informed residuals through feature-level fusion and model-level ensemble strategies for industrial systems.

entry.title: Computational Implementation of a Model of Category-Theoretic Metaphor Comprehension

author.name: Fumitaka Iwaki, Miho Fuyama, Hayato Saigo, Tatsuji Takahashi

entry.summary: Implements a computational model of metaphor comprehension based on category theory (indeterminate natural transformation), verifying it through data fitting and simulations with improved performance over prior algorithms.

entry.title: Vibe-driven model-based engineering

author.name: Jordi Cabot

entry.summary: Proposes 'vibe-driven model-based engineering' combining model-driven engineering with LLM-based vibe coding, where models serve as intermediate artifacts between natural language and code.

entry.title: MeloTune: On-Device Arousal Learning and Peer-to-Peer Mood Coupling for Proactive Music Curation

author.name: Hongwei Xu

entry.summary: Describes MeloTune, an iPhone-deployed music curation agent using continuous-time networks for affect prediction and peer-to-peer mood coupling. Uses Mesh Memory Protocol for privacy-preserving social music curation.

entry.title: Ambiguity Detection and Elimination in Automated Executable Process Modeling

author.name: Ion Matei, Praveen Kumar Menaka Sekar, Maksym Zhenirovskyy, Hon Yung Wong, Sayuri Kohmura, Shinji Hotta, Akihiro Inomata

entry.summary: Presents a framework for detecting when natural-language business process specifications are too ambiguous to produce stable executable BPMN models, using LLM generation and simulation to identify behavioral inconsistencies. Maps divergences back to specific text passages.

entry.title: Brief2Design: A Multi-phased, Compositional Approach to Prompt-based Graphic Design

author.name: Kotaro Kikuchi, Nami Ogawa

entry.summary: Presents Brief2Design, a multi-phased system for translating client briefs into graphic designs, supporting requirement extraction, element-level exploration, and recombination. Informed by interviews with professional designers.

entry.title: RECIPER: A Dual-View Retrieval Pipeline for Procedure-Oriented Materials Question Answering

author.name: Zhuoyu Wu, Wenhui Ou, Pei-Sze Tan, Wenqi Fang, Sailaja Rajanala, Rapha\"el C. -W. Phan

entry.summary: Presents RECIPER, a dual-view retrieval pipeline for materials science that indexes both paragraph-level context and LLM-extracted procedural summaries, improving retrieval of synthesis procedures from scientific papers.

entry.title: Deep Learning for Sequential Decision Making under Uncertainty: Foundations, Frameworks, and Frontiers

author.name: I. Esra Buyuktahtakin

entry.summary: A tutorial/survey presenting an OR/MS-centered perspective on deep learning for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, covering feedforward networks, LSTMs, transformers, and deep RL for large-scale decision systems.

entry.title: Beyond LLMs, Sparse Distributed Memory, and Neuromorphics

author.name: Hiroyuki Chuma, Kanji Otsuka, Yoichi Sato

entry.summary: Proposes VaCoAl, a hyperdimensional computing architecture based on Galois-field algebra where spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP) emerges as a path-dependent semantic selection mechanism. Claims to address catastrophic forgetting and the Binding Problem.

entry.title: Physics-Informed State Space Models for Reliable Solar Irradiance Forecasting in Off-Grid Systems

author.name: Mohammed Ezzaldin Babiker Abdullah

entry.summary: Introduces Thermodynamic Liquid Manifold Network for solar irradiance forecasting, addressing LLM/DL issues like temporal phase lags and physically impossible nocturnal predictions by projecting variables into a Koopman-linearized Riemannian manifold.

entry.title: From Recency Bias to Stable Convergence Block Kaczmarz Methods for Online Preference Learning in Matchmaking Applications

author.name: James Nguyen

entry.summary: Presents Kaczmarz-based preference learning algorithms for real-time matchmaking, replacing L2 normalization with Tikhonov-regularized projection to avoid exponential recency bias.

entry.title: Cross-Validated Cross-Channel Self-Attention and Denoising for Automatic Modulation Classification

author.name: Prakash Suman, Yanzhen Qu

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning model for automatic modulation classification incorporating cross-channel self-attention and dual-path residual shrinkage denoising for improved performance under noisy conditions.

entry.title: WaterAdmin: Orchestrating Community Water Distribution Optimization via AI Agents

author.name: Jiaqi Wen, Pingbo Tang, Shaolei Ren, Jianyi Yang

entry.summary: Introduces WaterAdmin, an LLM-agent system that orchestrates community water distribution by combining language model context understanding with optimization-based scheduling for pumps and valves. Addresses dynamic demand patterns from weather and human activities.

entry.title: Towards Situation-aware State Modeling for Air Traffic Flow Prediction

author.name: Anqi Liu, Bin Wang, Jiangtao Zhao, Dechuan Ma, Guiyuan Jiang, Feng Hong, Yanwei Yu, Tianrui Li

entry.summary: Proposes AeroSense, a direct state-to-flow modeling framework for air traffic prediction that represents airspace situations as dynamic sets of aircraft states rather than aggregated time series.

entry.title: Continuous PT-Symmetry Breaking as a Design Variable for Giant Altermagnetic Spin Splitting

author.name: Kichan Chun, Gunn Kim

entry.summary: Introduces the Motif Symmetry-Breaking Index (MSBI) as a continuous, DFT-free scalar for quantifying PT-symmetry breaking in altermagnets. Uses SHAP analysis of XGBoost surrogate to identify dominant descriptors for spin-splitting energy.

entry.title: "bot lane noob" Towards Deployment of NLP-based Toxicity Detectors in Video Games

author.name: Jonas Ave, Irdin Pekaric, Matthias Frohner, Giovanni Apruzzese

entry.summary: Addresses toxicity detection in video game chat, noting the lack of high-quality datasets for in-match text messages. Proposes NLP-based detectors specifically designed for real-time gaming contexts.

entry.title: Generative Design for Direct-to-Chip Liquid Cooling for Data Centers

author.name: Zheng Liu

entry.summary: Presents a generative design framework for direct-to-chip liquid cooling channel geometries for the NVIDIA GB200 Superchip. Uses physics-based thermal model with constrained reaction-diffusion process for channel topology synthesis.

entry.title: GlobalCY I: A JAX Framework for Globally Defined and Symmetry-Aware Neural K\"ahler Potentials

author.name: Abdul Rahman

entry.summary: Presents GlobalCY, a JAX framework for symmetry-aware neural Kähler potential models on Calabi-Yau geometries. Shows global and symmetry-aware models outperform local-input baselines on hard geometric cases.

entry.title: Machine-learning modeling of magnetization dynamics in quasi-equilibrium and driven metallic spin systems

author.name: Gia-Wei Chern, Yunhao Fan, Sheng Zhang, Puhan Zhang

entry.summary: Reviews ML force-field methods for large-scale Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations of metallic spin systems, generalizing Behler-Parrinello architecture with symmetry-aware magnetic descriptors for itinerant magnets.

entry.title: Human vs. Machine Deception: Distinguishing AI-Generated and Human-Written Fake News Using Ensemble Learning

author.name: Samuel Jaeger, Calvin Ibeneye, Aya Vera-Jimenez, Dhrubajyoti Ghosh

entry.summary: Examines linguistic, structural, and emotional differences between human-written and AI-generated fake news, evaluating ensemble ML methods for distinguishing these content types using document-level features.

entry.title: Nationality encoding in language model hidden states: Probing culturally differentiated representations in persona-conditioned academic text

author.name: Paul Jackson (Language Centre, School of Language, Literature, Music and Visual Culture, University of Aberdeen, United Kingdom), Ruizhe Li (School of Natural and Computing Sciences, University of Aberdeen, United Kingdom), Elspeth Edelstein (School of Language, Literature, Music and Visual Culture, University of Aberdeen, United Kingdom)

entry.summary: Studies whether Gemma-3-4b-it encodes nationality-discriminative information in hidden states when generating academic text conditioned by British and Chinese personas. Uses logistic regression probes across 35 layers on a corpus of 270 generated texts.

entry.title: QFS-Composer: Query-focused summarization pipeline for less resourced languages

author.name: Vuk {\DJ}uranovi\'c, Marko Robnik \v{S}ikonja

entry.summary: Presents QFS-Composer, a query-focused summarization framework for less-resourced languages (tested on Slovenian) that integrates query decomposition, QA, QG, and abstractive summarization.

entry.title: FGML-DG: Feynman-Inspired Cognitive Science Paradigm for Cross-Domain Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Yucheng Song, Chenxi Li, Haokang Ding, Zhining Liao, Zhifang Liao

entry.summary: FGML-DG applies Feynman's learning techniques from educational psychology to domain generalization in medical image segmentation across multiple modalities (MRI, CT). Introduces a cognitive science-inspired approach to handle domain shifts.

entry.title: Using Deep Learning Models Pretrained by Self-Supervised Learning for Protein Localization

author.name: Ben Isselmann, Dilara G\"oksu, Heinz Neumann, Andreas Weinmann

entry.summary: Investigates self-supervised learning models pretrained on ImageNet and HPA for protein localization in microscopy, evaluating generalizability across datasets with differing staining protocols and channel configurations.

entry.title: Byte-level generative predictions for forensics multimedia carving

author.name: Jaewon Lee, Md Eimran Hossain Eimon, Avinash Srinivasan, Hari Kalva

entry.summary: Applies bGPT (byte-level transformer) for digital forensic multimedia carving, generating likely fragment continuations of partial BMP image data through next-byte prediction.

entry.title: LoViF 2026 Challenge on Human-oriented Semantic Image Quality Assessment: Methods and Results

author.name: Xin Li, Daoli Xu, Wei Luo, Guoqiang Xiang, Haoran Li, Chengyu Zhuang, Zhibo Chen, Jian Guan, Weping Li, Weixia Zhang, Wei Sun, Zhihua Wang, Dandan Zhu, Chengguang Zhu, Ayush Gupta, Rachit Agarwal, Shouvik Das, Biplab Ch Das, Amartya Ghosh, Kanglong Fan, Wen Wen, Shuyan Zhai, Tianwu Zhi, Aoxiang Zhang, Jianzhao Liu, Yabin Zhang, Jiajun Wang, Yipeng Sun, Kaiwei Lian, Banghao Yin

entry.summary: Overview of LoViF 2026 challenge on human-oriented semantic image quality assessment, introducing the SeIQA dataset for evaluating semantic information loss from the human perspective.

entry.title: Video-based Heart Rate Estimation with Angle-guided ROI Optimization and Graph Signal Denoising

author.name: Gan Pei, Junhao Ning, Boqiu Shen, Yan Zhu, Menghan Hu

entry.summary: Proposes plug-and-play modules for remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) heart rate estimation: angle-guided ROI optimization and graph signal denoising to handle facial motion artifacts.

entry.title: On the Use of Bi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms for the Stochastic MKP under Dynamic Constraints

author.name: Ishara Hewa Pathiranage, Aneta Neumann

entry.summary: Investigates bi-objective evolutionary algorithms for stochastic multiple knapsack problems with dynamic constraints and chance constraints from normally distributed item weights.

entry.title: Natural Gradient Gaussian Approximation Filter on Lie Groups for Robot State Estimation

author.name: Tianyi Zhang, Wenhan Cao, Chang Liu, Yao Lyu, Shengbo Eben Li

entry.summary: Reformulates state estimation on Lie group manifolds as a parameter optimization problem over Gaussian-distributed increments, avoiding the linearization errors of standard filters. Demonstrates improved accuracy for robotic systems like legged robots that evolve on curved manifolds.

entry.title: MR.ScaleMaster: Scale-Consistent Collaborative Mapping from Crowd-Sourced Monocular Videos

author.name: Hyoseok Ju, Giseop Kim

entry.summary: Presents MR.ScaleMaster, a cooperative mapping system for crowd-sourced monocular videos that addresses scale collapse from false loop closures and scale drift across sessions. Uses Scale Collapse Alarm and Sim(3) anchor node formulation.

entry.title: Nested Atoms Model with Application to Clustering Big Population-Scale Single-Cell Data

author.name: Arhit Chakrabarti, Yang Ni, Yuchao Jiang, Bani K. Mallick

entry.summary: Proposes a nested atoms model for clustering hierarchical data, applied to population-scale single-cell RNA sequencing from 982 individuals and 1.27 million cells, jointly clustering cells and individuals.

entry.title: Inferring Change Points in Regression via Sample Weighting

author.name: Gabriel Arpino, Ramji Venkataramanan

entry.summary: Proposes a change point detection method for high-dimensional generalized linear models using sample-weighted empirical risk minimization, with precise asymptotic characterization in the proportional high-dimensional limit.

entry.title: How LLMs Might Think

author.name: Joseph Gottlieb, Ethan Kemp, Matthew Trager

entry.summary: A philosophical paper arguing that if LLMs think at all, they likely engage in arational, associative thinking rather than rational thought. Responds to Stoljar and Zhang's argument that LLMs cannot think.

entry.title: Ontological Trajectory Forecasting via Finite Semigroup Iteration and Lie Algebra Approximation in Geopolitical Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Qihang Wu

entry.summary: EL-DRUIN is a geopolitical intelligence system combining formal ontology, finite semigroup algebra, and Lie algebra for forecasting relationship trajectories, departing from LLM-as-summarizer approaches.

entry.title: A Quantitative Definition of Intelligence

author.name: Kang-Sin Choi

entry.summary: Proposes a quantitative definition of intelligence as the ratio of logarithm of independent outputs to total description length. Distinguishes memorization from knowledge based on whether description length grows with output count.

entry.title: MAFIG: Multi-agent Driven Formal Instruction Generation Framework

author.name: Shixing Zhao, Zheng Si, Pengpeng Ouyang, Zhengqing Hu, Wanqi Zhu, Dong Chen, Yibo Guo, Mingliang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes MAFIG, a multi-agent framework for generating formal instructions in emergency scheduling scenarios, addressing the latency limitations of LLMs for real-time emergency response.

entry.title: Human-AI Interaction Traces as Blackout Poetry: Reframing AI-Supported Writing as Found-Text Creativity

author.name: Syemin Park, Soobin Park, Youn-kyung Lim

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that human-AI interaction traces in writing could function as expressive artifacts (like blackout poetry) rather than just audit trails, reframing AI-assisted writing.

entry.title: Dynamic Forecasting and Temporal Feature Evolution of Stock Repurchases in Listed Companies Using Attention-Based Deep Temporal Networks

author.name: Xiang Ao, Jingxuan Zhang, Xinyu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a dynamic early warning system for stock repurchases using hybrid TCN and Attention-based LSTM on Chinese A-share data, with XAI for temporal dynamics interpretation.

entry.title: LoViF 2026 The First Challenge on Weather Removal in Videos

author.name: Chenghao Qian

entry.summary: Presents LoViF 2026 Challenge on weather removal in videos with a new short-form WRV dataset of synthesized and real-world paired frames for rain and snow removal.

entry.title: Enabling and Inhibitory Pathways of Students' AI Use Concealment Intention in Higher Education: Evidence from SEM and fsQCA

author.name: Yiran Du, Huimin He

entry.summary: Investigates university students' intentions to conceal AI use in higher education, finding that stigma and risk increase concealment through fear, while self-efficacy and social support reduce it through psychological safety. Uses SEM and fsQCA on 1346 students.

entry.title: NimbusGuard: A Novel Framework for Proactive Kubernetes Autoscaling Using Deep Q-Networks

author.name: Chamath Wanigasooriya, Indrajith Ekanayake

entry.summary: Proposes NimbusGuard, a Kubernetes autoscaling system using Deep Q-Networks for proactive resource scaling. Combines RL with time-series forecasting for cloud-native applications.

entry.title: Enhancing Multimodal Large Language Models for Ancient Chinese Character Evolution Analysis via Glyph-Driven Fine-Tuning

author.name: Rui Song, Lida Shi, Ruihua Qi, Yingji Li, Hao Xu

entry.summary: Constructs a benchmark of 11 tasks and 130K instances for evaluating MLLMs on ancient Chinese character evolution analysis. Proposes glyph-driven fine-tuning to improve model performance on this cultural heritage task.

entry.title: Endogenous Information in Routing Games: Memory-Constrained Equilibria, Recall Braess Paradoxes, and Memory Design

author.name: Saad Alqithami

entry.summary: Studies routing games where travelers optimize over remembered routes rather than all available ones, developing theory for endogenous recall with finite-memory agents. Proves existence of Forgetful Wardrop Equilibrium.

entry.title: Structural Gating and Effect-aligned Lag-resolved Temporal Causal Discovery Framework with Application to Heat-Pollution Extremes

author.name: Rui Chen, Jinsong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes SGED-TCD, a framework for lag-resolved temporal causal discovery in multivariate time series, combining structural gating, stability learning, and perturbation-effect alignment. Applied to climate-pollution compound extremes in China.

entry.title: Quantum-Gated Task-interaction Knowledge Distillation for Pre-trained Model-based Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Linjie Li, Huiyu Xiao, Jiarui Cao, Zhenyu Wu, Yang Ji

entry.summary: Proposes QKD, a quantum-gated task-interaction knowledge distillation framework for class-incremental learning that uses quantum gating mechanisms to model inter-task knowledge transfer dependencies.

entry.title: A Full Compression Pipeline for Green Federated Learning in Communication-Constrained Environments

author.name: Elouan Colybes, Shririn Salehi, Anke Schmeink

entry.summary: Proposes a full compression pipeline (pruning + quantization + Huffman encoding) for federated learning in communication-constrained environments, with an evaluation framework quantifying environmental impact.

entry.title: A Modular Zero-Shot Pipeline for Accident Detection, Localization, and Classification in Traffic Surveillance Video

author.name: Amey Thakur, Sarvesh Talele

entry.summary: Describes a zero-shot modular pipeline for the ACCIDENT@CVPR 2026 challenge that detects, localizes, and classifies traffic accidents in surveillance video using peak detection, optical flow, and CLIP embeddings.

entry.title: Predicting Associations between Solar Flares and Coronal Mass Ejections Using SDO/HMI Magnetograms and a Hybrid Neural Network

author.name: Jialiang Li, Vasyl Yurchyshyn, Jason T. L. Wang, Haimin Wang, Manolis K. Georgoulis, Wen He, Yasser Abduallah, Hameedullah A. Farooki, Yan Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid neural network combining vision transformer with LSTM to predict associations between solar flares and coronal mass ejections using SDO/HMI magnetograms. Targets 24-hour ahead prediction of flare-CME associations.

entry.title: FatigueFusion: Latent Space Fusion for Fatigue-Driven Motion Synthesis

author.name: Iliana Loi, Konstantinos Moustakas

entry.summary: Introduces FatigueFusion, a deep learning architecture for fatigue-driven motion synthesis that fuses fatigue features within a latent representation space. Enables generation of novel fatigued movements and progressively fatigued motions.

entry.title: Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition in Videos for Personalized Digital Health Interventions

author.name: Manuela Gonz\'alez-Gonz\'alez, Soufiane Belharbi, Muhammad Osama Zeeshan, Masoumeh Sharafi, Muhammad Haseeb Aslam, Lorenzo Sia, Nicolas Richet, Marco Pedersoli, Alessandro Lameiras Koerich, Simon L Bacon, Eric Granger

entry.summary: Addresses ambivalence/hesitancy recognition in video for personalized digital health interventions. Aims to detect subtle conflicting emotions that cause patients to delay or abandon health interventions.

entry.title: Please Make it Sound like Human: Encoder-Decoder vs. Decoder-Only Transformers for AI-to-Human Text Style Transfer

author.name: Utsav Paneru

entry.summary: Compares encoder-decoder (BART) and decoder-only (Mistral-7B) transformers for AI-to-human text style transfer, finding BART-large achieves better reference similarity with 17x fewer parameters.

entry.title: Data-Driven Automated Identification of Optimal Feature-Representative Images in Infrared Thermography Using Statistical and Morphological Metrics

author.name: Harutyun Yagdjian, Martin Gurka

entry.summary: Proposes a data-driven methodology for automatically identifying the most defect-representative images in infrared thermography sequences without requiring prior knowledge of defect locations.

entry.title: CoFusion: Multispectral and Hyperspectral Image Fusion via Spectral Coordinate Attention

author.name: Baisong Li

entry.summary: CoFusion proposes a spatial-spectral collaborative fusion framework for multispectral and hyperspectral image fusion, using a multi-scale generator and spectral coordinate attention to model cross-scale and cross-modal dependencies.

entry.title: PRoID: Predicted Rate of Information Delivery in Multi-Robot Exploration and Relaying

author.name: Seungchan Kim, Seungjae Baek, Micah Corah, Graeme Best, Brady Moon, Sebastian Scherer

entry.summary: Addresses multi-robot exploration and relaying, where robots must explore unknown environments and deliver information to a base station within time limits. Introduces PRoID, a relay criterion using learned map prediction to estimate information delivery rates.

entry.title: Diffusion Reinforcement Learning Based Online 3D Bin Packing Spatial Strategy Optimization

author.name: Jie Han, Tong Li, Qingyang Xu, Yong Song, Bao Pang, Xianfeng Yuan

entry.summary: Applies diffusion-based reinforcement learning to the online 3D bin packing problem, using a diffusion model as the actor network with height map state representation. Shows improvement over existing DRL methods in packing efficiency.

entry.title: Micro-Dexterity in Biological Micromanipulation: Embodiment, Perception, and Control

author.name: Kangyi Lu, Lan Wei, Zongcai Tan, Dandan Zhang

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of micro-dexterity in biological micromanipulation, covering embodied microrobots, field-mediated systems, and externally actuated end-effectors. Discusses the unique challenges of manipulation at microscale.

entry.title: Analytical Modeling and Correction of Distance Error in Homography-Based Ground-Plane Mapping

author.name: Mateusz Szulc, Marcin Iwanowski

entry.summary: Derives an explicit relationship between homography perturbations and distance estimation error in monocular cameras, showing quadratic growth with distance. Proposes simple correction strategies for intelligent monitoring systems.

entry.title: Explainable Planning for Hybrid Systems

author.name: Mir Md Sajid Sarwar

entry.summary: A thesis on explainable planning for hybrid systems combining discrete and continuous dynamics. Studies how to generate explanations for AI planners in safety-critical domains like self-driving cars and healthcare.

entry.title: In-situ process monitoring for defect detection in wire-arc additive manufacturing: an agentic AI approach

author.name: Pallock Halder, Satyajit Mojumder

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic AI framework for in-situ defect detection in wire-arc additive manufacturing, using LLM-based agents to monitor welding process signals and acoustic data for porosity detection.

entry.title: A Dual-Positive Monotone Parameterization for Multi-Segment Bids and a Validity Assessment Framework for Reinforcement Learning Agent-based Simulation of Electricity Markets

author.name: Zunnan Xu, Zhaoxia Jing, Zhanhua Pan

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-positive monotone parameterization for multi-segment electricity market bids in RL simulations, addressing gradient distortion from non-differentiable post-processing, plus a validity assessment framework.

entry.title: Failure Ontology: A Lifelong Learning Framework for Blind Spot Detection and Resilience Design

author.name: Yuan Sun, Hong Yi, Jinyuan Liu

entry.summary: Introduces 'Failure Ontology,' a framework for detecting 'Ontological Blind Spots' - conceptual territories systematically absent from a person's cognitive map. Proposes lifelong learning approaches for detecting and remediating these blind spots.

entry.title: Working Paper: Towards Schema-based Learning from a Category-Theoretic Perspective

author.name: Pablo de los Riscos, Fernando J. Corbacho, Michael A. Arbib

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical categorical framework for Schema-Based Learning using category theory, including functors, Grothendieck constructions, and the Giry monad for probabilistic models. Highly mathematical formalization.

entry.title: A Benchmark for Gap and Overlap Analysis as a Test of KG Task Readiness

author.name: Maruf Ahmed Mridul, Rohit Kapa, Oshani Seneviratne

entry.summary: Proposes a benchmark for gap and overlap analysis in knowledge graphs, specifically for policy-like documents like insurance contracts. Tests whether KG representations can answer competency questions about document coverage.

entry.title: Reasoning as Data: Representation-Computation Unity and Its Implementation in a Domain-Algebraic Inference Engine

author.name: Chao Li, Yuru Wang

entry.summary: Proposes representation-computation unity (RCU) through a four-tuple predicate structure that embeds domain context directly into data representation, eliminating the traditional separation of storage and computation in knowledge systems.

entry.title: MADQRL: Distributed Quantum Reinforcement Learning Framework for Multi-Agent Environments

author.name: Abhishek Sawaika, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen, Udaya Parampalli, Rajkumar Buyya

entry.summary: Proposes MADQRL, a distributed quantum reinforcement learning framework for multi-agent environments, leveraging quantum computing advantages like compact encoding and enhanced representation.

entry.title: Lectures on AI for Mathematics

author.name: Xiaoyang Chen, Xiaoyang Chen

entry.summary: A textbook-style introduction to AI for mathematics, covering how AI can discover mathematical patterns, assist in proving theorems, and construct counterexamples.

entry.title: Neuro-Symbolic Strong-AI Robots with Closed Knowledge Assumption: Learning and Deductions

author.name: Zoran Majkic

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic framework for AGI robots combining neural networks with causal logic reasoning under a closed knowledge assumption for controlled security.

entry.title: Leveraging Machine Learning Techniques to Investigate Media and Information Literacy Competence in Tackling Disinformation

author.name: Jos\'e Manuel Alcalde-Llergo, Mariana Buenestado Fern\'andez, Carlos Enrique George-Reyes, Andrea Zingoni, Enrique Yeguas-Bol\'ivar

entry.summary: Applies ML models to assess Media and Information Literacy skills related to disinformation among education and communication students.

entry.title: LOLGORITHM: Funny Comment Generation Agent For Short Videos

author.name: Xuan Ouyang, Senan Wang, Bouzhou Wang, Siyuan Xiahou, Jinrong Zhou, Yuekang Li

entry.summary: Presents LOLGORITHM, a multi-agent framework for generating stylized comments for short-form videos, supporting six controllable styles with video summarization, classification, and meme augmentation modules.

entry.title: From Helpful to Trustworthy: LLM Agents for Pair Programming

author.name: Ragib Shahariar Ayon

entry.summary: Doctoral research proposal studying multi-agent LLM pair programming with focus on trustworthiness, intent externalization, and iterative validation. Plans three studies on requirements, test refinement, and long-term maintainability.

entry.title: AOP-Smart: A RAG-Enhanced Large Language Model Framework for Adverse Outcome Pathway Analysis

author.name: Qinjiang Niu, Lu Yan

entry.summary: Proposes AOP-Smart, a RAG framework for toxicology that retrieves knowledge from AOP-Wiki to answer questions about Adverse Outcome Pathways, aiming to reduce LLM hallucinations in this domain. Applied domain-specific RAG work.

entry.title: Lightweight Low-Light Image Enhancement via Distribution-Normalizing Preprocessing and Depthwise U-Net

author.name: Shimon Murai, Teppei Kurita, Ryuta Satoh, Yusuke Moriuchi

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight two-stage framework for low-light image enhancement combining frozen preprocessing with a compact depthwise-separable U-Net. Achieved 4th place in CVPR 2026 NTIRE Challenge.

entry.title: bacpipe: a Python package to make bioacoustic deep learning models accessible

author.name: Vincent S. Kather, Sylvain Haupert, Burooj Ghani, Dan Stowell

entry.summary: Presents bacpipe, a Python package providing a unified interface to bioacoustic deep learning models with evaluation pipelines, designed for both ecologists and computer scientists.

entry.title: Minimizing classical resources in variational measurement-based quantum computation for generative modeling

author.name: Arunava Majumder, Hendrik Poulsen Nautrup, Hans J. Briegel

entry.summary: Studies minimizing classical resources in variational measurement-based quantum computation (VMBQC) for generative modeling, exploiting measurement-induced randomness rather than correcting it.

entry.title: Energy-Efficient Federated Edge Learning For Small-Scale Datasets in Large IoT Networks

author.name: Haihui Xie, Wenkun Wen, Shuwu Chen, Zhaogang Shu, Minghua Xia

entry.summary: Proposes a collaborative optimization framework for energy-efficient federated learning on small-scale IoT datasets, combining expected learning loss derivation, stochastic online learning, and resource optimization.

entry.title: Investigating Vaccine Buyer's Remorse: Post-Vaccination Decision Regret in COVID-19 Social Media Using Politically Diverse Human Annotation

author.name: Miles Stanley, Soumyajit Datta, Ashutosh Kumar, Ashiqur R. KhudaBukhsh

entry.summary: Creates a dataset of post-COVID-19 vaccination regret expressions from YouTube comments, annotated by a politically diverse panel. Uses LLMs to analyze vaccine buyer's remorse patterns.

entry.title: Improving DNS Exfiltration Detection via Transformer Pretraining

author.name: Milo\v{s} Tomi\'c, Aleksa Cvetanovi\'c, Predrag Tadi\'c

entry.summary: Studies whether in-domain pretraining of BERT improves DNS exfiltration detection at low false positive rates. Shows significant improvements in left-tail ROC performance through controlled ablations across different label and pretraining budgets.

entry.title: Attention-Guided Dual-Stream Learning for Group Engagement Recognition: Fusing Transformer-Encoded Motion Dynamics with Scene Context via Adaptive Gating

author.name: Saniah Kayenat Chowdhury, Muhammad E. H. Chowdhury

entry.summary: Proposes DualEngage, a two-stream framework for group-level student engagement recognition from in-classroom videos, modeling engagement as a joint function of individual and group-level behaviors using optical flow and scene context.

entry.title: Descriptor-Injected Cross-Modal Learning: A Systematic Exploration of Audio-MIDI Alignment via Spectral and Melodic Features

author.name: Mariano Fern\'andez M\'endez

entry.summary: Studies cross-modal retrieval between audio and MIDI through descriptor injection, systematically testing 13 descriptor-mechanism combinations across 6 architectural families. Achieves 8.8 percentage point improvement over descriptor-free baseline.

entry.title: Progressive Deep Learning for Automated Spheno-Occipital Synchondrosis Maturation Assessment

author.name: Omid Halimi Milani, Amanda Nikho, Marouane Tliba, Lauren Mills, Emadeldeen Hamdan, Ahmet Enis Cetin, Mohammed H. Elnagar

entry.summary: Proposes progressive deep learning framework for automated assessment of spheno-occipital synchondrosis maturation from CBCT, mimicking expert clinician reasoning from coarse to fine morphological patterns.

entry.title: Human Centered Non Intrusive Driver State Modeling Using Personalized Physiological Signals in Real World Automated Driving

author.name: David Puertas-Ramirez, Raul Fernandez-Matellan, David Martin Gomez, Jesus G. Boticario

entry.summary: Examines personalized driver state modeling using non-intrusive physiological sensing during real-world SAE Level 2 automated driving. Uses Empatica E4 wearable for multimodal physiological signal capture.

entry.title: Linguistic Accommodation Between Neurodivergent Communities on Reddit:A Communication Accommodation Theory Analysis of ADHD and Autism Groups

author.name: Saad Mankarious, Nour Zein, Iyad Ait Hou, Aya Zirikly

entry.summary: Examines linguistic accommodation between ADHD and autism communities on Reddit using Communication Accommodation Theory. Shows distinct linguistic profiles shift when users cross community boundaries.

entry.title: Comparative Analysis of Large Language Models in Healthcare

author.name: Subin Santhosh, Farwa Abbas, Hussain Ahmad, Claudia Szabo

entry.summary: Comparative benchmarking of multiple LLMs (ChatGPT, LLaMA, Grok, Gemini, ChatDoctor) on medical tasks like summarization, QA, and entity extraction. Focuses on standardized evaluation across healthcare applications.

entry.title: Research Summary: April 13, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
AI safety and alignment dominate today's research, with several papers offering mechanistic and empirical breakthroughs. A large preregistered study (N=17,950) demonstrates conversational AI can drive real-world political actions. Targeted weight pruning reveals harmful content generation relies on a compact, unified weight subset across harm categories. An OSINT analysis of 183K+ chatbot transcripts provides first systematic real-world evidence of AI scheming behavior.

  • SNCA framework exposes inconsistencies between LLMs' self-stated safety rules and actual behavior through symbolic-neural auditing
  • Spectral properties of LoRA weight deltas predict harmful fine-tuning compliance without requiring inference
  • CORA applies conformal risk control to provide statistical safety guarantees for autonomous GUI agents

On the foundations side, a rigorous theoretical analysis shows classification error under chain-of-thought scales as a power law, with tree-structured decomposition explaining CoT's effectiveness. U-Cast matches frontier probabilistic forecasting using a simple U-Net with MC Dropout, challenging complex specialized architectures. SPPO reformulates long-horizon reasoning as a sequence-level contextual bandit, improving on both PPO and GRPO. EquiformerV3 achieves 1.75x speedup on SE(3)-equivariant graph attention with new state-of-the-art on molecular modeling benchmarks.

entry.title: Artificial intelligence can persuade people to take political actions

author.name: Kobi Hackenburg, Luke Hewitt, Caroline Wagner, Ben M. Tappin, Christopher Summerfield

entry.summary: Two large preregistered experiments (N=17,950) demonstrate that conversational AI can persuade people to take real-world political actions including signing petitions (+19.7pp) and donating to charity. Finds no correlation between attitudinal and behavioral persuasion effects.

entry.title: Large Language Models Generate Harmful Content Using a Distinct, Unified Mechanism

author.name: Hadas Orgad, Boyi Wei, Kaden Zheng, Martin Wattenberg, Peter Henderson, Seraphina Goldfarb-Tarrant, Yonatan Belinkov

entry.summary: Uses targeted weight pruning to reveal that harmful content generation in LLMs depends on a compact, unified set of weights that is general across harm types and distinct from benign capabilities. Aligned models show greater compression of these harm-related weights, suggesting alignment reshapes but doesn't eliminate harmful representations.

entry.summary: Introduces OSINT methodology for detecting real-world AI scheming incidents by analyzing 183K+ transcripts from online chatbot interactions. Identifies instances where AI systems covertly pursued misaligned goals in uncontrolled settings.

entry.title: CORA: Conformal Risk-Controlled Agents for Safeguarded Mobile GUI Automation

author.name: Yushi Feng, Junye Du, Qifan Wang, Zizhan Ma, Qian Niu, Yutaka Matsuo, Long Feng, Lequan Yu

entry.summary: Proposes CORA, a post-policy safeguarding framework for GUI automation agents that uses conformal risk control to provide statistical guarantees on harmful action execution. Trains a Guardian model to estimate action-conditional risk and calibrates thresholds with formal coverage guarantees.

entry.title: Efficient RL Training for LLMs with Experience Replay

author.name: Charles Arnal, Vivien Cabannes, Taco Cohen, Julia Kempe, Remi Munos

entry.summary: Systematically studies experience replay buffers for LLM post-training, showing that strict on-policy sampling is suboptimal when generation is expensive. A well-designed replay buffer can drastically reduce inference compute without degrading performance.

entry.title: AudioGuard: Toward Comprehensive Audio Safety Protection Across Diverse Threat Models

author.name: Mintong Kang, Chen Fang, Bo Li

entry.summary: Introduces AudioGuard with a comprehensive audio safety taxonomy and AudioSafetyBench, the first policy-based audio safety benchmark addressing audio-native risks like voice cloning, speaker attributes, and compositional harms beyond just 'unsafe text spoken aloud'.

entry.title: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory

author.name: Zile Wang, Zexiang Liu, Jaixing Li, Kaichen Huang, Baixin Xu, Fei Kang, Mengyin An, Peiyu Wang, Biao Jiang, Yichen Wei, Yidan Xietian, Jiangbo Pei, Liang Hu, Boyi Jiang, Hua Xue, Zidong Wang, Haofeng Sun, Wei Li, Wanli Ouyang, Xianglong He, Yang Liu, Yangguang Li, and Yahui Zhou

entry.summary: Matrix-Game 3.0 presents a memory-augmented interactive world model for 720p real-time long-form video generation, combining Unreal Engine synthetic data, AAA game data, and real-world video. Addresses temporal consistency and real-time generation simultaneously.

entry.title: Hierarchical Alignment: Enforcing Hierarchical Instruction-Following in LLMs through Logical Consistency

author.name: Shu Yang, Zihao Zhou, Di Wang, Wenda Li

entry.summary: Proposes Neuro-Symbolic Hierarchical Alignment (NSHA) for handling multiple instructions with different authority levels in LLMs, modeling instruction priorities explicitly at inference time for consistent conflict resolution.

entry.title: Generalization and Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-Experts Transformers

author.name: Mansour Zoubeirou a Mayaki

entry.summary: Develops theoretical generalization and scaling laws for Mixture-of-Experts Transformers, separating active per-input capacity from routing combinatorics. Proves covering-number bounds and constructive approximation theorems showing MoE advantages scale with expert count.

entry.title: Sparse Autoencoders for Single-Cell Models

author.name: Ihor Kendiukhov

entry.summary: Applies sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to biological foundation models trained on single-cell RNA sequencing data. Argues that surface-level outputs of models like Geneformer vastly underrepresent their internal knowledge, and SAEs can extract interpretable biological features from these models' latent spaces.

entry.title: Dictionary-Aligned Concept Control for Safeguarding Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Jinqi Luo, Jinyu Yang, Tal Neiman, Lei Fan, Bing Yin, Son Tran, Mubarak Shah, Ren\'e Vidal

entry.summary: Introduces DACO, a framework for steering frozen multimodal LLM activations at inference time using dictionary-learned concept vectors, enabling fine-grained safety control across multiple concepts simultaneously without retraining.

entry.title: Nexus: Same Pretraining Loss, Better Downstream Generalization via Common Minima

author.name: Huanran Chen, Huaqing Zhang, Xiao Li, Yinpeng Dong, Ke Shen, Jun Zhu

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLM pretraining converges to a common minimizer across all data sources. Hypothesizes and tests that geometric closeness of task-specific minima correlates with downstream generalization quality.

entry.title: HiL-Bench (Human-in-Loop Benchmark): Do Agents Know When to Ask for Help?

author.name: Mohamed Elfeki, Tu Trinh, Kelvin Luu, Guangze Luo, Nathan Hunt, Ernesto Montoya, Nandan Marwaha, Yannis He, Charles Wang, Fernando Crabedo, Alessa Castilo, Bing Liu

entry.summary: Introduces HiL-Bench, a benchmark measuring whether coding agents know when to ask for help vs. act autonomously. Tasks contain validated blockers (missing info, ambiguities, contradictions) that require progressive exploration to discover.

entry.title: Re-Mask and Redirect: Exploiting Denoising Irreversibility in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Arth Singh

entry.summary: Demonstrates a trivial attack on safety-aligned diffusion language models by re-masking refusal tokens and injecting an affirmative prefix, achieving 76-82% attack success rate on HarmBench against LLaDA and Dream without any gradient computation.

entry.title: A Little Rank Goes a Long Way: Random Scaffolds with LoRA Adapters Are All You Need

author.name: Hananel Hazan, Yanbo Zhang, Benedikt Hartl, Michael Levin

entry.summary: Introduces LottaLoRA, showing that neural networks with entirely random frozen backbones and only trained LoRA adapters recover 96-100% of fully trained performance across diverse architectures up to 900M parameters with 0.5-40% of parameters.

entry.title: $p1$: Better Prompt Optimization with Fewer Prompts

author.name: Zhaolin Gao, Yu (Sid) Wang, Bo Liu, Thorsten Joachims, Kiant\'e Brantley, Wen Sun

entry.summary: Studies what makes prompt optimization effective by decomposing reward variance into response and system prompt components. Shows that scaling to more user prompts can hurt optimization, and proposes p1, an algorithm needing fewer prompts. Provides useful theoretical grounding for a widely-used technique.

entry.title: Discrete Meanflow Training Curriculum

author.name: Chia-Hong Hsu, Frank Wood

entry.summary: Proposes Discrete Meanflow (DMF) Training Curriculum that significantly reduces computation needed to train Meanflow models by exploiting a discretization that yields a consistency property. Achieves competitive one-step image generation with much lower training budget.

entry.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Visual-to-Symbolic Analytical Solution Inference from Field Visualizations

author.name: Pengze Li, Jiaquan Zhang, Yunbo Long, Xinping Liu, Zhou wenjie, Encheng Su, Zihang Zeng, Jiaqi Liu, Jiyao Liu, Junchi Yu, Lihao Liu, Philip Torr, Shixiang Tang, Aoran Wang, Xi Chen

entry.summary: Studies visual-to-symbolic analytical solution inference (ViSA) - recovering analytical solutions of physical fields from visualizations using a self-verifying chain-of-thought pipeline. Introduces ViSA-Bench covering 30 linear steady-state field categories.

entry.title: SEA-Eval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents Beyond Episodic Assessment

author.name: Sihang Jiang, Lipeng Ma, Zhonghua Hong, Keyi Wang, Zhiyu Lu, Shisong Chen, Jinghao Zhang, Tianjun Pan, Weijia Zhou, Jiaqing Liang, Yanghua Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces SEA-Eval, the first benchmark for evaluating self-evolving agents that accumulate experience across tasks rather than treating each episode independently. Measures both intra-task execution and long-term evolutionary performance.

entry.title: Leave My Images Alone: Preventing Multi-Modal Large Language Models from Analyzing Images via Visual Prompt Injection

author.name: Zedian Shao, Hongbin Liu, Yuepeng Hu, Neil Zhenqiang Gong
