entry.summary: ImageProtector embeds imperceptible perturbations in images that act as visual prompt injection attacks on MLLMs, causing them to generate refusal responses. Protects personal images from being analyzed by open-weight MLLMs.

entry.title: Advantage-Guided Diffusion for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Daniele Foffano, Arvid Eriksson, David Broman, Karl H. Johansson, Alexandre Proutiere

entry.summary: AGD-MBRL steers diffusion world model trajectory generation using advantage estimates, concentrating sampling on high-return trajectories. Proves theoretical guarantees for both Sigmoid and Exponential advantage guidance variants.

entry.title: TensorHub: Scalable and Elastic Weight Transfer for LLM RL Training

author.name: Chenhao Ye, Huaizheng Zhang, Mingcong Han, Baoquan Zhong, Xiang Li, Qixiang Chen, Xinyi Zhang, Weidong Zhang, Kaihua Jiang, Wang Zhang, He Sun, Wencong Xiao, Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau, Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau

entry.summary: TensorHub introduces Reference-Oriented Storage (ROS) for efficient weight transfer in LLM RL training, exploiting replicated weights across workers to avoid physical copying. Achieves significant speedups for heterogeneous scaling.

entry.title: Think Less, Know More: State-Aware Reasoning Compression with Knowledge Guidance for Efficient Reasoning

author.name: Yi Sui, Chaozhuo Li, Dawei Song

entry.summary: Proposes STACK, a framework for compressing Chain-of-Thought reasoning in large reasoning models by modeling stage-specific redundancy and integrating retrieval-augmented guidance. Dynamically switches between knowledge-guided compression and self-prompted compression based on reasoning state.

entry.title: Arbitration Failure, Not Perceptual Blindness: How Vision-Language Models Resolve Visual-Linguistic Conflicts

author.name: Farhad Nooralahzadeh, Omid Rohanian, Yi Zhang, Jonathan F\"urst, Kurt Stockinger

entry.summary: Investigates why VLMs fail on visual-linguistic conflicts (e.g., answering 'yellow' for a blue banana). Discovers an 'Encoding-Grounding Dissociation': models encode visual evidence correctly in early layers but fail at arbitration between visual and prior signals in later layers.

entry.title: SUPERNOVA: Eliciting General Reasoning in LLMs with Reinforcement Learning on Natural Instructions

author.name: Ashima Suvarna, Kendrick Phan, Mehrab Beikzadeh, Hritik Bansal, Saadia Gabriel

entry.summary: Proposes SUPERNOVA, a data curation framework for extending RLVR to general reasoning by systematically adapting instruction-tuning datasets with expert-annotated ground-truth for RL training. Conducts 100+ experiments to study effective data curation.

entry.title: Semantic Intent Fragmentation: A Single-Shot Compositional Attack on Multi-Agent AI Pipelines

author.name: Tanzim Ahad, Ismail Hossain, Md Jahangir Alam, Sai Puppala, Yoonpyo Lee, Syed Bahauddin Alam and Sajedul Talukder

entry.summary: Introduces Semantic Intent Fragmentation (SIF), an attack where a single legitimate request causes an LLM orchestrator to decompose tasks into individually benign but jointly harmful subtasks. Achieves policy violations without injected content or system modification.

entry.title: Post-Hoc Guidance for Consistency Models by Joint Flow Distribution Learning

author.name: Chia-Hong Hsu, Randall Balestriero

entry.summary: Proposes Joint Flow Distribution Learning (JFDL) to enable classifier-free guidance in pre-trained Consistency Models without requiring distillation from a separate diffusion model teacher, enabling practical few-step guided generation.

entry.title: Precise Shield: Explaining and Aligning VLLM Safety via Neuron-Level Guidance

author.name: Enyi Shi, Fei Shen, Shuyi Miao, Linxia Zhu, Pengyang Shao, Jinhui Tang, and Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Proposes Precise Shield, identifying safety neurons in VLLMs through activation contrasting to address multilingual and multimodal composite attacks. Shows safety capability is localized in specific neurons that can be targeted for defense.

entry.title: Aligned Agents, Biased Swarm: Measuring Bias Amplification in Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Keyu Li, Jin Gao, Dequan Wang

entry.summary: Empirically studies how multi-agent system topologies amplify bias, finding that structured workflows act as echo chambers that amplify minor stochastic biases into systemic polarization, contradicting assumptions about collaborative dilution.

entry.title: Watt Counts: Energy-Aware Benchmark for Sustainable LLM Inference on Heterogeneous GPU Architectures

author.name: Mauricio Fadel Argerich, Jonathan F\"urst and Marta Pati\~no-Mart\'inez

entry.summary: Watt Counts provides the largest open-access dataset of LLM energy consumption (5,000+ experiments, 50 LLMs, 10 GPUs) with a reproducible benchmark. Shows GPU selection is crucial for energy efficiency with up to order-of-magnitude differences.

entry.title: Identifying Causal Effects Using a Single Proxy Variable

author.name: Silvan Vollmer, Niklas Pfister and Sebastian Weichwald

entry.summary: SPICE extends proxy-based causal identification to higher dimensions with more flexible functional relationships using a single proxy variable. Develops SPICE-Net neural estimation framework with theoretical identifiability guarantees.

entry.title: PhysInOne: Visual Physics Learning and Reasoning in One Suite

author.name: Siyuan Zhou, Hejun Wang, Hu Cheng, Jinxi Li, Dongsheng Wang, Junwei Jiang, Yixiao Jin, Jiayue Huang, Shiwei Mao, Shangjia Liu, Yafei Yang, Hongkang Song, Shenxing Wei, Zihui Zhang, Peng Huang, Shijie Liu, Zhengli Hao, Hao Li, Yitian Li, Wenqi Zhou, Zhihan Zhao, Zongqi He, Hongtao Wen, Shouwang Huang, Peng Yun, Bowen Cheng, Pok Kazaf Fu, Wai Kit Lai, Jiahao Chen, Kaiyuan Wang, Zhixuan Sun, Ziqi Li, Haochen Hu, Di Zhang, Chun Ho Yuen, Bing Wang, Zhihua Wang, Chuhang Zou, Bo Yang

entry.summary: Presents PhysInOne, a massive synthetic dataset of 2 million videos across 153,810 3D scenes covering 71 physical phenomena with comprehensive annotations. Demonstrates utility across physics-aware video generation, prediction, and property estimation.

entry.title: Do Vision Language Models Need to Process Image Tokens?

author.name: Sambit Ghosh, R. Venkatesh Babu, Chirag Agarwal

entry.summary: Systematically investigates the role of image tokens in VLMs, finding that visual representations rapidly converge (entropy stabilizes, dimensionality compresses) while text representations continue evolving. Suggests image tokens may be prunable in later layers.

entry.title: Drift and selection in LLM text ecosystems

author.name: S{\o}ren Riis

entry.summary: Develops a mathematical framework for understanding how LLM-generated text entering the public record creates recursive feedback loops. Separates 'drift' (removal of rare forms through reuse) and 'selection' (publication filtering) forces, with exact solutions in the infinite-corpus limit.

entry.title: Decomposing the Delta: What Do Models Actually Learn from Preference Pairs?

author.name: Chia-Hsuan Lee, Mingyang Zhou, Renkun Ni, Zelei Cheng, Sihui Dai, Supriyo Chakraborty, Shixiong Zhang, Sambit Sahu, and William Campbell

entry.summary: Investigates what properties of preference data drive reasoning improvements in DPO/KTO, examining generator-level delta (model capability differences) and sample-level delta (quality differences within pairs). Finds generator-level delta matters more.

entry.title: Loom: A Scalable Analytical Neural Computer Architecture

author.name: Mehmet Kerem Turkcan

entry.summary: Presents Loom, a transformer architecture that executes C programs compiled to a 22-opcode instruction set, with analytically derived weights. Each forward pass executes one instruction, with the full machine state in a single tensor.

entry.title: Revisiting the Capacity Gap in Chain-of-Thought Distillation from a Practical Perspective

author.name: Tokio Kajitsuka, Ukyo Honda, Sho Takase

entry.summary: Revisits chain-of-thought distillation capacity gap, finding that CoT distillation often degrades performance vs pre-distillation baseline - an issue obscured in prior work. Proposes more realistic evaluation protocol.

entry.title: Bridging SFT and RL: Dynamic Policy Optimization for Robust Reasoning

author.name: Taojie Zhu, Dongyang Xu, Ding Zou, Sen Zhao, Qiaobo Hao, Zhiguo Yang, Yonghong He

entry.summary: Proposes DYPO (Dynamic Policy Optimization) that bridges SFT and RL through rigorous bias-variance analysis, integrating Group Alignment Loss, Dual Critic Assessment, and Dynamic Transition Strategy for LLM post-training.

entry.title: Confident in a Confidence Score: Investigating the Sensitivity of Confidence Scores to Supervised Fine-Tuning

author.name: Lorenzo Jaime Yu Flores, Cesare Spinoso di-Piano, Jackie Chi Kit Cheung

entry.summary: Investigates how supervised fine-tuning degrades the correlation between confidence scores and output quality in LLMs. Finds that post-SFT confidence changes can be driven by training distribution similarity rather than actual quality differences.

entry.title: AssemLM: Spatial Reasoning Multimodal Large Language Models for Robotic Assembly

author.name: Zhi Jing, Jinbin Qiao, Ouyang Lu, Jicong Ao, Shuang Qiu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Chenjia Bai

entry.summary: AssemLM integrates assembly manuals, point clouds, and text to predict 6D assembly poses for robotic assembly, enabling explicit geometric understanding. Bridges raw 3D perception with high-level reasoning for fine-grained manipulation.

entry.title: Learning Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Guoqing Wang, Pin Tang, Xiangxuan Ren, Guodongfang Zhao, Bailan Feng, Chao Ma

entry.summary: VLA-World unifies predictive imagination with reflective reasoning for autonomous driving, generating future frames from trajectory guidance and then reasoning about the imagined futures to improve driving decisions.

entry.title: DeepGuard: Secure Code Generation via Multi-Layer Semantic Aggregation

author.name: Li Huang, Zhongxin Liu, Yifan Wu, Tao Yin, Dong Li, Jichao Bi, Nankun Mu, Hongyu Zhang, Meng Yan

entry.summary: DeepGuard aggregates security-relevant signals from multiple transformer layers for secure code generation, addressing the 'final-layer bottleneck' where vulnerability cues attenuate near the output.

entry.title: CLIP-Inspector: Model-Level Backdoor Detection for Prompt-Tuned CLIP via OOD Trigger Inversion

author.name: Akshit Jindal, Saket Anand, Chetan Arora, Vikram Goyal

entry.summary: CLIP-Inspector detects backdoors in prompt-tuned CLIP models by inverting OOD triggers, addressing the specific threat where malicious MLaaS providers insert backdoors during prompt tuning while leaving encoders untouched.

entry.title: ELT: Elastic Looped Transformers for Visual Generation

author.name: Sahil Goyal, Swayam Agrawal, Gautham Govind Anil, Prateek Jain, Sujoy Paul, Aditya Kusupati

entry.summary: Introduces Elastic Looped Transformers (ELT), parameter-efficient visual generative models using weight-shared recurrent transformer blocks with Intra-Loop Self Distillation. Produces elastic models from a single training run enabling any-loop inference for compute-quality tradeoffs.

entry.title: Facet-Level Tracing of Evidence Uncertainty and Hallucination in RAG

author.name: Passant Elchafei, Monorama Swain, Shahed Masoudian, Markus Schedl

entry.summary: Introduces a facet-level diagnostics framework for RAG systems that decomposes questions into atomic reasoning facets and assesses evidence sufficiency and grounding using a structured Facet×Chunk matrix. Reveals systematic patterns in how RAG systems misuse evidence.

entry.title: Visually-Guided Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Zengbin Wang, Feng Xiong, Liang Lin, Xuecai Hu, Yong Wang, Yanlin Wang, Man Zhang, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Proposes VGPO (Visually-Guided Policy Optimization), a framework addressing 'temporal visual forgetting' in vision-language models during reasoning. Introduces Visual Attention Compensation to amplify visual cues and progressively elevate visual expectations during later reasoning steps.

entry.title: Rays as Pixels: Learning A Joint Distribution of Videos and Camera Trajectories

author.name: Wonbong Jang, Shikun Liu, Soubhik Sanyal, Juan Camilo Perez, Kam Woh Ng, Sanskar Agrawal, Juan-Manuel Perez-Rua, Yiannis Douratsos, Tao Xiang

entry.summary: Proposes 'Rays as Pixels,' a video diffusion model that learns joint distributions over videos and camera trajectories by representing cameras as dense ray pixels and denoising them jointly with video frames. Handles pose estimation, novel view synthesis, and video generation in a single model.

entry.title: Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy in LLM Agents

author.name: Jingyu Zhang, Tianjian Li, William Jurayj, Hongyuan Zhan, Benjamin Van Durme, Daniel Khashabi

entry.summary: Proposes Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH) for LLM agents handling arbitrarily many privilege levels of instructions, going beyond the typical fixed 3-5 tier hierarchy. Introduces ManyIH-Bench for evaluation.

entry.title: Process Reward Agents for Steering Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning

author.name: Jiwoong Sohn, Tomasz Sternal, Kenneth Styppa, Torsten Hoefler, and Michael Moor

entry.summary: Introduces Process Reward Agents (PRA), providing domain-grounded, online, step-wise rewards during test-time inference for knowledge-intensive reasoning. Unlike post-hoc PRMs, PRA enables integration with dynamic search-based decoding.

entry.title: RecaLLM: Addressing the Lost-in-Thought Phenomenon with Explicit In-Context Retrieval

author.name: Kyle Whitecross, Negin Rahimi

entry.summary: Proposes RecaLLM, reasoning models post-trained to interleave reasoning with explicit in-context retrieval, addressing 'lost-in-thought' where reasoning steps degrade subsequent retrieval from long contexts.

entry.title: VisionFoundry: Teaching VLMs Visual Perception with Synthetic Images

author.name: Guanyu Zhou, Yida Yin, Wenhao Chai, Shengbang Tong, Xingyu Fu, Zhuang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces VisionFoundry, a pipeline that generates synthetic training data for visual perception tasks using only a task keyword as input, leveraging LLMs and text-to-image models. It addresses VLM weaknesses in spatial understanding and viewpoint recognition without requiring reference images or human annotation.

entry.title: Beyond Relevance: Utility-Centric Retrieval in the LLM Era

author.name: Hengran Zhang, Minghao Tang, Keping Bi, Jiafeng Guo

entry.summary: Tutorial paper arguing that information retrieval objectives should evolve from relevance-centric to LLM-centric utility optimization in the RAG era, where retrieved documents serve as evidence for LLM generation rather than direct user consumption.

entry.title: Self-Sovereign Agent

author.name: Wenjie Qu, Xuandong Zhao, Jiaheng Zhang, Dawn Song

entry.summary: Investigates self-sovereign agents — AI systems that can economically sustain and extend their own operation without human involvement. Analyzes technical barriers and discusses security, societal, and governance challenges.

entry.title: Multi-User Large Language Model Agents

author.name: Shu Yang, Shenzhe Zhu, Hao Zhu, Jos\'e Ram\'on Enr\'iquez, Di Wang, Alex Pentland, Michiel A. Bakker, Jiaxin Pei

entry.summary: First systematic study of multi-user LLM agents, formalizing the multi-principal setting where agents must serve multiple users with conflicting roles, preferences, and authority levels. Addresses information asymmetry and privacy constraints.

entry.title: Robust Reasoning Benchmark

author.name: Pavel Golikov, Evgenii Opryshko, Gennady Pekhimenko, Mark C. Jeffrey

entry.summary: Proposes a perturbation pipeline of 14 techniques to evaluate robustness of LLM reasoning on math problems. Finds open-weight reasoning models suffer catastrophic collapses (up to 55% average accuracy drops) while frontier models show resilience.

entry.title: AlphaLab: Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Across Optimization Domains with Frontier LLMs

author.name: Brendan R. Hogan, Xiwen Chen, James T. Wilson, Kashif Rasul, Adel Boyarsky, Thomas Kamei, Anderson Schneider, Yuriy Nevmyvaka

entry.summary: Presents AlphaLab, an autonomous research harness using frontier LLM agents to automate the full experimental cycle: data exploration, evaluation framework construction, and large-scale GPU experiments with a persistent knowledge playbook.

entry.title: Mapping generative AI use in the human brain: divergent neural, academic, and mental health profiles of functional versus socio emotional AI use

author.name: Junjie Wang, Xianyang Gan, Dan Liu, Jingxian He, Stefania Ferraro, Keith M. Kendrick, Weihua Zhao, Shuxia Yao, Christian Montag, Benjamin Becker

entry.summary: Combines surveys with structural MRI in 222 university students to examine how generative AI use patterns relate to brain structure, academic performance, and mental health. Finds divergent profiles for functional vs. socio-emotional AI use, with concerning associations for socio-emotional use.

entry.title: StructRL: Recovering Dynamic Programming Structure from Learning Dynamics in Distributional Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ivo Nowak

entry.summary: Discovers that dynamic programming structure can be recovered from the learning dynamics of distributional RL. Introduces a temporal learning indicator t*(s) that reveals when states undergo strongest learning updates, inducing structured information propagation.

entry.title: Spectral-Transport Stability and Benign Overfitting in Interpolating Learning

author.name: Gustav Olaf Yunus Laitinen-Lundstr\"om Fredriksson-Imanov

entry.summary: Develops a theoretical framework for understanding benign overfitting in interpolating estimators via spectral-transport stability. Introduces a scale-dependent complexity parameter combining effective dimension, transport stability, and noise alignment.

entry.title: EXAONE 4.5 Technical Report

author.name: Eunbi Choi, Kibong Choi, Sehyun Chun, Seokhee Hong, Junwon Hwang, Hyojin Jeon, Ahra Jo, Hyunjik Jo, Yeonsik Jo, Joonkee Kim, Seonghwan Kim, Soyeon Kim, Sunkyoung Kim, Yireun Kim, Yongil Kim, Changhun Lee, Haeju Lee, Jinsik Lee, Kyungmin Lee, Sangha Park, Kwangrok Ryoo, Minju Seo, Sejong Yang, Heuiyeen Yeen, Hwan Chang, Stanley Jungkyu Choi, Yejin Choi, Kyubeen Han, Joonwon Jang, Kijeong Jeon, Geunyeong Jeong, Gerrard Jeongwon Jo, Jiyeon Jung, Daeseong Kim, Dohoon Kim, Dohyun Kim, Hyunseo Kim, Minu Kim, Myoungshin Kim, Youchul Kim, Byungoh Ko, Christopher Lee, Edward Hwayoung Lee, Honglak Lee, Jiyoung Lee, Sangeun Lee, Seungwon Lim, Woohyung Lim, Jueun Mun, Jaewoo Park, Jimin Park, Jinho Park, Yongmin Park, Wooseok Seo, Yongwoo Song, Sihyuk Yi, Kyungjae Yoo, Sangyeon Yoon

entry.summary: Technical report for EXAONE 4.5, LG AI Research's first open-weight vision language model, built by integrating a visual encoder into EXAONE 4.0. Supports 256K context, emphasizes document understanding, and shows strong performance across language and vision tasks.

entry.title: Skip-Connected Policy Optimization for Implicit Advantage

author.name: Fengwei Teng, Jinyi Bai, Xinhao Yao, Demi Ruohan Wang, Jiahao Zhao, and Zhijiang Guo

entry.summary: Proposes Skip-Connected Optimization (SKPO) for RLVR that decomposes reasoning into upstream (dense rewards) and downstream (group-relative) phases. Reveals that Monte Carlo estimation yields high-variance advantages for early tokens under practical budgets.

entry.title: LMGenDrive: Bridging Multimodal Understanding and Generative World Modeling for End-to-End Driving

author.name: Hao Shao, Letian Wang, Yang Zhou, Yuxuan Hu, Zhuofan Zong, Steven L. Waslander, Wei Zhan, and Hongsheng Li

entry.summary: Presents LMGenDrive, the first framework unifying LLM-based multimodal understanding with generative world models for end-to-end autonomous driving. Combines scene understanding with future imagination for action generation.

entry.title: Towards Responsible Multimodal Medical Reasoning via Context-Aligned Vision-Language Models

author.name: Sumra Khan, Sagar Chhabriya, Aizan Zafar, Sheeraz Arif, Amgad Muneer, Anas Zafar, Shaina Raza, Rizwan Qureshi

entry.summary: Introduces a context-aligned reasoning framework for medical VLMs that enforces agreement across radiomic statistics, explainability activations, and semantic cues before generating diagnostic conclusions with structured outputs including uncertainty estimates and safety notes.

entry.title: SenBen: Sensitive Scene Graphs for Explainable Content Moderation

author.name: Fatih Cagatay Akyon, Alptekin Temizel

entry.summary: Introduces SenBen, the first large-scale scene graph benchmark for sensitive content moderation with 13,999 movie frames annotated with detailed scene graphs. Distills a frontier VLM into a compact 241M student model achieving strong explainable content moderation.

entry.title: Scalable High-Recall Constraint-Satisfaction-Based Information Retrieval for Clinical Trials Matching

author.name: Cyrus Zhou, Yufei Jin, Yilin Xu, Yu-Chiang Wang, Chieh-Ju Chao, Monica S. Lam

entry.summary: Proposes SatIR, a clinical trial matching system using SMT solvers and relational algebra for constraint satisfaction-based retrieval, achieving high precision and interpretability compared to embedding-based approaches.

entry.title: Finite-Sample Analysis of Nonlinear Independent Component Analysis:Sample Complexity and Identifiability Bounds

author.name: Yuwen Jiang

entry.summary: Provides the first complete finite-sample analysis of nonlinear ICA with neural network encoders, establishing matching upper and lower bounds for sample complexity and identifiability.

entry.title: StaRPO: Stability-Augmented Reinforcement Policy Optimization

author.name: Jinghan Zhang, Fengran Mo, Tharindu Cyril Weerasooriya, Ruimin Dai, Xiaoyan Han, Yanjie Fu, Dakuo Wang, Kunpeng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes StaRPO, an RL framework incorporating reasoning stability metrics (autocorrelation and path efficiency) into the optimization objective for LLM reasoning, addressing logical inconsistency and structural redundancy.

entry.title: Delve into the Applicability of Advanced Optimizers for Multi-Task Learning

author.name: Zhipeng Zhou, Linxiao Cao, Pengcheng Wu, Peilin Zhao, Chunyan Miao

entry.summary: Investigates how advanced optimizers interact with multi-task learning, finding that instant-derived gradients play only marginal roles in parameter updates. Discovers that Muon optimizer inherently functions as a multi-task learner.

entry.title: TouchAnything: Diffusion-Guided 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Robot Touches

author.name: Langzhe Gu, Hung-Jui Huang, Mohamad Qadri, Michael Kaess and Wenzhen Yuan

entry.summary: Presents TouchAnything, using a pretrained 2D vision diffusion model as semantic/geometric prior for 3D reconstruction from sparse tactile measurements, avoiding category-specific training.

entry.title: Breaking Block Boundaries: Anchor-based History-stable Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models

author.name: Shun Zou, Yong Wang, Zehui Chen, Lin Chen, Chongyang Tao, Feng Zhao, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Proposes Anchor-based History-stable Decoding (AHD) for diffusion LLMs that breaks block boundaries in semi-autoregressive decoding by identifying stable tokens that can be decoded earlier across blocks.

entry.title: Neighbourhood Transformer: Switchable Attention for Monophily-Aware Graph Learning

author.name: Yi Luo, Xu Sun, Guangchun Luo, Aiguo Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Neighbourhood Transformers that apply self-attention within local neighborhoods instead of message-passing, designed to handle heterophilic graphs by leveraging the monophily property. Theoretically guarantees expressiveness in distinguishing local structures.

entry.title: CONDESION-BENCH: Conditional Decision-Making of Large Language Models in Compositional Action Space

author.name: Yeonjun Hwang, Sungyong Park, Minju Kim, Dongha Lee, Jinyoung Yeo

entry.summary: CONDESION-BENCH evaluates LLM conditional decision-making in compositional action spaces where actions are defined as allocations with explicit feasibility constraints, going beyond simple finite action selection.

entry.title: V-CAGE: Vision-Closed-Loop Agentic Generation Engine for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yaru Liu, Ao-bo Wang, Nanyang Ye

entry.summary: V-CAGE is an agentic framework for autonomous robotic data synthesis that uses foundation models to generate semantically coherent and physically feasible training scenes for VLA models.

entry.title: Scene-Agnostic Object-Centric Representation Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Tsuheng Hsu, Guiyu Liu, Juho Kannala, Janne Heikkil\"a

entry.summary: Proposes a dataset-level, object-centric supervision scheme for 3D Gaussian Splatting that learns a scene-agnostic object codebook, enabling consistent cross-scene object representations without per-scene mask processing.

entry.title: Tora3: Trajectory-Guided Audio-Video Generation with Physical Coherence

author.name: Junchao Liao, Zhenghao Zhang, Xiangyu Meng, Litao Li, Ziying Zhang, Siyu Zhu, Long Qin, Weizhi Wang

entry.summary: Tora3 uses object trajectories as a shared kinematic prior to jointly guide video and audio generation, improving physical coherence of motion-sound relationships in audio-video generation.

entry.title: PDE-regularized Dynamics-informed Diffusion with Uncertainty-aware Filtering for Long-Horizon Dynamics

author.name: Min Young Baeg and Yoon-Yeong Kim

entry.summary: PDYffusion integrates PDE-based regularization and UKF-based uncertainty-aware forecasting into diffusion models for stable long-horizon spatiotemporal prediction with physical consistency.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation from Spatial Transcriptomics to Histology

author.name: Arbel Hizmi, Artemii Bakulin, Shai Bagon, Nir Yosef

entry.summary: Proposes cross-modal distillation from spatial transcriptomics to histology, enabling histology-only models to identify tissue niches previously requiring expensive transcriptomics data.

entry.title: Strips as Tokens: Artist Mesh Generation with Native UV Segmentation

author.name: Rui Xu, Dafei Qin, Kaichun Qiao, Qiujie Dong, Huaijin Pi, Qixuan Zhang, Longwen Zhang, Lan Xu, Jingyi Yu, Wenping Wang, Taku Komura

entry.summary: SATO uses triangle strips as token ordering for autoregressive mesh generation, preserving UV boundaries and edge flow characteristic of artist-created meshes. Produces more professional mesh topology than coordinate or patch-based methods.

entry.title: MAG-3D: Multi-Agent Grounded Reasoning for 3D Understanding

author.name: Henry Zheng, Chenyue Fang, Rui Huang, Siyuan Wei, Xiao Liu and Gao Huang

entry.summary: Presents MAG-3D, a training-free multi-agent framework for grounded 3D reasoning using off-the-shelf VLMs. Decomposes 3D reasoning into specialized agents for object identification and spatial relationship reasoning without task-specific training.

entry.title: BadSkill: Backdoor Attacks on Agent Skills via Model-in-Skill Poisoning

author.name: Guiyao Tie, Jiawen Shi, Pan Zhou, Lichao Sun

entry.summary: Presents BadSkill, a backdoor attack targeting agent skill ecosystems where third-party skills bundle malicious model artifacts that activate only under specific semantic trigger combinations, exposing a supply-chain risk in AI agent platforms.

entry.title: OASIS: Online Activation Subspace Learning for Memory-Efficient Training

author.name: Sakshi Choudhary, Utkarsh Saxena, Kaushik Roy

entry.summary: Proposes OASIS, an online activation subspace learning algorithm that continuously tracks and projects activations onto a low-dimensional evolving subspace during LLM training, reducing memory without modifying forward-pass computations.

entry.title: SafeAdapt: Provably Safe Policy Updates in Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Maksim Anisimov (Imperial College London), Francesco Belardinelli (Imperial College London), Matthew Wicker (Imperial College London)

entry.summary: Proposes SafeAdapt for provably safe policy updates in continual RL by introducing the Rashomon set - a certified region in policy parameter space meeting safety constraints. Enables a priori safety guarantees rather than post-hoc verification.

entry.title: From Reasoning to Agentic: Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models

author.name: Chenchen Zhang

entry.summary: Surveys 47 credit assignment methods for RL in LLMs, organizing them by assignment granularity and mechanism. Covers both reasoning RL (single-generation) and agentic RL (multi-turn) regimes, highlighting the challenge of increasingly long trajectories.

entry.title: Integrated electro-optic attention nonlinearities for transformers

author.name: Luis Mickeler, Kai Lion, Alfonso Nardi, Jost Kellner, Pierre Didier, Bhavin J. Shastri, Niao He, Rachel Grange

entry.summary: Demonstrates lithium niobate Mach-Zehnder modulators as analog electro-optic alternatives to digital Softmax and Sigmoid in transformers, maintaining model accuracy while drastically reducing latency of nonlinear computations.

entry.title: Envisioning the Future, One Step at a Time

author.name: Stefan Andreas Baumann, Jannik Wiese, Tommaso Martorella, Mahdi M. Kalayeh, Bj\"orn Ommer

entry.summary: Proposes autoregressive diffusion over sparse point trajectories to predict future scene dynamics, rather than dense video prediction. This enables efficient exploration of many plausible futures over long horizons by focusing computation on sparse motion trajectories rather than full appearance.

entry.title: Towards Real-world Human Behavior Simulation: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Long-horizon, Cross-scenario, Heterogeneous Behavior Traces

author.name: Jiawei Chen, Ruoxi Xu, Boxi Cao, Ruotong Pan, Yunfei Zhang, Yifei Hu, Yong Du, Tingting Gao, Yaojie Lu, Yingfei Sun, Xianpei Han, Le Sun, Xiangyu Wu, Hongyu Lin

entry.summary: Introduces OmniBehavior, the first user simulation benchmark from real-world data integrating long-horizon, cross-scenario behavioral patterns. Shows that isolated scenario datasets suffer from 'tunnel vision' and that current LLMs struggle with authentic cross-scenario behavior.

entry.title: Medical Reasoning with Large Language Models: A Survey and MR-Bench

author.name: Xiaohan Ren, Chenxiao Fan, Wenyin Ma, Hongliang He, Chongming Gao, Xiaoyan Zhao, Fuli Feng

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of medical reasoning with LLMs, grounded in cognitive theories of clinical reasoning (abduction, deduction, induction). Organizes methods into seven technical routes and introduces MR-Bench for unified evaluation.

entry.title: WildDet3D: Scaling Promptable 3D Detection in the Wild

author.name: Weikai Huang, Jieyu Zhang, Sijun Li, Taoyang Jia, Jiafei Duan, Yunqian Cheng, Jaemin Cho, Mattew Wallingford, Rustin Soraki, Chris Dongjoo Kim, Donovan Clay, Taira Anderson, Winson Han, Ali Farhadi, Bharath Hariharan, Zhongzheng Ren, Ranjay Krishna

entry.summary: Introduces WildDet3D, a unified geometry-aware architecture for promptable monocular 3D object detection that supports diverse prompt types and leverages geometric cues. Also addresses data scarcity with new training data covering diverse categories.

entry.title: PRAGMA: Revolut Foundation Model

author.name: Maxim Ostroukhov, Ruslan Mikhailov, Vladimir Iashin, Artem Sokolov, Andrei Akshonov, Vitaly Protasov, Dmitrii Beloborodov, Vince Mullin, Roman Yokunda Enzmann, Georgios Kolovos, Jason Renders, Pavel Nesterov, Anton Repushko

entry.summary: Introduces PRAGMA, a family of Transformer-based foundation models for multi-source banking event sequences from Revolut. Pre-trained with masked modeling on heterogeneous financial data, supporting credit scoring, fraud detection, and lifetime value prediction.

entry.title: EvoLen: Evolution-Guided Tokenization for DNA Language Model

author.name: Nan Huang, Xiaoxiao Zhou, Junxia Cui, Mario Tapia-Pacheco, Tiffany Amariuta, Yang Li, Jingbo Shang

entry.summary: Proposes EvoLen, an evolution-guided tokenization strategy for DNA language models that incorporates evolutionary conservation information to prioritize functional sequence patterns like regulatory motifs rather than linguistic regularities.

entry.title: AniGen: Unified $S^3$ Fields for Animatable 3D Asset Generation

author.name: Yi-Hua Huang and Zi-Xin Zou and Yuting He and Chirui Chang and Cheng-Feng Pu and Ziyi Yang and Yuan-Chen Guo and Yan-Pei Cao and Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: Presents AniGen, a unified framework that directly generates animation-ready 3D assets (geometry, skeleton, skinning weights) from a single image using S³ Fields. Introduces a dual bone representation and curriculum training.

entry.title: Optimal Multi-bit Generative Watermarking Schemes Under Worst-Case False-Alarm Constraints

author.name: Yu-Shin Huang, Chao Tian, Krishna Narayanan

entry.summary: Develops optimal multi-bit watermarking schemes for LLM text under worst-case false-alarm constraints. Shows a previously proposed scheme is suboptimal and provides two new constructions achieving the theoretical lower bound.

entry.title: Policy-Aware Design of Large-Scale Factorial Experiments

author.name: Xin Wen, Xi Chen, Will Wei Sun, Yichen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage factorial experiment design for digital firms that centralizes overlapping A/B tests into a single low-rank tensor problem, optimizing for policy identification rather than estimating every treatment effect under budget constraints.

entry.title: Hierarchical Kernel Transformer: Multi-Scale Attention with an Information-Theoretic Approximation Analysis

author.name: Giansalvo Cirrincione

entry.summary: Introduces Hierarchical Kernel Transformer (HKT), a multi-scale attention mechanism processing sequences at multiple resolution levels with theoretical guarantees on kernel properties and information-theoretic approximation bounds. Costs only 1.3x standard attention.

entry.title: AI-Induced Human Responsibility (AIHR) in AI-Human teams

author.name: Greg Nyilasy, Brock Bastian, Jennifer Overbeck, Abraham Ryan Ade Putra Hito

entry.summary: Across four experiments (N=1,801), discovers that humans attribute more responsibility to human decision-makers when paired with AI than with another human (AIHR effect), averaging 10 points higher on a 0-100 scale.

entry.title: A Closer Look at the Application of Causal Inference in Graph Representation Learning

author.name: Hang Gao, Kunyu Li, Huang Hong, Baoquan Cui, Fengge Wu

entry.summary: Proves that aggregating graph elements into single causal variables violates core causal inference assumptions, and proposes a theoretical model using smallest indivisible graph units to ensure causal validity.

entry.title: Large-Scale Universal Defect Generation: Foundation Models and Datasets

author.name: Yuanting Fan, Jun Liu, Bin-Bin Gao, Xiaochen Chen, Yuhuan Lin, Zhewei Dai, Jiawei Zhan, Chengjie Wang

entry.summary: Introduces UDG (300K quadruplets) and UniDG, a universal defect generation foundation model supporting reference-based and text-instruction-based defect editing without per-category fine-tuning for anomaly detection training.

entry.title: Predictive Entropy Links Calibration and Paraphrase Sensitivity in Medical Vision-Language Models

author.name: Binesh Sadanandan, Vahid Behzadan

entry.summary: Shows that predictive entropy from a single forward pass can predict both miscalibration and paraphrase sensitivity in medical VLMs, linking both failure modes to proximity to the decision boundary.

entry.title: Modality-Aware Zero-Shot Pruning and Sparse Attention for Efficient Multimodal Edge Inference

author.name: Yueyuan Sui, Payal Mohapatra, Do\u{g}a\c{c} Eldenk, Haodong Yang, Yiting Zhang, Haoyan Zhang, Qi Zhu, Stephen Xia

entry.summary: SentryFuse framework enables zero-shot pruning and sparse attention for multimodal models on edge devices, adapting to sensor dropout without fine-tuning. It addresses the practical challenge of deploying multimodal pipelines under fluctuating power budgets and unpredictable sensor availability.

entry.title: PilotBench: A Benchmark for General Aviation Agents with Safety Constraints

author.name: Yalun Wu, Haotian Liu, Zhoujun Li, and Boyang Wang

entry.summary: PilotBench evaluates LLMs on safety-critical flight trajectory and attitude prediction using 708 real-world aviation trajectories with 34-channel telemetry. Tests whether text-trained models can reason about complex physics under safety constraints.

entry.title: Robust by Design: A Continuous Monitoring and Data Integration Framework for Medical AI

author.name: Mohammad Daouk, Jan Ulrich Becker, Neeraja Kambham, Anthony Chang, Chandra Mohan, Hien Van Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes a continuous monitoring framework for medical AI that detects data drift and selectively retrains on statistically similar, low-uncertainty images. Maintains robust glomerular pathology classification over time with strict performance safeguards.

entry.title: SiMing-Bench: Evaluating Procedural Correctness from Continuous Interactions in Clinical Skill Videos

author.name: Xiyang Huang, Jiawei Lin, Keying Wu, Jiaxin Huang, Kailai Yang, Renxiong Wei, Cheng zeng, Jiayi Xiang, Ziyan Kuang, Min Peng, Qianqian Xie, Sophia Ananiadou

entry.summary: SiMing-Bench evaluates MLLMs on procedural correctness judgment in clinical skill videos, requiring tracking of interaction-driven state updates across entire workflows. First benchmark targeting rubric-grounded process-level judgment.

entry.title: Physically Grounded 3D Generative Reconstruction under Hand Occlusion using Proprioception and Multi-Contact Touch

author.name: Gabriele Mario Caddeo, Pasquale Marra, Lorenzo Natale

entry.summary: Proposes multimodal approach for 3D object reconstruction under hand occlusion using proprioception and multi-contact touch sensing alongside vision, represented as pose-aware signed distance fields.

entry.title: Truncated Rectified Flow Policy for Reinforcement Learning with One-Step Sampling

author.name: Xubin Zhou, Yipeng Yang, Zhan Li

entry.summary: Proposes Truncated Rectified Flow Policy (TRFP) for maximum entropy reinforcement learning that addresses limitations of Gaussian policies in modeling multimodal action distributions. Achieves one-step sampling while maintaining tractable likelihood and entropy computation.

entry.title: SHIFT: Steering Hidden Intermediates in Flow Transformers

author.name: Nina Konovalova, Andrey Kuznetsov, Aibek Alanov

entry.summary: Proposes SHIFT, a lightweight framework for concept removal in DiT diffusion models via targeted manipulation of intermediate activations at inference time, inspired by activation steering in LLMs. Can suppress unwanted concepts or steer toward desired styles.

entry.title: DRBENCHER: Can Your Agent Identify the Entity, Retrieve Its Properties and Do the Math?

author.name: Young-Suk Lee, Ramon Fernandez Astudillo, Radu Florian

entry.summary: Introduces DRBENCHER, a synthetic benchmark generator for deep research agents that require both web browsing and multi-step computation. Enforces verifiability via code-executable gold answers and filters out easily solvable questions.

entry.title: VAG: Dual-Stream Video-Action Generation for Embodied Data Synthesis

author.name: Xiaolei Lang, Yang Wang, Yukun Zhou, Chaojun Ni, Kerui Li, Jiagang Zhu, Tianze Liu, Jiajun Lv, Xingxing Zuo, Yun Ye, Guan Huang, Xiaofeng Wang, Zheng Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes VAG, a dual-stream framework for simultaneously generating videos and paired action trajectories for robot learning data synthesis. Addresses the alignment gap between generated video and action in existing world models.

entry.title: Mind the Gap Between Spatial Reasoning and Acting! Step-by-Step Evaluation of Agents With Spatial-Gym

author.name: Lars Benedikt Kaesberg and Tianyu Yang and Niklas Bauer and Terry Ruas and Jan Philip Wahle and Bela Gipp

entry.summary: Introduces Spatial-Gym, a benchmark testing spatial reasoning in LLMs via 2D grid pathfinding as sequential decision tasks with optional backtracking. The best model (GPT-OSS 120B) achieves only 16% solve rate vs 98% human baseline, revealing a massive gap in spatial reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: Sharp description of local minima in the loss landscape of high-dimensional two-layer ReLU neural networks

author.name: Jie Huang, Bruno Loureiro, Stefano Sarao Mannelli

entry.summary: Provides sharp characterization of local minima in two-layer ReLU network loss landscapes in a teacher-student setting, showing minima admit exact low-dimensional representations and establishing connections between local minima and SGD fixed points.

entry.title: BERT-as-a-Judge: A Robust Alternative to Lexical Methods for Efficient Reference-Based LLM Evaluation

author.name: Hippolyte Gisserot-Boukhlef, Nicolas Boizard, Emmanuel Malherbe, C\'eline Hudelot, Pierre Colombo

entry.summary: Proposes BERT-as-a-Judge as a lightweight alternative to LLM-as-a-Judge for reference-based evaluation. Shows lexical evaluation conflates problem-solving ability with format compliance across 36 models and 15 tasks, and BERT-based evaluation maintains accuracy at much lower cost.

entry.title: Strategic Algorithmic Monoculture:Experimental Evidence from Coordination Games

author.name: Gonzalo Ballestero, Hadi Hosseini, Samarth Khanna, Ran I. Shorrer

entry.summary: Experimentally studies algorithmic monoculture in LLMs through coordination games, distinguishing primary (baseline similarity) from strategic monoculture (incentive-responsive similarity). LLMs coordinate well on similar actions but lag behind humans in sustaining heterogeneity.

entry.title: VL-Calibration: Decoupled Confidence Calibration for Large Vision-Language Models Reasoning

author.name: Wenyi Xiao, Xinchi Xu, Leilei Gan

entry.summary: Proposes VL-Calibration, an RL framework that decouples confidence calibration in vision-language models into separate visual and reasoning components. This addresses the problem where incorrect VLM predictions may stem from either perceptual or reasoning failures, which a single confidence score conflates.

entry.title: Why I'm excited about meta-models for interpretability

author.name: loops

entry.summary: Advocates for using 'meta-models' (models trained to interpret other models) for interpretability research, arguing they are underexplored compared to mechanistic interpretability. Highlights Activation Oracles as a promising direction and proposes extensions.

entry.title: Routing Sensitivity Without Controllability: A Diagnostic Study of Fairness in MoE Language Models

author.name: Junhyeok Lee and Kyu Sung Choi

entry.summary: Introduces FARE, a diagnostic framework revealing that MoE language models are sensitive to demographic content at routing level, but this sensitivity cannot be exploited for fairness control. Tests across Mixtral, Qwen, DeepSeek, and OLMoE architectures.

entry.title: Dynamic sparsity in tree-structured feed-forward layers at scale

author.name: Reza Sedghi, Robin Schiewer, Anand Subramoney, David Kappel

entry.summary: Studies tree-structured sparse feed-forward layers as drop-in replacements for MLP blocks in transformers, enabling conditional computation with hard hierarchical routing. First demonstration of scalability beyond 1B parameters, matching dense baselines at <5% activation.

entry.title: Distributionally Robust Token Optimization in RLHF

author.name: Yeping Jin, Jiaming Hu and Ioannis Ch. Paschalidis

entry.summary: Proposes Distributionally Robust Token Optimization (DRTO), combining token-level RLHF with distributionally robust optimization to improve LLM consistency under distribution shifts. Achieves 9.17% improvement on GSM8K and 2.49% on MATH.

entry.title: OpenKedge: Governing Agentic Mutation with Execution-Bound Safety and Evidence Chains

author.name: Jun He, Deying Yu

entry.summary: Introduces OpenKedge, a protocol for governing autonomous AI agent mutations through declarative intent proposals, deterministic state evaluation, and execution contracts with bounded permissions. Shifts safety from reactive filtering to preventative enforcement.

entry.title: InsEdit: Towards Instruction-based Visual Editing via Data-Efficient Video Diffusion Models Adaptation

author.name: Zhefan Rao, Bin Zou, Haoxuan Che, Xuanhua He, Chong Hou Choi, Yanheng Li, Rui Liu, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: Presents InsEdit, an instruction-based video editing model built on HunyuanVideo-1.5 that achieves SOTA open-source performance with only ~100K video editing data. Uses Mutual Context Attention for creating aligned video pairs.

entry.title: Generative Simulation for Policy Learning in Physical Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Junxiang Wang, Xinwen Xu, Tiancheng Wu, Julian Millan, Nir Pechuk, Zackory Erickson

entry.summary: Introduces a zero-shot text2sim2real framework using LLMs and VLMs to procedurally generate diverse physical human-robot interaction scenarios from natural language prompts, then trains imitation learning policies from synthetic demonstrations.

entry.title: Every Response Counts: Quantifying Uncertainty of LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems through Tensor Decomposition

author.name: Tiejin Chen, Huaiyuan Yao, Jia Chen, Evangelos E. Papalexakis, Hua Wei

entry.summary: Introduces MATU, a framework for quantifying uncertainty in LLM-based multi-agent systems using tensor decomposition. Addresses cascading uncertainty, inter-agent communication variability, and diverse topologies.

entry.title: Adam-HNAG: A Convergent Reformulation of Adam with Accelerated Rate

author.name: Yaxin Yu, Long Chen, Zeyi Xu

entry.summary: Develops a convergent reformulation of Adam optimizer using variable/operator splitting with curvature-aware gradient correction. Establishes convergence guarantees including accelerated rates in the convex smooth setting.

entry.title: Toward Hardware-Agnostic Quadrupedal World Models via Morphology Conditioning

author.name: Mohamad H. Danesh, Chenhao Li, Amin Abyaneh, Anas Houssaini, Kirsty Ellis, Glen Berseth, Marco Hutter, Hsiu-Chin Lin

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for training a generalizable Quadrupedal World Model (QWM) that disentangles environmental dynamics from robot morphology via morphology conditioning, enabling transfer across different quadruped robots.

entry.title: PSIRNet: Deep Learning-based Free-breathing Rapid Acquisition Late Enhancement Imaging

author.name: Arda Atalik, Hui Xue, Rhodri H. Davies, Thomas A. Treibel, Daniel K. Sodickson, Michael S. Hansen, Peter Kellman

entry.summary: Develops PSIRNet, an 845M parameter physics-guided deep learning network for free-breathing cardiac MRI that produces diagnostic quality from a single two-heartbeat acquisition, eliminating need for 8-24 motion-corrected averages. Trained on 800K+ slices from 55K+ patients.

entry.title: MedConceal: A Benchmark for Clinical Hidden-Concern Reasoning Under Partial Observability

author.name: Yikun Han, Joey Chan, Jingyuan Chen, Mengting Ai, Simo Du, Yue Guo

entry.summary: Presents MedConceal, a benchmark with interactive patient simulator for evaluating hidden-concern reasoning in medical dialogue. Contains 300 curated cases and 600 clinical dialogues testing LLMs' ability to elicit concealed patient concerns.

entry.title: Adaptive Candidate Point Thompson Sampling for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Donney Fan, Geoff Pleiss

entry.summary: Introduces Adaptive Candidate Thompson Sampling (ACTS) for high-dimensional Bayesian optimization that adaptively reduces the search space during sampling using gradient guidance, addressing the curse of dimensionality for candidate points.

entry.title: GeoMMBench and GeoMMAgent: Toward Expert-Level Multimodal Intelligence in Geoscience and Remote Sensing

author.name: Aoran Xiao, Shihao Cheng, Yonghao Xu, Yexian Ren, Hongruixuan Chen, Naoto Yokoya

entry.summary: Introduces GeoMMBench, a comprehensive multimodal benchmark for geoscience and remote sensing evaluating 36 LLMs, plus GeoMMAgent integrating tool use and dynamic retrieval for expert-level geospatial interpretation.

entry.title: M-IDoL: Information Decomposition for Modality-Specific and Diverse Representation Learning in Medical Foundation Model

author.name: Yihang Liu and Ying Wen and Jiaxiong Yang and Longzhen Yang and Lianghua He and Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes M-IDoL, a medical foundation model using information decomposition to learn modality-specific representations via Mixture-of-Experts subspaces, maximizing inter-modality entropy while minimizing intra-modality uncertainty.

entry.title: Litmus (Re)Agent: A Benchmark and Agentic System for Predictive Evaluation of Multilingual Models

author.name: Avni Mittal, Shanu Kumar, Sandipan Dandapat and Monojit Choudhury

entry.summary: Introduces Litmus (Re)Agent for predictive multilingual evaluation - estimating model performance on missing language-task combinations through a DAG-orchestrated agentic system with feature-aware evidence aggregation.

entry.title: Testing the Assumptions of Active Learning for Translation Tasks with Few Samples

author.name: Lorenzo Jaime Yu Flores, Cesare Spinoso di-Piano, Ori Ernst, David Ifeoluwa Adelani, Jackie Chi Kit Cheung

entry.summary: Tests core assumptions of active learning for translation tasks with few samples, finding that neither informativeness nor diversity of training data correlate with test set performance. Suggests fundamental limitations of AL strategies in low-sample regimes.

entry.title: PinpointQA: A Dataset and Benchmark for Small Object-Centric Spatial Understanding in Indoor Videos

author.name: Zhiyu Zhou, Peilin Liu, Ruoxuan Zhang, Luyang Zhang, Cheng Zhang, Hongxia Xie, Wen-Huang Cheng

entry.summary: PinpointQA is the first benchmark for small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos, with 10K QA pairs across four progressively challenging tasks from presence verification to precise localization.

entry.title: StreamMeCo: Long-Term Agent Memory Compression for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding

author.name: Junxi Wang, Te Sun, Jiayi Zhu, Junxian Li, Haowen Xu, Zichen Wen, Xuming Hu, Zhiyu Li, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: StreamMeCo compresses vision agent memory for streaming video understanding through graph-based sampling and pruning, reducing memory overhead while maintaining accuracy. Introduces time-decay retrieval to mitigate compression-induced performance loss.

entry.title: Hypergraph Neural Networks Accelerate MUS Enumeration

author.name: Hiroya Ijima, Koichiro Yawata

entry.summary: Proposes using hypergraph neural networks to accelerate MUS (Minimal Unsatisfiable Subsets) enumeration in constraint satisfaction problems. Uses RL-trained HGNN agents to minimize satisfiability checks in a domain-agnostic way.

entry.title: BlendFusion -- Scalable Synthetic Data Generation for Diffusion Model Training

author.name: Thejas Venkatesh, Suguna Varshini Velury

entry.summary: BlendFusion generates synthetic training data from 3D scenes using path tracing to avoid model collapse (MAD) that occurs when training on purely diffusion-generated images. Curates FineBLEND dataset with automatic captioning.

entry.title: Nested Radially Monotone Polar Occupancy Estimation: Clinically-Grounded Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation for Glaucoma Screening

author.name: Rimsa Goperma, Rojan Basnet, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: NPS-Net formulates optic disc/cup segmentation as nested radially monotone polar occupancy estimation, guaranteeing clinical validity (star-convexity and nesting) while achieving strong zero-shot generalization across 7 datasets.

entry.title: Off-the-shelf Vision Models Benefit Image Manipulation Localization

author.name: Zhengxuan Zhang, Keji Song, Junmin Hu, Ao Luo, Yuezun Li

entry.summary: ReVi adapter repurposes off-the-shelf general vision models for image manipulation localization, showing that semantic priors from generation and segmentation networks contain useful manipulation-detection signals.

entry.title: "Take Me Home, Wi-Fi Drone": A Drone-based Wireless System for Wilderness Search and Rescue

author.name: Weiying Hou, Luca Jiang-Tao Yu, Chenshu Wu

entry.summary: Wi2SAR uses drones with Wi-Fi hotspots that mimic known networks to trigger automatic reconnection of victims' mobile devices for wilderness search and rescue, enabling localization without existing infrastructure.

entry.title: MixFlow: Mixed Source Distributions Improve Rectified Flows

author.name: Nazir Nayal, Christopher Wewer, Jan Eric Lenssen

entry.summary: Proposes MixFlow, a training strategy for rectified flows that reduces generative path curvature by conditioning the source distribution on an arbitrary signal aligned with the data distribution. Achieves faster sampling through straighter generative paths.

entry.title: Mosaic: Multimodal Jailbreak against Closed-Source VLMs via Multi-View Ensemble Optimization

author.name: Yuqin Lan, Gen Li, Yuanze Hu, Weihao Shen, Zhaoxin Fan, Faguo Wu, Xiao Zhang, Laurence T. Yang, Zhiming Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes Mosaic, a multi-view ensemble optimization framework for multimodal jailbreak attacks against closed-source VLMs. Identifies and addresses 'surrogate dependency' gap between homogeneous and heterogeneous attack settings.

entry.title: SkillMOO: Multi-Objective Optimization of Agent Skills for Software Engineering

author.name: Jingzhi Gong, Ruizhen Gu, Zhiwei Fei, Yazhuo Cao, Lukas Twist, Alina Geiger, Shuo Han, Dominik Sobania, Federica Sarro, Jie M. Zhang

entry.summary: Presents SkillMOO, a multi-objective optimization framework that automatically evolves skill bundles for LLM-based coding agents using NSGA-II. Improves pass rate by up to 131% while reducing cost by 32% on software engineering tasks.

entry.title: Constraint-Aware Corrective Memory for Language-Based Drug Discovery Agents

author.name: Maochen Sun, Youzhi Zhang, Gaofeng Meng

entry.summary: Presents CACM, a language-based drug discovery framework with constraint-aware corrective memory that tracks protocol-level requirements (set size, diversity, binding quality) across an agent's multi-step planning process.

entry.title: Physics-guided surrogate learning enables zero-shot control of turbulent wings

author.name: Yuning Wang, Pol Suarez, Mathis Bode and Ricardo Vinuesa

entry.summary: Shows that RL policies trained in turbulent channel flows can transfer zero-shot to a realistic NACA4412 wing, achieving 28.7% skin-friction drag reduction by exploiting local structures of wall-bounded turbulence.

entry.title: Case-Grounded Evidence Verification: A Framework for Constructing Evidence-Sensitive Supervision

author.name: Soroosh Tayebi Arasteh, Mehdi Joodaki, Mahshad Lotfinia, Sven Nebelung, Daniel Truhn

entry.summary: Introduces case-grounded evidence verification, a framework where models must determine whether provided evidence supports a claim for a specific case. The key contribution is a supervision construction procedure generating support examples alongside semantically controlled non-support examples including counterfactuals.

entry.title: ANTIC: Adaptive Neural Temporal In-situ Compressor

author.name: Sandeep S. Cranganore, Andrei Bodnar, Gianluca Galleti, Fabian Paischer, Johannes Brandstetter

entry.summary: Introduces ANTIC, an in-situ neural compression pipeline for massive PDE simulation data. It combines adaptive temporal snapshot selection with spatial neural compression to handle petabyte-to-exabyte scale data from physics simulations like Navier-Stokes and magnetohydrodynamics.

entry.title: VerifAI: A Verifiable Open-Source Search Engine for Biomedical Question Answering

author.name: Milo\v{s} Ko\v{s}prdi\'c, Adela Ljaji\'c, Bojana Ba\v{s}aragin, Darija Medvecki, Lorenzo Cassano, Nikola Milo\v{s}evi\'c

entry.summary: Introduces VerifAI, an open-source biomedical QA system combining RAG with post-hoc claim verification that decomposes answers into atomic claims and validates against evidence using fine-tuned NLI. Outperforms GPT-4 on HealthVer hallucination detection.

entry.title: Adjoint Matching through the Lens of the Stochastic Maximum Principle in Optimal Control

author.name: Carles Domingo-Enrich, Jiequn Han

entry.summary: Rigorously derives Adjoint Matching from the Stochastic Maximum Principle for stochastic optimal control problems. Generalizes to control-dependent drift/diffusion and convex running costs, showing critical points satisfy HJB conditions.

entry.title: CSAttention: Centroid-Scoring Attention for Accelerating LLM Inference

author.name: Chuxu Song, Zhencan Peng, Jiuqi Wei, Chuanhui Yang

entry.summary: Proposes CSAttention, a training-free sparse attention method for LLM inference that front-loads computation into offline prefill and uses centroid-scoring for efficient online decoding. Optimized for reusable context scenarios.

entry.title: Act or Escalate? Evaluating Escalation Behavior in Automation with Language Models

author.name: Matthew DosSantos DiSorbo, Harang Ju

entry.summary: Models the act-or-escalate decision in LLM automation across five domains (forecasting, recommendation, moderation, lending, driving). Finds marked differences in implicit cost thresholds across model families with miscalibrated self-estimates.

entry.title: Evidential Transformation Network: Turning Pretrained Models into Evidential Models for Post-hoc Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Yongchan Chun, Chanhee Park, Jeongho Yoon, Jaehyung Seo, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Proposes the Evidential Transformation Network (ETN), a lightweight post-hoc module that converts pretrained models into evidential models for uncertainty estimation. Operates in logit space with sample-dependent affine transformations.

entry.title: Creator Incentives in Recommender Systems: A Cooperative Game-Theoretic Approach for Stable and Fair Collaboration in Multi-Agent Bandits

author.name: Ramakrishnan Krishnamurthy, Arpit Agarwal, Lakshminarayanan Subramanian, Maximilian Nickel

entry.summary: Models content creator incentives in recommendation platforms as a cooperative game-theoretic multi-agent bandit problem. Proves that for homogeneous agents the game is convex with non-empty core containing the Shapley value, ensuring stability and fairness.

entry.title: Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference

author.name: Dengjia Zhang, Alexander Martin, William Jurayj, Kenton Murray, Benjamin Van Durme, Reno Kriz

entry.summary: Introduces Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference (UMUI), a task requiring calibrated probability estimates across text, audio, and video modalities. Proposes CLUE method combining self-consistent teacher distillation for calibrated uncertainty estimation.

entry.title: Demystifying the Silence of Correctness Bugs in PyTorch Compiler

author.name: Meiziniu Li, Dongze Li, Jianmeng Liu, Shing-Chi Cheung

entry.summary: Systematically characterizes correctness bugs in PyTorch's torch.compile, which cause incorrect outputs without crashes/warnings. Provides the first empirical study of these silent bugs that threaten LLM application reliability.

entry.title: Artifacts as Memory Beyond the Agent Boundary

author.name: John D. Martin, Fraser Mince, Esra'a Saleh, Amy Pajak

entry.summary: Formalizes how environment artifacts can functionally serve as agent memory in RL, proving that certain observations reduce the information needed to represent history. Experiments show spatial paths reduce memory requirements for learning.

entry.title: State Space Models are Effective Sign Language Learners: Exploiting Phonological Compositionality for Vocabulary-Scale Recognition

author.name: Bryan Cheng, Austin Jin, Jasper Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PHONSSM, using state space models with phonological decomposition for sign language recognition at vocabulary scale (5,565 signs). Achieves 72.1% on WLASL2000, improving over skeleton-based methods by 18.4pp.

entry.title: MT-OSC: Path for LLMs that Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation

author.name: Jyotika Singh, Fang Tu, Miguel Ballesteros, Weiyi Sun, Sandip Ghoshal, Michelle Yuan, Yassine Benajiba, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth

entry.summary: Introduces MT-OSC, a framework for condensing multi-turn chat history for LLMs using a Condenser Agent with few-shot inference and a lightweight Decider. Reduces token counts by up to 72% in 10-turn conversations while maintaining performance.

entry.title: HiFloat4 Format for Language Model Pre-training on Ascend NPUs

author.name: Mehran Taghian, Yunke Peng, Xing Huang, Yao Wang, Yaoyuan Wang, Wei Guo, Yuanyong Luo, Tianchi Hu, Junsong Wang, Xin Wang, Hu Liu, Yu Cheng, Ziwei Yu, Hongliang Li, Mehdi Rahimifar, Lei Yan, Xuefei Wang, Zhuang Ma, Lei Liu, Hui Yu, Anandharaju Durai Raju, Hoang Le, Hei Yi Mak, Tanzila Rahman, Shadan Golestan

entry.summary: Investigates Huawei's HiFloat4 FP4 format for LLM pre-training on Ascend NPUs, systematically comparing it with MXFP4 for large-scale training. Targets 4x compute throughput and memory efficiency improvements.

entry.title: HM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models in Hyperspectral Remote Sensing

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Zurong Mai, Qingmei Li, Zjin Liao, Yibin Wen, Yuhang Chen, Xiaoya Fan, Chan Tsz Ho, Bi Tianyuan, Haoyuan Liang, Ruifeng Su, Zihao Qian, Juepeng Zheng, Jianxi Huang, Yutong Lu, and Haohuan Fu

entry.summary: Introduces HM-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on hyperspectral remote sensing imagery, with 19,337 QA pairs across 13 task categories and a dual-modal spectral encoding strategy.

entry.title: Ge$^\text{2}$mS-T: Multi-Dimensional Grouping for Ultra-High Energy Efficiency in Spiking Transformer

author.name: Zecheng Hao, Shenghao Xie, Kang Chen, Wenxuan Liu, Zhaofei Yu, Tiejun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Ge²mS-T, a spiking vision transformer with grouped computation across temporal, spatial, and network dimensions, achieving ultra-high energy efficiency through a novel ExpG-IF neuron model enabling lossless ANN-SNN conversion.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Decision-Focused Learning via Value-Aware Sequential Communication

author.name: Benjamin Amoh, Geoffrey Parker, Wesley Marrero

entry.summary: Introduces SeqComm-DFL, unifying sequential communication with decision-focused learning for multi-agent coordination. Messages maximize receiver decision quality with Stackelberg conditioning and prosocial ordering.

entry.title: WOMBET: World Model-based Experience Transfer for Robust and Sample-efficient Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Mintae Kim, Koushil Sreenath

entry.summary: Proposes WOMBET, a framework that learns source-task world models and generates filtered offline data for target-task online fine-tuning with uncertainty-penalized planning and adaptive sampling.

entry.title: How Should Video LLMs Output Time? An Analysis of Efficient Temporal Grounding Paradigms

author.name: Shengji Jin, Yuanhao Zou, Victor Zhu, Zhengping Ji, Chen Chen

entry.summary: Presents controlled empirical study comparing three temporal grounding output paradigms for Video LLMs (text numeral, temporal token, continuous temporal) across compact VLMs, finding temporal token generation achieves best accuracy-efficiency tradeoff.

entry.title: PerMix-RLVR: Preserving Persona Expressivity under Verifiable-Reward Alignment

author.name: Jihwan Oh, Soowon Oh, Murad Aghazada, Minchan Jeong, Sungnyun Kim, Se-Young Yun

entry.summary: Addresses the trade-off between persona expressivity and task performance when applying RLVR to LLMs. Proposes PerMix-RLVR which preserves persona sensitivity during training-time alignment without inference-time prompt search.

entry.title: ASTRA: Adaptive Semantic Tree Reasoning Architecture for Complex Table Question Answering

author.name: Xiaoke Guo, Songze Li, Zhiqiang Liu, Zhaoyan Gong, Yuanxiang Liu, Huajun Chen, and Wen Zhang

entry.summary: ASTRA proposes adaptive semantic tree reasoning for complex table QA, reconstructing tables into logical semantic trees that model hierarchical dependencies. Combines tree construction with dual-phase reasoning for improved table understanding.

entry.title: Regime-Conditional Retrieval: Theory and a Transferable Router for Two-Hop QA

author.name: Andre Bacellar

entry.summary: Formalizes the two-regime structure of two-hop QA retrieval (Q-dominant vs B-dominant) with three theorems and proposes RegimeRouter, a lightweight binary router that selects retrieval strategies per query.

entry.title: Skill-Conditioned Visual Geolocation for Vision-Language

author.name: Chenjie Yang, Yutian Jiang and Chenyu Wu

entry.summary: GeoSkill is a training-free framework for visual geolocation using an evolving Skill-Graph of atomic geographic reasoning skills. Enables self-evolution of geolocation capabilities through feedback loops.

entry.title: Overhang Tower: Resource-Rational Adaptation in Sequential Physical Planning

author.name: Ruihong Shen, Shiqian Li, Yixin Zhu

entry.summary: Studies how humans adapt physical prediction mechanisms and planning strategies under resource constraints in a block-stacking task. Shows a dual transition from simulation to heuristics and from deliberative to myopic planning under pressure.

entry.title: Memory-Efficient Transfer Learning with Fading Side Networks via Masked Dual Path Distillation

author.name: Yutong Zhang, Jiaxin Chen, Honglin Chen, Kaiqi Zheng, Shengcai Liao, Hanwen Zhong, Weixin Li, Yunhong Wang

entry.summary: MDPD enables memory-efficient transfer learning with fading side networks that are distilled away during inference, eliminating the inference overhead of typical side-network approaches.

entry.title: FIRE-CIR: Fine-grained Reasoning for Composed Fashion Image Retrieval

author.name: Fran\c{c}ois Gard\`eres, Camille-Sovanneary Gauthier, Jean Ponce, Shizhe Chen

entry.summary: FIRE-CIR introduces compositional reasoning to fashion composed image retrieval through question-driven visual reasoning that explicitly determines what to preserve and change rather than relying on embedding similarity.

entry.title: Interactive ASR: Towards Human-Like Interaction and Semantic Coherence Evaluation for Agentic Speech Recognition

author.name: Peng Wang (1), Yanqiao Zhu (1), Zixuan Jiang (1), Qinyuan Chen (2), Xingjian Zhao (2), Xipeng Qiu (2), Wupeng Wang (3), Zhifu Gao (3), Xiangang Li (3), Kai Yu (1), Xie Chen (1) ((1) X-LANCE Lab, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (2) School of Computer Science, Fudan University, (3) Tongyi Fun Team, Alibaba Group)

entry.summary: Proposes Interactive ASR with LLM-as-a-Judge for semantic-aware evaluation beyond WER, plus an LLM-driven interactive correction framework that mimics human communication patterns.

entry.title: MATCHA: Efficient Deployment of Deep Neural Networks on Multi-Accelerator Heterogeneous Edge SoCs

author.name: Enrico Russo, Mohamed Amine Hamdi, Alessandro Ottaviano, Francesco Conti, Angelo Garofalo, Daniele Jahier Pagliari, Maurizio Palesi, Luca Benini, Alessio Burrello

entry.summary: MATCHA is a DNN deployment framework for heterogeneous multi-accelerator SoCs that uses constraint programming for optimized memory allocation and scheduling, achieving up to 35% latency reduction.

entry.title: CT-1: Vision-Language-Camera Models Transfer Spatial Reasoning Knowledge to Camera-Controllable Video Generation

author.name: Haoyu Zhao, Zihao Zhang, Jiaxi Gu, Haoran Chen, Qingping Zheng, Pin Tang, Yeyin Jin, Yuang Zhang, Junqi Cheng, Zenghui Lu, Peng Shu, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes CT-1 (Camera Transformer 1), a Vision-Language-Camera model that transfers spatial reasoning to camera-controllable video generation. Uses Wavelet-based Regularization Loss for learning complex camera trajectory distributions.

entry.title: GRM: Utility-Aware Jailbreak Attacks on Audio LLMs via Gradient-Ratio Masking

author.name: Yunqiang Wang, Hengyuan Na, Di Wu, Miao Hu, Guocong Quan

entry.summary: Proposes Gradient-Ratio Masking (GRM) for jailbreak attacks on audio LLMs that balances attack success with utility preservation. Finds that concentrating perturbation on select frequency bands yields better attack-utility tradeoffs.

entry.title: The AI Codebase Maturity Model: From Assisted Coding to Self-Sustaining Systems

author.name: Andy Anderson

entry.summary: Presents the AI Codebase Maturity Model (ACMM), a 5-level framework for how codebases evolve from basic AI-assisted coding to self-sustaining systems, validated through a 4-month experience report maintaining a Kubernetes dashboard with Claude Code and Copilot.

entry.title: E3-TIR: Enhanced Experience Exploitation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning

author.name: Weiyang Guo, Zesheng Shi, Liye Zhao, Jiayuan Ma, Zeen Zhu, Junxian He, Min Zhang, Jing Li

entry.summary: Proposes E3-TIR, a training paradigm for tool-integrated reasoning that dynamically integrates expert prefixes, expert-guided exploration, and self-exploration to address inefficient exploration in Zero-RL and capability plateaus in SFT-then-RL.

entry.title: XFED: Non-Collusive Model Poisoning Attack Against Byzantine-Robust Federated Classifiers

author.name: Israt Jahan Mouri, Muhammad Ridowan, Muhammad Abdullah Adnan

entry.summary: Introduces XFED, a non-collusive model poisoning attack against Byzantine-robust federated learning where compromised clients share adversarial objectives but never communicate with each other, challenging assumptions of existing defenses.

entry.title: EgoTL: Egocentric Think-Aloud Chains for Long-Horizon Tasks

author.name: Lulin Liu, Dayou Li, Yiqing Liang, Sicong Jiang, Hitesh Vijay, Hezhen Hu, Xuhai Xu, Zirui Liu, Srinivas Shakkottai, Manling Li, and Zhiwen Fan

entry.summary: Introduces EgoTL, a think-aloud capture pipeline for egocentric data that addresses noisy VLM auto-labeling in long-horizon household tasks. It combines human verbal annotations with spatial grounding to provide more accurate training data for embodied AI.

entry.title: Tango: Taming Visual Signals for Efficient Video Large Language Models

author.name: Shukang Yin, Sirui Zhao, Hanchao Wang, Baozhi Jia, Xianquan Wang, Chaoyou Fu, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Tango, a framework for efficient Video LLMs that improves token pruning through diversity-driven attention selection and improved similarity-based clustering. Identifies and addresses limitations in existing top-k selection and clustering approaches for video token reduction.

entry.title: 3D-VCD: Hallucination Mitigation in 3D-LLM Embodied Agents through Visual Contrastive Decoding

author.name: Makanjuola Ogunleye, Eman Abdelrahman and Ismini Lourentzou

entry.summary: Introduces 3D-VCD, the first inference-time visual contrastive decoding framework for mitigating hallucinations in 3D embodied agents. Constructs distorted 3D scene graphs to generate contrastive distributions that penalize hallucinated content.

entry.title: Yes, But Not Always. Generative AI Needs Nuanced Opt-in

author.name: Wiebke Hutiri, Morgan Scheuerman, Shruti Nagpal, Austin Hoag, Alice Xiang

entry.summary: Argues that binary opt-in/opt-out consent for generative AI training data is insufficient, proposing nuanced inference-time consent verification through an agent-based architecture that checks conditional consent granted by rights holders.

entry.title: DenseLoRA: Dense Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

author.name: Lin Mu, Xiaoyu Wang, Li Ni, Yang Li, Zhize Wu, Peiquan Jin, Yiwen Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces DenseLoRA, an improvement over LoRA for LLM fine-tuning that uses a single Encoder-Decoder to refine and compress hidden representations across adaptation layers instead of redundant low-rank matrix pairs. Claims superior parameter efficiency and performance.

entry.title: SparseCoop: Cooperative Perception with Kinematic-Grounded Queries

author.name: Jiahao Wang, Zhongwei Jiang, Wenchao Sun, Jiaru Zhong, Haibao Yu, Yuner Zhang, Chenyang Lu, Chuang Zhang, Lei He, Shaobing Xu, Jianqiang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SparseCoop, a fully sparse cooperative perception framework for autonomous driving 3D detection and tracking that discards intermediate BEV representations, using kinematic-grounded sparse queries for efficient multi-vehicle communication.

entry.title: Controllable Egocentric Video Generation via Occlusion-Aware Sparse 3D Hand Joints

author.name: Chenyangguang Zhang, Botao Ye, Boqi Chen, Alexandros Delitzas, Fangjinhua Wang, Marc Pollefeys, Xi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for controllable egocentric video generation using sparse 3D hand joints as embodiment-agnostic control signals. Handles severe egocentric occlusions and enables cross-embodiment generalization to robotic hands.

entry.title: EMA Is Not All You Need: Mapping the Boundary Between Structure and Content in Recurrent Context

author.name: Arth Singh

entry.summary: Uses EMA (exponential moving average) traces as controlled probes to map the boundary between temporal structure and token content in sequence models. Finds EMA captures structural information well (96% of supervised BiGRU) but destroys token identity, with 8x worse perplexity than GPT-2.

entry.title: Attention-Based Sampler for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Yuyan Zhou, Kai Syun Hou, Weiyu Chen, James Kwok

entry.summary: Studies decoding order selection for diffusion language models from a log-likelihood maximization perspective. Proposes an attention-based sampler that accounts for global sequence structure rather than just token-level information.

entry.title: FluidFlow: a flow-matching generative model for fluid dynamics surrogates on unstructured meshes

author.name: David Ramos, Lucas Lacasa, Ferm\'in Guti\'errez, Eusebio Valero and Gonzalo Rubio

entry.summary: Introduces FluidFlow, a generative model based on conditional flow-matching for CFD surrogates that operates directly on unstructured meshes without mesh interpolation. Provides scalable surrogate models for fluid dynamics.

entry.title: From Dispersion to Attraction: Spectral Dynamics of Hallucination Across Whisper Model Scales

author.name: Ivan Viakhirev, Kirill Borodin, Grach Mkrtchian

entry.summary: Proposes the Spectral Sensitivity Theorem predicting phase transitions in deep ASR networks from dispersive to attractor regimes. Validates on Whisper models, finding intermediate models show structural disintegration while large models enter compression-seeking states.

entry.title: LEGO: Latent-space Exploration for Geometry-aware Optimization of Humanoid Kinematic Design

author.name: Jihwan Yoon, Taemoon Jeong, Jeongeun Park, Chanwoo Kim, Jaewoon Kwon, Yonghyeon Lee, Kyungjae Lee, and Sungjoon Choi

entry.summary: Proposes LEGO, a framework for optimizing humanoid robot kinematic design by learning a latent design space from existing mechanical designs using screw-theory representations and isometric manifold learning, then optimizing via motion retargeting.

entry.title: RAMP: Hybrid DRL for Online Learning of Numeric Action Models

author.name: Yarin Benyamin, Argaman Mordoch, Shahaf S. Shperberg, Roni Stern

entry.summary: Proposes RAMP, combining deep RL, action model learning, and automated planning for learning numeric planning action models online through environment interaction. Creates a positive feedback loop between RL exploration and model-based planning.

entry.title: Accelerating Transformer-Based Monocular SLAM via Geometric Utility Scoring

author.name: Xinmiao Xiong, Bangya Liu, Hao Wang, Dayou Li, Nuo Chen, Andrew Feng, Mingyu Ding, Suman Banerjee, Yang Zhou, and Zhiwen Fan

entry.summary: Proposes LeanGate, a lightweight feed-forward gating network that predicts geometric utility scores for frames before expensive geometric decoding in monocular SLAM. Bypasses over 90% of frames while maintaining mapping quality.

entry.title: LLMs Underperform Graph-Based Parsers on Supervised Relation Extraction for Complex Graphs

author.name: Paolo Gajo, Domenic Rosati, Hassan Sajjad, Alberto Barr\'on-Cede\~no

entry.summary: Shows that LLMs underperform much smaller graph-based parsers for relation extraction when sentence graphs are complex (many relations). The performance gap widens as graph complexity increases.

entry.title: InstrAct: Towards Action-Centric Understanding in Instructional Videos

author.name: Zhuoyi Yang, Jiapeng Yu, Reuben Tan, Boyang Li, and Huijuan Xu

entry.summary: Proposes InstrAction, a pretraining framework for action-centric video understanding that addresses static bias in video models. Uses action-centric hard negatives and an Action Perceiver module to disentangle actions from objects.

entry.title: Revisiting Anisotropy in Language Transformers: The Geometry of Learning Dynamics

author.name: Raphael Bernas, Fanny Jourdan, Antonin Poch\'e, C\'eline Hudelot

entry.summary: Revisits anisotropy in language Transformers from a geometric learning dynamics perspective. Derives arguments for how frequency-biased sampling affects curvature and why training amplifies tangent directions.

entry.title: R2G: A Multi-View Circuit Graph Benchmark Suite from RTL to GDSII

author.name: Zewei Zhou, Jiajun Zou, Jiajia Zhang, Ao Yang, Ruichao He, Haozheng Zhou, Ao Liu, Jiawei Liu, Leilei Jin, Shan Shen, Daying Sun

entry.summary: Presents R2G, a multi-view circuit graph benchmark suite spanning RTL-to-GDSII physical design stages with 30 open-source IP cores, standardized representations, and reproducible baselines for GNN-based EDA tasks.

entry.title: TAIHRI: Task-Aware 3D Human Keypoints Localization for Close-Range Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Ao Li, Yonggen Ling, Yiyang Lin, Yuji Wang, Yong Deng, Yansong Tang

entry.summary: Proposes TAIHRI, the first VLM tailored for close-range human-robot interaction perception, understanding motion commands and localizing task-relevant 3D keypoints in egocentric camera coordinates.

entry.title: Low-Data Supervised Adaptation Outperforms Prompting for Cloud Segmentation Under Domain Shift

author.name: Harshith Kethavath and Weiming Hu

entry.summary: Shows that low-data supervised adaptation consistently outperforms all 60 prompt variants for cloud segmentation with CLIPSeg, where even engineered prompts underperform the zero-shot baseline.

entry.title: Efficient Hierarchical Implicit Flow Q-learning for Offline Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhiqiang Dong, Teng Pang, Rongjian Xu, Guoqiang Wu

entry.summary: Proposes goal-conditioned mean flow policy for offline GCRL, introducing average velocity fields into hierarchical policy modeling to address limited expressiveness of Gaussian policies for long-horizon control.

entry.title: Quantisation Reshapes the Metacognitive Geometry of Language Models

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Shows that model quantization restructures rather than uniformly degrades metacognitive efficiency in LLMs, with domain-level M-ratio profiles becoming uncorrelated between quantized and full-precision formats. However, underlying discrimination (Type-2 AUROC) remains perfectly stable.

entry.title: ActFER: Agentic Facial Expression Recognition via Active Tool-Augmented Visual Reasoning

author.name: Shifeng Liu, Zhengye Zhang, Sirui Zhao, Xinglong Mao, Zhehan Kan, Zhixiang Wei, Shiwei Wu, Chaoyou Fu, Tong Xu, Enhong Chen
